jobs.title: Develop your radiology career in Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Radiologists career opportunities across Sweden

Sweden currently has a strong need for specialist radiologists within both general diagnostic radiology and several subspecialties. Through Dignus Medical, a Scandinavian medical recruitment company with more than 20 years of experience, radiologists from across Europe can explore long-term career opportunities within the Swedish healthcare system.

We collaborate with hospitals and imaging departments across Sweden, ranging from regional hospitals to large university hospitals.

Our goal is to match your professional background, experience and preferences with the right workplace.

Radiologists in Sweden play a central role in clinical decision-making and work in close collaboration with physicians from many specialties. The work is primarily clinically focused and supported by modern imaging technology, digital reporting systems and well-structured workflows. Departments typically operate advanced diagnostic equipment including MRI, CT, ultrasound and conventional radiography, supported by modern PACS systems.

Professional Development

The current need in Sweden is primarily for radiologists who wish to focus on clinical diagnostic work. Radiologists often work broadly within diagnostic radiology while gradually developing subspecialist expertise depending on their interests and the needs of the department. Multidisciplinary collaboration with clinicians is an important part of everyday work.

For those interested, opportunities for teaching, research collaboration and academic involvement may also be available, particularly within larger hospitals. Some radiologists later choose to combine clinical work with teleradiology as part of their career development.

Relocation and Support

Relocating to another country is a significant step. Dignus Medical supports you throughout the entire process, from identifying suitable positions to becoming established in Sweden.

You will have an advisor guiding you through each step, including assistance with medical licensing, relocation planning and practical matters related to moving. Our services are completely free of charge for physicians.

Your advisor will remain your main point of contact throughout the entire process, from the initial discussions until you are fully established in your new role and life in Sweden.

Support for your family

Many physicians relocate with their families, and we provide guidance to help make the transition as smooth as possible. This may include information about schools, childcare and everyday life in Sweden, as well as guidance for partners seeking employment. If your partner works within healthcare, there may also be opportunities within our network.

Language training

To work independently as a physician in Sweden, Swedish language proficiency at C1 level is required. Dignus Medical provides intensive Swedish language training with professional instructors, online and adapted to your schedule.

Language training can also be offered to accompanying partners and older children up to B2 level to support their integration into Swedish society.

Living in Sweden

Sweden offers a high quality of life, safe communities and well-developed public services. Physicians often appreciate the balance between professional responsibility and personal life, with structured working hours and good opportunities for leisure activities.

Families benefit from high-quality childcare, subsidized preschool and free school meals for children. The country’s forests, lakes and coastline also provide excellent opportunities for outdoor activities throughout the year.

Requirements

We are seeking radiologists who hold EU-recognized specialist certification in radiology, have good communication skills in English and are motivated to learn Swedish.

Interested?

Radiologists working in general diagnostic radiology as well as those with subspecialist expertise are welcome to explore opportunities with us.

Send your CV and specialist certificate, and we will discuss suitable opportunities within our network of hospitals across Sweden. Dignus Medical will help match your profile with the right position and guide you throughout the entire process.

We look forward to receiving your application!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.title: Er du min superhelt? Gutt 10 år søker assistent
jobs.employer: MIO BPA AS AVD KONTOR KRISTIANSAND
jobs.description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA
📅 Tiltredelse: Snarlig
📌 Stillingstype: Fast og tilkalling
⏰ Arbeidstid: Primært ettermiddag og helg


Vi søker en en rolig, trygg, leken og god assistent til en gutt på 10 år med et sjeldent syndrom. Vi søker deg som kan være med å gi han gode opplevelser og støtte i hverdagen. Han liker blant annet å «lage kule ting», danse, teater, gjøre eksperimenter, tegne, lese, hoppe på trampoline og dra i dyreparken eller Skyland. Om vinteren bruker han sitski i alpintbakken og om sommeren er vi en del på stranden eller i båt. Han er omsorgsfull, glad og har mye humor, men kan også være sint og trenge hjelp med regulering. Han har språk, men det er litt utydelig og det kan ta litt tid før man lærer å forstå alt han sier. Assistenten må kunne være selvstendig i å engasjere han i aktiviteter, samt være en del av det praktiske hverdagslivet i familien.

Du må være tillitsskapende, tålmodig og trives med lek. Det er viktig at du har evne til å sette rolige, gode grenser og at du er en trygg og god voksen, som kan tenke kreativt i grensesettingssituasjoner. Gutten har to yngre søsken, så det er viktig at den som blir ansatt er glad i små barn og kan tåle noe støynivå. Det er ønskelig med en assistent som har anledning til å bli over lenger tid.

Arbeidstid og stilling

Vi søker etter:

  • Fast stilling på ca 5,75 timer i uken.

  • Tilkalling som kan stille opp ved behov.

Arbeidstid er på ettermiddag/kveldstid noen hverdager i uken og dagtid eller kveld i helger.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Henting på SFO

  • Støtte i kommunikasjon og lek

  • Deltakelse i familiehverdagen med to yngre søsken

  • Følge og støtte på aktiviteter i og utenfor hjemmet

  • Motivering og veiledning

  • Personlig stell

  • Praktiske oppgaver i hjemmet

Personlige egenskaper

  • Du bør være trygg og rolig, løsningsorientert og humørfylt

  • Du må være pålitelig og kunne arbeide selvstendig

  • Personlig egnethet og kjemi vektlegges ved ansettelse

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Erfaring med barn, gjerne helsefaglig eller pedagogisk bakgrunn

  • Gjerne student

  • Førerkort klasse B, automatgir

  • Gode norskkunnskaper

  • Gyldig politiattest

Oppstart etter avtale. Opplæring vil bli gitt.

Dersom du lurer på noe kan du gjerne ta en telefon til mamma, Helene, på telefon 48002510

Ved spørsmål angående stillingen, kontakt rekrutterer Jenny Dolven på epost: jenny.dolven@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfylt jobb

  • Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 236,49,-, kveldstillegg på 67,- og helgetillegg på 70,-

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer, nettbutikker etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. Det er viktig for oss å kunne gi våre kunder den aller beste tjenesten og at vi er den beste arbeidsplassen for våre medarbeidere. Mio BPA er en del av Mio-konsernet som er 100 prosent norskeid.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

• Modig: Vi utgjør en forskjell for hvert enkelt menneske vi møter. Vi gir mennesker et bedre liv og frihet til å leve slik de vil.

jobs.title: Ledig stilling ved dagsenter
jobs.description:
Vi søker en engasjert og omsorgsfull medarbeider til vårt dagsenter for personer med demens.

 

Stillingen er for tiden lagt til mandag, onsdag og fredag kl. 09.00-15.00. Arbeidet består i å bidra til en trygg, meningsfull og aktiv hverdag for brukerne av dagsenteret.

 

Arbeidsoppgaver:

Du vil blant annet: 

  • følge opp og ivareta personer med demens gjennom dagen 
  • planlegge og gjennomføre aktiviteter tilpasset den enkeltes interesser, funksjonsnivå og dagsform 
  • legge til rette for sosialt fellesskap, gode samtaler og hyggelige måltider 
  • gjennomføre aktiviteter som turer, trim og bevegelse, musikk og sang, spill, quiz, høytlesning, håndarbeid og andre kreative aktiviteter 
  • bidra til ro, trygghet, struktur og gode rutiner 
  • observere brukernes behov og bidra til god oppfølging 
  • samarbeide med kollegaer, pårørende og andre aktuelle samarbeidspartnere 
  • bidra med praktiske oppgaver knyttet til den daglige driften av dagsenteret 

 

Vi ser etter deg som

  • er trygg, tålmodig og glad i å arbeide med mennesker.
  • tar initiativ, ser den enkelte og evner å skape gode øyeblikk i hverdagen.
  • har erfaring fra arbeid med personer med demens eller eldre er en fordel.

Det er ønskelig med relevant fagutdanning

Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.

 

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfull og variert arbeidshverdag hvor du får bidra til økt livskvalitet, aktivitet og sosialt fellesskap for mennesker med demens. Du blir en del av et arbeidsmiljø hvor omsorg, samarbeid og respekt for den enkelte står sentralt.

 

Etter søknadsfristens utløp, vil det bli satt opp en offentlig søkerliste inneholdende navn, alder, stilling eller yrkestittel og bosteds- eller arbeidskommune for hver søker. Det kan gjøres unntak fra innsyn for opplysninger om en søker dersom vedkommende selv ber om det. Opplysninger om en søker kan bli offentlige selv om søkeren har anmodet om ikke å bli ført opp på søkerlisten. Dersom anmodningen ikke blir tatt til følge vil søkeren bli varslet om dette.

 

Alle stillinger legges ut på Hole kommunes nettside under ledige stillinger, elektronisk søknad skal benyttes.

Søk på stillingen ved å klikke på "Søk her" knappen på denne siden.

Vi oppfordrer til å laste opp attester og vitnemål i søknaden.

Merk at Hole kommune aldri ber om BankID-informasjon i noen del av søknadsprosessen. Det opplyses om dette da brukere av søknadstjenesten har opplevd forsøk på phishing

(digital snoking hvor det fiskes etter passord eller kredittkortnummer)

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Hole kommune har ca. 7000 innbyggere og ligger under 30 minutters kjøring fra Sandvika. Det jobbes med ny vei og bane som formodentlig vil redusere reisetiden ytterligere. Kommunen rigger seg for vekst og utvikling ved egne investeringer og satsningsområder og i felleskap med kommunene i Ringeriksregionen. Kommunens viktigste oppgave fremover er å både bevare de gode lokale verdiene og samtidig sørge for befolkningsvekst og nye arbeidsplasser. Hole kommune er Holes største arbeidsgiver med omlag 700 ansatte. Våre verdier kalt "RÅLF", Respekt- Åpenhet- Lojalitet- Fleksibilitet er godt nedfelt i vår organisasjonskultur, og du som søker må føle eierskap til disse verdibegrepene. Vår organisasjon kjennetegnes videre av en Vi-kultur, og vi trenger deg som vil spille på lag og bidra til at kommunen yter sitt beste for våre innbyggere.

jobs.title: Junior Product Owner
jobs.description:
Your journey

ROMEO is the queer company behind the legendary ROMEO dating app, one of Europe’s longest-standing dating platforms for queer communities. We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users.

In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams. It is a great opportunity to grow your product skills while taking real ownership of the day-to-day delivery process.


Your typical day

  • Support the Product Management team in refining product requirements and translating approved PRDs into implementation-ready epics, user stories and tickets.
  • Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria and are sufficiently refined before entering development.
  • Maintain and order the backlog according to priorities set by product leadership.
  • Take part in regular and ad hoc meetings to clarify product requirements with development, design and other delivery teams.
  • Support our two-week delivery cycle by ensuring development teams have the information and decisions they need to proceed.
  • Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery.
  • Work closely with QA to communicate product and release priorities, clarify acceptance criteria, and support defect triage and release-readiness decisions.
  • Support product acceptance and release readiness by checking delivered functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Support the BI team by translating product questions, KPIs and tracking needs into clear data requirements.
  • Ensure agreed analytics requirements are captured as part of delivery, including relevant event tracking before work is considered complete.
  • Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation in Jira and Confluence.


We look for

  • You are passionate about building products for LGBTQ+ communities and interested in contributing to the continued development of ROMEO.
  • You have initial experience in a Product Owner or similar product delivery role, ideally in a B2C environment. Experience in social, dating or community products is a plus. Being familiar with how our product works is a plus.
  • You have experience writing or refining user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • You have a good understanding of Agile product development and ideally hands-on experience with Scrum and/or Kanban.
  • You are comfortable working with Jira and Confluence. Experience with Xray is a plus.
  • You are organised, detail-oriented and reliable in following work through to completion.
  • You proactively follow up on missing information and drive requirements towards clarity.
  • You are based in Berlin or willing to relocate and are happy to work from our Wittenbergplatz office at least three days per week.
  • You have excellent written and spoken English skills, ideally at a native or near-native level.


What We Offer

  • A hands-on role working on an established European digital product during a significant phase of product and technology transformation.
  • Close collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, QA and BI,
  • Hybrid working (3 days per week in our Berlin office at Wittenbergplatz)
  • €40 employer contribution towards the Germany Job Ticket
  • EGYM Wellpass (only €20/month employee contribution)
  • In-house German classes
  • Annual learning budget (e.g. for conferences, courses, certifications)
  • International team, English-speaking environment

jobs.title: Er du glad i tur og friluftsliv, liker varierte dager og vil ha en jobb som betyr noe?
jobs.description:
Jeg er en aktiv familiemann i 30-årene som søker assistenter til mitt nye BPA-team i Arna. I fjor sommer fikk jeg en ryggmargsskade etter en fallulykke, og nå bygger jeg opp hverdagen min igjen. Som brukerstyrt personlig assistent vil du bli en viktig del av at jeg kan leve et fritt, aktivt og meningsfullt liv.


Om meg

Jeg bor sammen med min nydelige kone, våre to herlige små barn og tre hunder.

Som person trives jeg aller best ute – på tur, med hundene eller i aktivitet. Friluftsliv er en av mine store lidenskaper, som det er en fordel av du deler – men hvis ikke kommer du langt med å eie gode regnklær og en positiv innstilling!

Jeg er familiefar, jaktmann, hundemann og et arbeidsjern av de sjeldne. Hos meg vil du bli tatt godt imot, da jeg er en person med godt humør som liker å slå av en spøk.


Arbeidsoppgaver

Som assistent hos meg vil du tilrettelegge og bistå meg i det daglige.

Dette innebærer blant annet:

  • Følge til og fra aktiviteter, trening, avtaler, barnehagen, osv.
  • Tilrettelegge for lek med barna
  • Ståtrening og gjennombevegelse
  • Går tur med hundene, både sammen med meg og alene
  • Bistand til huslige gjøremål (handling, renhold, vask. osv.)
  • Personlig stell
  • Bistå med forflytning
  • Du vil få god opplæring i alle arbeidsoppgaver. Stillingen krever ikke helsefaglig bakgrunn eller tidligere erfaring.


Stillingene og arbeidstid

Jeg ser etter deg som ønsker å jobbe én til to ettermiddagsvakter i uken. Vaktene er vanligvis fra kl. 16.00 til 22.00 og vil hovedsakelig være på mandager, torsdager eller fredager.

Det er en fordel om du også har mulighet til å ta noen ekstra vakter i sommermånedene ved behov. Skriv gjerne litt i søknadsteksten om din egen tilgjengelighet.


Hvem vil trives i jobben?

Det viktigste for meg er at du trives med barn, er varm og omsorgsfull. Så lenge du er stabil og moden, har alder ikke noe å si.

Ellers passer du godt her om du:

  • Liker å jobbe tett på mennesker og tåler at det kan bli litt støy av og til
  • Syns det er greit, og helst litt kjekt, å komme seg ut i all slags vær
  • Er positiv og løsningsorientert
  • Ønsker en jobb du kan bli i over tid


Kvalifikasjonskrav

  • 18 år og plettfri vandel
  • Ikke være allergisk mot hund
  • Gode norskkunnskaper
  • Førerkort klasse B


Vi tilbyr

  • En meningsfull jobb som fremmer likestilling
  • Gode arbeids- og lønnsbetingelser gjennom tariffavtale
  • Grundig opplæring og tett oppfølging av lokalkontor
  • En selvstendig jobb med varierte arbeidsoppgaver

Det er viktig for oss at du skal ha et godt arbeidsmiljø.


Du vil bli formelt ansatt i Prima Assistanse, som vil ha ansvaret for lønn, forsikringer og kurs av ulike slag, men arbeidsplassen blir hjemme hos meg i Arna.

Søknader behandles fortløpende, med ønsket oppstart så snart som mulig. Jeg ser frem til å høre fra akkurat deg!

BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. jobs.title: Bli BPA-assistent og en viktig del av hverdagen til en fantastisk 12-åring 😊
jobs.description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA
📅 Tiltredelse: Fortløpende
📌 Stillingstype: Fast
⏰ Arbeidstid: Helg

Hei! Jeg er en sosial og aktiv gutt på 12 år som bor på Jessheim, like ved Nordbytjernet. Nå trenger jeg flere faste assistenter til teamet mitt, og kanskje er det akkurat deg jeg håper skal bli med!

Jeg er en gutt som liker at det skjer ting. På fritiden gamer jeg på iPad og Xbox, sykler på tandemsykkel, bowler, drar på tur med bil, tog og trikk og går gjerne på kino. Jeg sier heller ikke nei til en is! Jeg liker også å stå på sitski og leke med lillebror og lillesøster.

Kort sagt: Jeg liker mennesker med godt humør, masse energi og sans for tull og tøys. Hvis du i tillegg synes gaming og biler er gøy, har vi allerede noe å snakke om! 😄

Jeg har cerebral parese og bruker rullestol. Det betyr at jeg trenger hjelp til alt av det praktiske i hverdagen. Samtidig er jeg veldig tydelig på hva jeg liker, hva jeg vil og hvordan jeg ønsker å ha det. Som assistent blir du derfor ikke bare en som hjelper meg – du blir armene og beina mine, og en viktig del av hverdagen min.

Arbeidstid

Jeg søker nå faste assistenter som kan inngå i teamet mitt.

Ledige stillingene er:

• 2 x stillinger med arbeid hver 3. helg (lørdag og søndag), som utgjør ca. 11 % stilling.

Arbeidstid: Dagvakt 09:00 - 15:00, Kveldsvakt 15:00 - 20:30

Arbeidsoppgaver

• Personlig hygiene

• Gi meg mat og medisiner – jeg spiser noe selv, mens resten gis via PEG-knapp

• Kommunikasjon ved hjelp av Tobii øyestyringsskjerm

• Forflytning mellom ulike hjelpemidler

• Kjøre og håndtere rullestolen

• Henting på skolen

• Å bli med på aktiviteter, turer og alt det morsomme jeg liker å gjøre

• Å være armene og beina mine når jeg trenger det

Hvem håper jeg å finne?

Jeg håper du er en person som:

• Er leken, morsom og ikke redd for litt tull og tøys

• Har godt humør og liker å være aktiv

• Er tålmodig og løsningsorientert

• Er trygg, omsorgsfull og ansvarsbevisst

• Synes gaming og biler er gøy – det er et stort pluss!

Kvalifikasjoner

• Førerkort, siden du skal kunne hente meg på skolen

• Du må snakke godt norsk

• Du må ha gyldig politiattest

Det viktigste for meg er likevel hvem du er som person. Du trenger ikke kunne alt fra før. Det lærer du underveis.

Hvis du kjenner at dette høres ut som en jobb du kunne trivdes med, håper jeg virkelig du søker! Kanskje er det nettopp du som blir en del av teamet mitt. 😊

Jeg gleder meg til å høre fra deg!

Aktuelle kandidater inviteres til intervju fortløpende, og vi ansetter så snart vi har funnet de rette personene.

Ved spørsmål angående stillingen, kontakt rekrutterer Karen Tonette Bulæg på epost karen.bulag@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfylt jobb

  • Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 236,49,-, kveldstillegg på 67,- og helgetillegg på 70,-

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer, nettbutikker etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. Det er viktig for oss å kunne gi våre kunder den aller beste tjenesten og at vi er den beste arbeidsplassen for våre medarbeidere. Mio BPA er en del av Mio-konsernet som er 100 prosent norskeid.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

• Modig: Vi utgjør en forskjell for hvert enkelt menneske vi møter. Vi gir mennesker et bedre liv og frihet til å leve slik de vil.

We are in a steep expansion, and you will be part of Hitachi Energy Cooling Systems business unit in Landskrona. We have a global responsibility for the development and manufacture of cooling systems for Power Electronic applications and other applications that require water cooling systems with high reliability and availability.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the green transition and create a more sustainable energy future for all. So, if you want to take the next step in your career, and contribute to develop a stronger, smarter, and greener energy system – Join us now, we are ready for you!

Your responsibilities

jobs.title: Manager - IT Network, Lund
jobs.description:
Do you want to lead a team that keeps a global company connected? We're looking for a Manager - IT Network to lead our IT Network team and take ownership of the network that ties Axis together worldwide. The role is based at our headquarters in Lund!

Your future team
The IT Network team is part of our IT Infrastructure & Operations department and consists of around 10 senior technical specialists. You and your team are responsible for the strategic development of the Axis network. Together, you will shape the future of our network through clear roadmaps and action plans, based on an understanding of Axis' requirements and of how technology is developing in the network market.

You will report to the Director of IT Infrastructure.

What you'll do here as Manager - IT Network
Every meeting, every product shipped, every colleague logging in from an Axis site somewhere in the world depends on the network working, not only today but in the future. As Manager - IT Network, you lead the team that defines the future network agenda and makes sure the development plans are carried out.

    Lead, coach and develop the IT Network team, with responsibility for the team's development and your colleagues' personal development
    Own our global network infrastructure from a strategic and tactical point of view, ensuring stable and reliable day-to-day operation of the network
    Set the direction for the network area and drive architecture decisions together with colleagues across IT and stakeholders globally within Axis
    Manage vendors, service providers and contracts
    Take ownership of the budget and forecast for the network area
    Work closely with information security to keep our network secure

Who are you?
You enjoy leading through others. Coaching, giving feedback and helping people grow is what makes the job meaningful to you, and you see the power in a team where different perspectives meet.

You're structured, you know when to zoom out and when to go into the details, and you communicate clearly with colleagues wherever they sit in the world.

You are comfortable in technical discussions and understand what they mean from a business perspective. Leading change in a complex infrastructure environment should be something you feel excited about.

You should be open and curious towards people and technology and have the courage to challenge the status quo.

We'd love to hear that you have:

    A degree in IT or engineering, or equivalent experience
    Solid experience of global networks
    Solid experience of leading change, both technical and organizational
    Experience of developing people and teams
    Professional working proficiency in English and Swedish, spoken and written

Bonus points if you also have:

    Experience of working in a global environment

What Axis has to offer
We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact.

Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance - developing solutions used worldwide.

As a fast growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You'll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance.

Our Lund HQ Campus, including the impressive Grenden building, offers a dynamic environment with spaces crafted to encourage collaboration, whether through informal "fika" chats, formal meetings, or after-hours activities. Check it out: Axis HQ

Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance - and even your own Axis bicycle.

To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore:

Axis Career Hub

Life at Axis blog  

Engineering at Axis blog

Innovation at Axis

Ready to Act?
Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications.

We go through applications continuously so don't wait - send in your application today!

If you have any questions, please contact the recruiting manager Åsa Antius Child, Director Infrastructure & IT Operations, at +46 46 272 18 00 (Switchboard)

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in epigenetics at the K.G Jebsen Centre of Obesity Research (CORA)
jobs.description:
About the position 

Applications are invited for a 3-year position as postdoctoral researcher in epigenetics and obesity research at the newly established K.G Jebsen Centre of Obesity ReseArch (CORA). The position will be affiliated to Yvonne Böttcher’s research group at the Department of Clinical Molecular Biology (EpiGen) at Institute of Clinical Medicine, UiO, physically located at Campus Ahus (Akershus University Hospital).  

The project aims at investigating molecular mechanisms underlying weight regain and long-term weight loss maintenance using advanced molecular biology techniques. In particular, the project will investigate amongst other the concept of epigenetic memory of obesity in humans and closely collaborate with clinical environments involved in treatment of obesity  

The applicant will be involved in tasks related to epigenetic and epitranscriptomic mechanisms potentially being implicated in the regulation of human body weight and adipose tissue biology in general. We are looking for a candidate with extensive hands-on training on a broad spectrum of multiomics analyses in adipose tissue. The applicant will join a team with long-standing experience in translational obesity research whilst other groups in the department Is generally working on translational biomedical research focusing on Alzheimer´s, and cancer research in a precision medicine perspective. 


Project description

Obesity is a growing health problem worldwide. Metabolic surgery or use of GLP-1R analoga are efficient methods to induce significant weight loss in individuals with obesity. However, many individuals struggle to maintain a healthier body weight and often suffer from regain weight after treatment. The newly established K.G. Jebsen Center for obesity research (CORA), lead by Prof. Yvonne Böttcher, aims to understand the biological mechanisms underlying weight regain and obesity relapse, identify individuals at risk, and develop strategies for sustained weight loss and long-term weight maintenance.  

Yvonne Böttcher’ research group (https://functionalgeneticsofobesity.wordpress.com/) is investigating the role of epigenetic mechanisms in obesity, the molecular mechanisms imposed by DNA, RNA and histone modifications and their potential interplay with genetic risk variants. In CORA, the group will specifically focus on the role of epigenetic memory in adipose tissue after weight loss.  

The project aims at investigating mechanisms involved in metabolic memory in human adipose tissue and weight re-gain after weight loss in humans. The candidate will be closely involved in collaborations with excellent clinical environments in Norway and abroad. 

The successful applicant will will work on amongst others on human biomaterial and cell culture models to better understand the potential epigenetic mechanisms responsible for weight regain. The work will include advanced molecular biology techniques such as next generation sequencing and multi-omics technologies as well as potentially single-cell technologies. 

The position will require collaboration both within Norway, and internationally, with clinicians, molecular biologists and bioinformaticians/statisticians in other areas of the centre. The successful candidate is expected to become a driver of the project in close


Your areas of responsibility will be
  • Carry out high-quality scientific research
  • Publish results in high-impact, peer-reviewed scientific journals
  • Apply for research funding 
  • Disseminate research at national and international meetings and conferences 
  • Co-Mentoring of PhD and mentoring of master students 

Qualifications and competence

Qualification requirements:

  • A degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in molecular biology, biomedicine, genetics, or a closely related area. If the degree is not yet formally received, the doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the application date. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and public defense are eligible for employment
  • Experience in epigenetics and/or obesity research 
  • Extensive experience in molecular biology laboratory work
  • Hands-on experience in one or more of the following:
    • Single cell sequencing techniques 
    • Omics techniques such as ChIP-seq, CUT & Run; CUT & Tag, ATAC-seq, Whole genome bisulphite sequencing, RNAseq, Nanopore sequencing, ribosome profiling
    • Work with human adipose tissue or primary adipocytes and relevant cell culture models such as 3T3L-1 adipocytes or SGBS cells 
    • Next generation sequencing data analysis 
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English
  • Published first author papers in well recognized journals

It is an advantage if you have:

  • Experience working with sensitive data in TSD  
  • Methodologal knowledge in cell sorting 
  • Basic programming skills (R/Python/Unix) 
  • Competence in statistics (R/SPSS/Stata) 

Personal characteristics
  • Team player
  • Self-driven/ independent  
  • Structured and well organized 
  • Good communication and collaboration skills 
  • Positive and enthusiastic 
     

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We can offer you
  • A stimulating environment at a high scientific level at CORA, with possibilities for extensive cross-diciplinary collaborations
  • Excellent laboratory facilities at EpiGen 
  • Career development programs through the Postdoctoral programme (The Medical Faculty, UiO), and through the K.G. Jebsen academy for young scientists 
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK from 595 00 to 679 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal


Application

Your application should include:

  • Application letter
  • CV
  • A complete list of publications separating original publications from review articles
  • Transcripts and certificates
  • Contact information for 2-3 references

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

jobs.title: Founding Account Executive
jobs.description:
What do we do?

Our mission is to radically accelerate the pace of software development by empowering every engineer to ship at the speed their agents write code. We’re building the last piece of the puzzle to enable this - the part that makes it actually safe to ship.

AI is enabling engineers to write code faster than ever before. But software review and testing hasn’t caught up. Engineering leaders are drowning in long software review cycles and more bugs than ever. The bottleneck isn’t writing code anymore, it’s everything that comes after it.

We spent 3 years building patented foundational technology to solve this. Our CTO, Quentin, spent over a decade at Palantir, where he led the 0 to 1 of core products that insiders credit as the primary value drivers behind Gotham and Foundry. Since then, we’ve grown 5x year-on-year and now work with top engineering orgs - Notion, ElevenLabs, Mercor, Dropbox, Discord, LaunchDarkly, Wiz, CoreWeave, Wealthsimple, and more.

You’ll be joining us at a pivotal time. We’ve raised $20m from Chemistry, Menlo and Coatue, the same investors behind Twilio, Twitch, Intercom and PagerDuty and are backed by angels including the founders of Vercel, Datadog, Segment, Dropbox, the CTO of GitHub, CPO of Adobe, head of engineering at Cursor and many more.

This is an opportunity to join a company going through hypergrowth as we scale from millions of annual recurring revenue to $100m ARR.

If this excites you, come help us build it!

What is the opportunity?

Join us as a Founding AE hire in London and own the full sales motion end-to-end, from first discovery to strategising pilot deployment to closing the deal.

Most AEs work a narrow slice of the stack, repeating the same sales scripts and motion deal after deal and handing off to a sales engineer the moment a conversation turns technical. Here, you’ll own the sales cycle from discovery to pilot, then stay on as deployment lead to make sure it actually succeeds. You’ll own technical conversations, building real technical authority with engineering leaders and understand exactly what their software development workflow looks like, why they buy and what they’d like to see different about the product.

This is an IC role, there is no team beneath you and no one to delegate work to.

Examples of what you will work on

  • Own end-to-end cycles: You’ll build and manage your own sales pipeline, win pilots and close deals, growing to lead a geography or sector or team as we scale

  • Lead enterprise sales: Navigate complex sales cycles with the world’s leading mid-market and enterprise tech businesses (up to $XXX BN market cap), initially securing low-six then mid-six figure deals

  • Strategise complex deployments: Work alongside our engineers on pilots to figure out how to make them successful, run training sessions and build strong relationships at the user level

  • Help steer our roadmap: You’ll become the best person in the company at explaining and pitching the product and can take specific customer feedback back to our product teams

  • Events: You’ll network with CTOs & engineering leaders, attend our dinners and conferences across the US, and become well-known in this space

You will love this role if

  • ⭐ You learn fast and want to dive deep into the product - you have strong analytical thinking and can work from first principles; ambiguity / lack of experience in a technical domain doesn’t faze you / you are excited to learn!

  • ⭐ You are highly agentic - you have a bias to action, move fast, take ownership without being asked (e.g. if you need sales collateral you build it yourself!)

  • ⭐ You’re a hunter - chasing down revenue feels energizing, not exhausting or stressful, you create your own pipeline if there isn’t one!

  • ⭐ You want to work with engineers - you will spend most of your time externally and internally with developers, and this excites you!

This role is not for you if

  • You expect to work regular working hours and to travel infrequently; our teams, customers, investors span SF, London, NY

  • You need a team of BDRs, RevOps and Marketing to support you across the sales motion

  • You expect to lean entirely on engineers for technical demos and discovery calls

  • You expect never to have to build your own pipeline

Requirements

  • STEM degree

  • 3-7 years of work experience outperforming in a B2B SaaS sales, strategic deployment or adjacent role

  • Experience with outbound-led sales

  • Bonus if you have experience selling a deeply technical product to senior engineering leaders or have been an early GTM hire (< #20) at a fast growing startup

  • If you were previously or are currently a software engineer with strong commercial acumen looking to pivot into tech sales, we’d strongly encourage you to apply!

You may look like this

  • Ex-STEM: You were always on the STEM track but realised being around people is what drives you! You are currently an AE but want to go back to doing something that is a bit more technical.

  • Builder: You are an AE but were previously a founder, have been part of an incubator (YC, EF, Antler) or want to be a future founder. You spike at commercial work but want to build knowledge outside of that to be a more well rounded leader in the future.

  • Early-stage operator: You have been or want to be an early founding hire to help shape what sales looks like and work to build up the processes, materials and strategy that will help us win!

  • AI lover: You work in b2b sales but feel like AI is developing so quickly you’re being left behind and want to build out a more technical skillset

Perks ♥️

  • Competitive comp + significant equity

  • 🍲 Unlimited food & drinks in office - including daily lunch as a team, and your own Amazon business account to buy whatever snacks you want for the office.

  • 💻 A setup you’ll love - everyone has a standing desk, brand new Macbook, your choice of ergonomic peripherals, and a £2k WFH budget to make home just as good

  • 🏄‍♀️ £300 monthly wellness stipend - Third Space gym, reformer pilates, cold plunge, however you want to keep your best

  • 🎁 We celebrate you - £400 in gifts on your birthday and work anniversary every year

  • 🌴 Team offsites - we work and play hard, we’ve done offsites in Italy, Abu Dhabi and local 5-star resorts

  • 📚 Unlimited book budget - we have a growing in-office library and actively encourage everyone to add to it, whether you want to ramp up your knowledge of software testing, or become a better startup operator!

  • 📌 In-person, 4 days a week - at our office in Shoreditch

  • many more!

People behind Meticulous

Guillermo Rauch (founder of Vercel), Jason Warner (CTO of GitHub), Calvin French-Owen (founder of Segment), Jared Friedman (YC partner and founder of Scribd), Scott Belsky (CPO of Adobe), Arash Ferdowsi (founder of Dropbox) and many others are all personal investors in Meticulous.

Compensation: £100K – £200K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission

  • • OTE £100K – £200K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission

jobs.title: Global Practice Lead
jobs.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🐙 Kraken Customer

What we do: build an AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimising resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

🏠 Where you’ll fit in: The Delivery Team

We have been licensing Kraken since 2019. Throughout this time, the Delivery team has been at the forefront of industry-leading migrations, setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like. These transformations go far beyond technology: we work with clients to rethink their operating models and ways of working, while continuously making the most of Kraken's evolving capabilities.

Client Delivery sits at the heart of Kraken’s transformation journeys, at the intersection of our clients and the product and engineering teams building Kraken 🚀 We lead conversations around our clients’ most important needs, help them unlock the value of Kraken and turn complex challenges into opportunities to evolve the platform, keeping Kraken innovative, relevant and ahead of where the energy market is going.

It’s a high-impact, hands-on team where you’ll influence both our clients transformation and what Kraken becomes next 💡 As a Global Practice Lead, you’ll shape and lead your practice globally, working closely with Regional Practice Leads in your team across EMEA, the US and APAC to set the global direction for the practice, drive consistency and excellence across regions, and bring together insights from our people, clients and markets to influence how we deliver and how Kraken evolves.

 

🚀 What you'll own

As a Global Practice Lead at Kraken, you will set the global direction for your practice and be accountable for its performance, capability and evolution across regions. You will lead and develop Regional Practice Leads and their teams, ensuring that Kraken delivers consistently high standards for clients globally while adapting to different markets and client needs.

Operating at the intersection of Delivery, Product, Engineering and our clients, you will identify patterns across markets, influence Kraken’s strategy and product direction, and build the structures, capabilities and talent needed for the practice to scale successfully.

  • Global Vision & Strategy: Define and own the global vision and strategy for your practice, translating Kraken’s broader objectives into clear priorities, standards and outcomes across regions.

  • Leadership & People Development: Lead, coach and develop Regional Practice Leads and senior delivery leaders, building a strong leadership layer and ensuring consistent expectations around performance, development and team health globally.

  • Global Delivery Excellence: Own the overall quality and effectiveness of delivery within your practice, identifying systemic risks and opportunities and ensuring consistently high standards across regions, clients and programs.

  • Client & Product Strategy: Represent global client needs within Kraken, identifying patterns across markets and partnering closely with Product and Engineering leadership to influence product strategy, prioritize scalable solutions and maximize adoption of Kraken’s core capabilities.

  • Global TTV & Transformation Outcomes: Drive improvements in Time to Value and client outcomes across the global portfolio, using insights across migrations and BAU engagements to continuously improve how Kraken delivers.

  • Global Capacity & Workforce Strategy: Own the long-term capability and capacity strategy for the practice, partnering with regional leaders and Talent to anticipate demand, identify skills gaps and ensure the right expertise is available in the right markets.

  • Executive Client Engagement: Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders globally and step into the most strategic or complex engagements where senior leadership, alignment or intervention is required.

  • Strategic Escalation & Decision-Making: Act as a senior escalation point for complex, cross-regional challenges, bringing together the right stakeholders and removing organizational, product or delivery blockers.

  • Practice Expertise & Standards: Define what excellence looks like within your practice, establishing global methodologies, standards and best practices while allowing appropriate flexibility for regional and client-specific needs.

  • Organizational Influence: Partner with senior leaders across Delivery, Product, Engineering and other functions to shape decisions that affect clients, delivery strategy and the future development of the practice.

  • Cross-Regional Learning & Scale: Ensure knowledge, successful delivery patterns and lessons learned move effectively across regions, turning individual client experiences into improvements that benefit Kraken globally.

  • Future Capability: Anticipate how the practice needs to evolve as Kraken, our product and the energy industry develop, building new capabilities and expertise ahead of emerging client needs.

     

🧠 What you'll bring to the party

  • People-first leadership: A leadership style grounded in influence, trust and leading by example rather than authority, with a genuine commitment to caring for and developing people. The ability to create psychological safety and combine empathy with clear expectations and accountability, enabling teams to feel trusted, supported and empowered to do their best work.

  • Senior global leadership experience: Significant experience leading complex client delivery, transformation or professional-services organizations across multiple regions, clients and markets.

  • Leadership of leaders: experience leading and developing other leaders, with the ability to create clarity and accountability while empowering regional leadership teams to make effective decisions.

  • Strategic influence: A demonstrated ability to operate at senior leadership level and influence strategy across organizational boundaries, particularly across Delivery, Product and Engineering.

  • Executive client leadership: Credibility with C-level and senior client stakeholders, including experience navigating complex transformations, competing priorities and high-stakes client situations.

  • Subject-matter expertise: Deep expertise in your practice area, combined with a strong understanding of the global energy landscape and the ability to recognize where regional differences require different approaches.

  • Systems thinking: The ability to look across regions and client engagements, identify patterns and root causes, and turn those insights into scalable improvements to products, processes and ways of working.

  • Strategic & operational balance: The ability to set long-term direction while remaining close enough to delivery to understand what is happening on the ground and intervene effectively when required.

  • People leadership & emotional intelligence: Sound judgment and empathy, with experience developing senior talent, navigating difficult conversations and creating environments where leaders and teams can perform at their best.

  • Communication & executive presence: Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics, create compelling narratives and align senior internal and external stakeholders around a common direction.

  • Resilience & adaptability: The resilience, pragmatism and hands-on mindset to navigate ambiguity and significant transformation, while keeping teams aligned and moving forward.

     

⭐️ Bonus points

  • Languages: Full professional proficiency in English is required; additional languages are a plus.

jobs.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

We are looking for a Global Director of Product for Flex to lead the product strategy, direction, and organisation behind Kraken's global flexibility platform. Kraken Flex connects distributed energy resources to energy markets at scale — operating across Liberalised Markets, where we trade flexibility directly, and Regulated Markets, where we partner with utilities and DSOs to deliver grid services.

This is a pivotal executive product role at the heart of Kraken's fastest-growing business unit. You will own the product direction, roadmap, culture, and delivery effectiveness of the shared Flex platform — the core set of capabilities that both business units depend on to compete and grow.

Your mandate is to evolve the Flex platform into a scalable, differentiated capability that creates long-term strategic advantage: meaningfully ahead of anything the flexibility market has built.

 
 

🏡 Where you'll fit in:

You will lead the product organisation across all shared Flex platform squads — the teams building the core capabilities that underpin Liberalised and Regulated Markets propositions globally. You will work with the VP of Engineering for Flex, together accountable for the quality, culture, and strategic direction of the Flex technology organisation.

The shared platform sits at the intersection of two distinct business models, multiple geographies, and a constantly evolving set of market requirements. The central challenge of this role is making the right calls about what the platform should build, in what sequence, and why — while holding the tension between serving immediate business needs and protecting long-term platform integrity.

 
 

🚀 What you'll own:

  • Product Strategy and Roadmap: Own the product vision and roadmap across all Flex platform squads. Ensure it is genuinely aligned with Flex's long-term strategy and the priorities of both business units — not a backlog of requests from the loudest stakeholder.

  • Cross-BU Alignment: Work alongside Proposition Product Leaders across Liberalised and Regulated Markets to identify what the platform should build to unlock their roadmaps, and which capabilities developed in proposition teams are ready to become shared platform features. Make those calls with clarity and conviction.

  • Platform Strategy: Identify and drive capabilities emerging from proposition teams. Ensure the shared platform evolves toward reusable, composable architecture — balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term platform coherence.

  • Product Culture and Practice: Build and sustain a high-performing product organisation. Define how teams discover, prioritise, and deliver. Mentor Product Managers across Flex, set the bar for product excellence, and create the conditions for PMs to meet it.

  • Competitive Positioning: Maintain a clear picture of where Flex has capability gaps versus alternatives in the market. Own the plans to close those gaps before they become liabilities.

  • Long-Term Differentiation: Look beyond the current roadmap. Identify technology and product investments that create durable, hard-to-replicate advantage for Kraken Flex, and work with Flex GMs to prioritise them.

🧠 What you'll bring:


Essential Experience

  • Executive Product Leadership: Proven experience building and leading product organisations — not just managing product teams. You've shaped culture, developed people, and elevated the function around you.

  • Platform Product Expertise: Deep experience in platform or shared infrastructure product contexts — building capabilities that serve multiple internal customers with competing priorities, without losing coherence or quality.

  • Commercial Acumen: A track record of connecting product decisions to business outcomes and making the case for long-term platform investment in commercial terms. You can represent product strategy credibly to executive leadership.

  • Engineering Partnership: Genuine experience co-owning roadmaps and co-building organisations with engineering leadership as a peer — not a handoff relationship.

  • Organisational Complexity: Demonstrated ability to operate across multiple business units, market models, or geographies — making decisions that serve the whole without losing sight of the specific.


Leadership & Mindset

  • You possess a rare combination of strategic clarity and operational discipline — you can define where the platform needs to be in three years while staying close enough to delivery to know when something's going wrong today.

  • You are a product leader who builds organisations, not just products. The PMs around you get better because of you.

  • You thrive in environments where the answer isn't obvious. You can hold the tension between serving immediate business needs and protecting long-term platform integrity, and make good decisions in that space.

  • You embody the ability to "think long-term and ship next week."

 
 

⭐️ Bonus points:

  • Experience in energy trading, utilities, or distributed energy resources used for grid flexibility.

  • Experience building platforms that serve both internal proposition teams and external partners or customers.

  • Prior experience scaling a product organisation through a period of rapid, sustained growth.

jobs.description:

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏡 Where you'll fit in:
KrakenFlex is the flexibility arm of the Kraken group, built to put a big green dent in global carbon emissions by rewriting how electricity grids operate. We stabilize the grid and help renewables come online much faster by managing the second-by-second balance of clean power. Right now, our platform connects nearly one million assets worldwide, putting over 6GW of live load under our direct control.

Behind the scenes, that means handling massive technical scale: solving complex optimization problems in real time and processing 15 billion data readings a day from the latest green technologies, ensuring the grid stays reliable without relying on old fossil-fuel backup plants.

The next phase of our journey involves monumental growth. Currently operational across multiple countries, we are poised for further global expansion, scaling our asset base and tackling unique grid challenges in new territories. Our mission is to integrate an increasingly diverse array of green flexibility assets while ensuring our market-leading platform remains exceptionally stable and performant.

What is Optimisation in Flex?
The Optimisation chapter is the mathematical and algorithmic engine of the KrakenFlex platform. While other chapters manage physical asset connectivity or ingest market signals, this domain is responsible for the intelligence that decides exactly what every asset should do, second by second, to maximise both grid stability and financial returns.

The teams within this chapter build and maintain the real-time dispatch engines, predictive forecasting models, and algorithmic solvers that handle massive multi-asset portfolios. This involves translating complex market rules, physical asset constraints (like battery degradation curves, state-of-charge limits, and ramp rates), and fluctuating price signals into optimised execution strategies.

The defining challenge for this chapter is scaling computational performance alongside our rapid asset growth. Running complex, multi-variable mathematical models in tight real-time windows requires immense efficiency. The core tension lies in balancing the demand from data science and quantitative engineering to introduce increasingly sophisticated models with the strict platform requirement for absolute reliability, low latency, and cost-effective cloud compute.

Ultimately, this chapter must move away from bespoke optimisation routines tailored to individual markets or asset types. Your goal is to architect a highly performant, modular optimisation core that uses standard abstract layers, allowing us to roll out new algorithms or expand into new global territories without rewriting the underlying engine.

The Flex platform is built on autonomous Chapters, which are collections of specialists focused on delivering a core service or business outcome, defined by the unchanging nature of the energy business (independent of technology, hardware, or regional differences). A Head of Engineering leading a Chapter is a senior leadership role combining strong product thinking, engineering judgement, operational awareness, and people leadership. They manage managers and senior individual contributors, helping teams own their product surfaces, make sound trade-offs, and deliver reliably.

This role requires influencing beyond its formal remit, spotting cross-team patterns, clarifying ownership and decision-making, and driving initiatives to turn recurring issues into visible actions with owners, dates, and measures of success. jobs.title: Senior Product Quality Analyst - AI Voice
jobs.description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

We are the Voice Production Team, the creative team behind Spotify’s AI voice experiences. We think about AI voices from a casting perspective — including voice type, age and gender — and from a performance perspective, recognizing that a voice may need to perform differently for DJ than it does for an audiobook recap. We bring expertise in voice casting, direction, recording and production, and work closely with Speak to set the quality bar for AI voice models across experiences including AI DJ, Generative AI Ads, Personalized Podcasts, Agent Voice Chat and more.

As a Senior Product Quality Analyst, you’ll bring a dedicated evaluation perspective to the team. You’ll own how we define and measure AI voice quality, bringing together Voice Production’s creative bar, Speak’s technical bar and the wider industry bar. Your goal won’t simply be to determine whether Spotify has the “best” AI voice technology on the market. You’ll help us answer a more important question: is our technology the best at serving Spotify’s specific needs?

 

What You'll Do
  • Own the quality bar for Spotify’s AI voice models, defining what “good enough” means for different products, audiences, languages and use cases.
  • Independently design evaluation rubrics and build an evaluation approach that measures qualities such as naturalness, tone, pacing, pronunciation, accent, audio quality and overall experience.
  • Plan and carry out evaluation campaigns, turning qualitative and quantitative findings into clear recommendations for Voice Production, Speak and product teams.
  • Establish an ongoing evaluation rhythm, including when and how we reassess model quality as our technology and products evolve.
  • Benchmark Spotify’s AI voices against third-party models and competitors to understand where our experiences lead, where they differ and where there are opportunities to improve.
  • Help determine appropriate quality trade-offs as Spotify expands into additional languages and regions, considering the product use case and needs of each market.
  • Partner closely with voice experts, machine learning teams, product partners and vendors to maintain a consistent quality bar across demanding and sometimes competing priorities.
  • Surface the most meaningful gaps in model performance and use evaluation insights to help influence future research and technical priorities.

    • Who You Are
  • You have experience in product quality, evaluation, data curation or a closely related field where human judgment is used to assess model or product performance.
  • You know how to independently define evaluation criteria and turn subjective qualities into clear, repeatable rubrics.
  • You are comfortable designing and running both qualitative and MOS-style evaluations and synthesizing the results into actionable insights.
  • You have an understanding of voice or audio quality, including qualities such as naturalness, pacing, tone, accent and pronunciation, or the ability to develop that expertise quickly.
  • You have strong judgment and can maintain a consistent quality bar while balancing different product requirements, markets and stakeholder perspectives.
  • You are comfortable working autonomously, identifying what needs to be evaluated and establishing the processes and cadence to make that evaluation useful over time.
  • You communicate clearly across creative, technical and product teams and can act as a reliable point of contact for internal partners and external vendors.
  • You are curious about generative AI, speech technology and the evolving AI voice landscape and can translate changes in the industry into meaningful benchmarks for Spotify.

    • Where You'll Be
  • This role is based in London
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
    • Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti databáz a počítačových sietí inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

jobs.title: Dizajnéri a správcovia databáz
jobs.description:
Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards translating complex operational data into actionable insights for business operations stakeholders; ensure models are performant, scalable, and governed.

Build and maintain automated workflows and business applications using Power Automate and Power Apps, reducing manual effort across core operations processes (approvals, data collection, escalation routing).

Own the data layer: write and optimize DAX measures and Power Query transformations; connect to sources including SharePoint, Dataverse, SQL, and Snowflake where applicable.

Collaborate with business operations teams to gather, challenge, and translate requirements into technical solutions — including scope control and managing change requests.

Administer production and distribution of internal financial reports, compile various cross functional reports. Drive the reporting simplification and efficiency.

Prepare, clean, and analyze large datasets from various sources (ERP, operational, and financial systems).

Maintain solution documentation, workspace governance, and RLS (row-level security) configurations in line with organizational data access policies.

Troubleshoot and resolve incidents across the Power Platform environment; support end-user adoption through training and hands-on guidance.

Contribute to the Centre of Excellence (CoE) standards for naming conventions, deployment pipelines, version control, and template reuse across the team.

Work within a GBS or shared-services operating model, balancing multiple stakeholder demands with clear SLA management and transparent prioritization.

Collaborate with senior management and provide update on financial reports, progress and modifications. Explain the variances to senior leadership team.

Support data governance and documentation of data sources, logic, and model results.

Communicate findings and analytical results in a clear and actionable way to non-technical stakeholders.

Keep up to date with emerging trends in AI, machine learning, and Power Platform technologies.

jobs.title: Správcovia objektov
jobs.description:
Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

jobs.title: Správcovia systémov
jobs.description:
Poskytovanie technickej podpory používateľom pri riešení bežných problémov s hardvérom, softvérom a podnikovými aplikáciami. Evidencia, klasifikácia a riešenie používateľských požiadaviek a incidentov prostredníctvom tiketovacieho systému HALO. Inštalácia, konfigurácia a príprava pracovných staníc, notebookov, tlačiarní, mobilných telefónov a ďalších koncových zariadení. Podpora používateľov pri práci s Microsoft 365 a štandardnými kancelárskymi aplikáciami. Správa používateľských účtov, hesiel a prístupových oprávnení podľa interných postupov. Evidencia a aktualizácia inventára IT hardvéru a softvéru. Spolupráca pri nákupe, príprave a vydávaní IT techniky novým zamestnancom. Základná správa tlačového prostredia vrátane riešenia bežných problémov s tlačiarňami a skenermi. Podpora výrobných pracovísk pri riešení základných IT problémov ovplyvňujúcich výrobnú prevádzku. Spolupráca pri aktualizáciách operačných systémov, aplikácií a bezpečnostných nástrojov. Vykonávanie pravidelných kontrol pridelených IT systémov podľa definovaných postupov. Spolupráca pri vedení a aktualizácii IT dokumentácie, interných postupov a prevádzkových záznamov. Eskalácia zložitejších technických problémov na IT špecialistu alebo IT administrátora senior. Dodržiavanie pravidiel informačnej bezpečnosti a podieľanie sa na ochrane firemných dát a IT prostriedkov. Plnenie ďalších úloh v oblasti IT podpory podľa pokynov nadriadeného alebo potrieb spoločnosti.
Výhody:13, 14 mzda po odpracovaní 6 mesiacov, mesačné prémie, príspevok na dochádzanie do práce, kredit na občerstvenie, príspevok na stravu nad rámec zákona.

jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

Príprava, uzatváranie poistných zmlúv životného a neživotného poistenia v príslušnom regióne obchodného miesta. Starostlivosť o zverené klientske portfólio. Systém vzdelávania, odborných školení a tréningov. Flexibilný pracovný čas. Príspevok na DDS III. pilier. Finančné odmeny pri pracovnom a životnom jubileu.
