jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Enterprise Platform
jobs.description:
TL;DR

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help define the future of Lovable Enterprise.

Some of the world's largest companies are already building with Lovable. Now we're building the platform that allows them to deploy Lovable securely, reliably, and on their own terms.

How do you let an enterprise customer deploy Lovable inside their own cloud without slowing product development? How do you build a platform that works seamlessly across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud without compromising security or developer experience? Those are the kinds of problems you'll solve.

You'll define the technical direction for the platform that powers Lovable Enterprise—from cloud architecture and sandboxing to networking, encryption, and identity.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

Why join now?

Very few engineering roles offer this level of ownership. You'll help define a platform rather than inherit one. Many of the hardest architectural decisions haven't been made yet, giving you the opportunity to shape the foundation of Lovable Enterprise alongside engineering leadership.

Whether you've been a Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, founding engineer, or CTO, we're looking for someone who's already operated with this level of ownership—and wants to do it again on an even bigger stage.

What you'll do

You'll define the technical direction for the platform that lets enterprise customers run Lovable securely and at scale.

You'll spend your time writing software, making architecture decisions, mentoring engineers, and working directly with customers on problems that don't have established playbooks. Examples include:

  • Defining the architecture for enterprise deployments across AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, including deployments into customer-controlled environments.

  • Building cloud-agnostic systems that give customers flexibility in how and where they run Lovable.

  • Designing secure sandboxing and runtime environments for running untrusted code at scale.

  • Setting the technical bar for networking, encryption, identity and enterprise infrastructure.

  • Building the internal platform that helps our engineering teams ship faster.

  • Mentoring engineers and raising the engineering bar across the organisation.

  • Working directly with enterprise customers and cloud providers on complex infrastructure challenges.

What we're looking for

We're looking for a Staff-level (or equivalent) Software Engineer with deep platform and infrastructure experience who have set technical direction before. This is a role for engineers who enjoy building software that powers infrastructure, if you’re from a traditional DevOps background this is less likely to be a good fit.

This is the role for you if you have:

  • Strong programming skills in Go or Rust, or a comparable systems language (C++, Java or similar)

  • Experience building enterprise products and working with enterprise customers.

  • Designed and scaled distributed systems in production that are used by multiple teams.

  • Built on Kubernetes (or a similar orchestrator) as a platform, not just deployed to it.

  • Hands-on experience designing and running production systems across more than one major cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), with deep expertise in at least one.

  • A product mindset. You care about the people using the systems you build, not just the systems themselves.

  • Experience operating at Staff, Principal, founding engineer, or CTO-level scope.

And deep experience in some of these:

  • Shipping software into customer-controlled environments (BYOC, VPC, self-hosted, air-gapped).

  • Sandboxing and isolation (containers, microVMs, multi-tenant security).

  • Enterprise identity, networking and encryption (SSO/SCIM, KMS/BYOK, private networking).

Our tech stack

  • Languages: Go, Rust, TypeScript

  • Cloud: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Cloudflare

  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Terraform, Temporal, OpenTelemetry, CI/CD

  • Data: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery

 

About your application

Please submit your application in English—it's our company language.

We encourage anyone excited by the role to apply, even if your current title isn't "Staff Software Engineer." What matters most is the scope you've owned and the impact you've had.

jobs.description:
Research Engineer, Manipulation Data & Teleoperation — Zurich

This role owns the data generation layer of Sereact's VLA stack: teleoperation systems and data collection infrastructure that feed Cortex, built from our Zurich research hub.

About Sereact

Sereact is a Series B embodied-AI company. Cortex, our VLA model, is deployed in live warehouse robotic cells across the EU and US. Zurich is our newest research hub, focused on the manipulation and control problems that sit underneath Cortex.

The role

This is a Research Engineer position. It is scoped to the data generation layer of the VLA stack: teleoperation hardware and software, retargeting pipelines that map human demonstrations onto robot hands, and the data collection infrastructure that feeds Cortex. It requires building the systems that produce the data those models train on, and working closely with the training team on what that data needs to look like.

What you'll do

  • Build and operate teleoperation systems for dexterous manipulation, including retargeting algorithms that map human hand and arm motion onto robot end-effectors

  • Design and maintain scalable, UMI-style data collection hardware and software that other engineers at Sereact rely on

  • Benchmark control and retargeting approaches using rigorous, human-factors-informed methodology

  • Instrument and support the physical robots deployed in the Zurich hub, including day-to-day work on the control stack

  • Work with the model-training team to define what data they need and close the loop on data quality

  • Build tooling or infrastructure outside your immediate brief when it unblocks the wider team

What you'll bring

  • MSc (or equivalent, in progress) in robotics, mechanical engineering, or a closely related field, with a thesis or capstone project on manipulation, teleoperation, or retargeting

  • Hands-on experience building a data collection device or system for robot learning (UMI or a comparable system), not just operating one someone else built

  • Working knowledge of retargeting algorithms for mapping human input onto robot hands or end-effectors

  • 1 to 2 years of combined research, internship, or industry experience in robotics, mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline

  • Software and systems engineering skills strong enough to build and maintain infrastructure other engineers rely on, not only research-grade prototypes

  • Comfortable working as an individual contributor in a small, still-forming team

Nice to have

  • A conference submission on manipulation, teleoperation, or retargeting where the candidate is an author (an MSc thesis submitted to a venue like CoRL counts; supervising a student team whose own work was later published does not)

  • Teaching or TA experience in a robotics course

  • Some exposure to large-model training, even without an independent training record

  • A concrete example of building something outside the formal role brief because the team needed it

Location:

Zurich Area, Switzerland:

  • This role is based in our Zurich office, offering a vibrant ecosystem for robotics and AI.

What We Offer:

  • Free meals at the workplace.

  • Flexible working hours and the option to work from home when needed.

  • Direct collaboration with founders and world-leading AI experts.

  • Access to large-scale compute clusters and proprietary robotic datasets.

  • A key role in shaping the future of embodied AI.

  • Competitive compensation and a relocation package for the Zurich area

jobs.description:
Front is the customer operations platform built for B2B complexity, keeping every team, tool, and customer conversation in sync so companies can scale without losing connection. Others handle simple interactions. Front handles the coordination and context behind complex B2B customer relationships. Over 9,000 companies, including Uber Freight, Navan, and Stripe, rely on Front because it's the only one that can run the operational layer that makes customer-facing work actually succeed.

Backed by Sequoia Capital and Salesforce Ventures, Front has raised $204M from leading venture capital firms and independent investors including top executives at Atlassian, Okta, Qualtrics, Zoom, and PagerDuty. Front has received numerous accolades, including a Certified Great Place to Work in 2026, Top Places to Work by USA Today 2025, Y Combinator's list of Top Companies in 2023, #4 on Fortune’s Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™ ,Inc. Magazine's 2022 Best Workplaces list, and Forbes Best Startup Employers 2022 List.

AI is transforming customer service at a pace the industry hasn’t seen before. Front is at the leading edge of that shift, with more than 9,000 companies worldwide, including CultureAmp, Hootsuite, and Y Combinator, already running their support operations on it.

We’re looking for a Senior Design Engineer to help close the gap between how Front is designed and how Front is built. Front has a mature, complex product surface with more than a decade of UI investment, a rich Figma library, and a large production codebase. This role is for someone who is equally comfortable in Figma and in frontend code, and who wants to turn design systems from static documentation into living, production-quality systems that help product teams move faster.

You’ll own the connective tissue between Design and Engineering: building reusable components, shaping design-system architecture, improving the fidelity between Figma and production, and creating the tooling, patterns, and practices that make high-quality UI easier to ship. You won’t just document the system — you’ll build it, ship it, evolve it, and help teams adopt it.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with high leverage across Product, Design, and Engineering. The right person brings strong frontend engineering judgment, excellent UI craft, deep design-systems experience, and the ability to influence teams without becoming a bottleneck.

What will you be doing?

  • Own and evolve Front’s design system across Figma, Storybook, and production code, helping create a clearer source of truth between design and engineering.

  • Build, refactor, and maintain reusable, accessible, well-documented UI components that product teams can confidently use across Front’s core surfaces.

  • Identify and reduce design/code drift across our existing component libraries, legacy UI patterns, and evolving Figma system.

  • Establish patterns, conventions, and guardrails that improve consistency, accessibility, maintainability, and developer experience.

  • Prototype new interaction patterns and reference implementations in code to help teams align quickly and de-risk complex product decisions.

  • Partner closely with Product Designers, Product Managers, and Engineers to define what “great” looks like for complex workflows, edge cases, and enterprise-grade product experiences.

  • Use AI tools thoughtfully to accelerate prototyping, iteration, production changes, and system maintenance while applying strong judgment to the output.

What skills and experience do you need?

  • 6+ years of experience designing and building production frontend experiences, ideally in complex B2B SaaS, enterprise software, developer tools, or similarly deep product domains.

  • Strong frontend engineering skills with modern web technologies and component-based architecture. You do not need to have used Front’s exact stack, but you should be able to ramp quickly in a large, mature codebase.

  • High UI/UX craft and strong product taste. You can evaluate whether an interface is not only visually polished, but also usable, accessible, flexible, and maintainable.

  • Experience building or maintaining component libraries, Storybook documentation, visual regression workflows, design-token pipelines, Figma workflows/plugins, or similar design-engineering infrastructure.

  • Strong accessibility fundamentals, including semantic HTML, ARIA patterns, keyboard interaction models, focus management, and inclusive component states.

  • Strong communication skills. You can explain technical and design-system decisions clearly to both specialists and non-specialists.

  • A portfolio or body of work showing shipped design-engineering impact: production UI, component systems, prototypes, Storybook examples, design-system documentation, or code-backed product work.

Bonus points

  • Experience working on products with a large existing frontend surface area, multiple product teams, and a mature or evolving design system.

  • Experience in customer support, customer operations, collaboration software, internal tools, developer tools, or other workflow-heavy SaaS products.

  • Experience consolidating fragmented component libraries or aligning Figma libraries with production code.

  • Experience using AI-assisted coding or design tools to accelerate prototyping, refactoring, and product iteration.

What you’ll bring to Front

  • A systems mindset: you see patterns, edge cases, and long-term maintenance costs, not just individual screens.

  • A high craft bar: you care about the last 10% of interaction detail, visual polish, accessibility, and usability.

  • A builder’s bias: you prefer to make ideas real in code, learn from how they behave, and iterate quickly.

  • A collaborative approach: you raise the quality of work around you by making the right path easier for other designers and engineers.

  • Senior-level judgment: you can operate through ambiguity, prioritize high-leverage improvements, and sequence change in a way that teams can actually adopt

Front operates on a hybrid model — we come together in the office each Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday to collaborate and stay connected.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary

  • Equity (we are post-series D & backed by some of the best VCs in the US)

  • Private health insurance, including plan options at no cost to employees

  • Paid parental leave

  • Flexible time off policy

  • Flexibility to work from home Monday and Friday, unless posted as a fully remote role

  • Mental health support with Workplace Options

  • Family planning support with Maven

  • $100 per month Lifestyle Stipend to spend on fitness, health and wellness, and other activities

  • Wellness Days - Fronteers get an additional day off on months with no holidays

  • Winter Break - Our offices are closed from Christmas to New Year's Day!

The Logistics Officer brings senior operational experience and the judgement to run the function independently day-to-day — escalating where needed, but owning the full logistics picture between escalations. The right candidate has seen enough complexity — military goods, DG shipments, ITAR — to handle it confidently and knows when something requires attention from the Lead.

  • Process import documentation, verify HS/CN classification, and coordinate with customs brokers to ensure clean clearance

Outbound Logistics

  • Able to operate the inbound/outbound logistics function independently — making sound daily decisions on customs, DG, and compliance without close supervision

jobs.title: Professionaliseringsmedewerker kleuteronderwijs - Campus Sint-Andries (50-100%)
jobs.description:
Hier gebeurt het. Met meer dan 2000 medewerkers en meer dan 22.000 studenten is Thomas More de grootste hogeschool van Vlaanderen, een warme, internationale en bruisende community met optimale leerkansen voor elk talent. Om onze visie 'met lef toonaangevend' verder te realiseren zijn wij op zoek naar mensen met Lef, Enthousiasme, Focus en Vertrouwen. Geïnspireerd door deze vier waarden bieden wij je een uitdagende job binnen een dynamische onderwijsomgeving waarin vernieuwing en samenwerking cruciaal zijn, en waarin je als TM-ambassadeur bijdraagt aan een aangename werkomgeving voor iedereen.

Inhoud van de opdracht:

In het Expertisecentrum Onderwijs & Leren is een meerjarig (2026-2030) programma ‘Vlaanderen Kennisrijk Kansrijk’ opgestart, een strategisch initiatief dat Vlaamse basisscholen ondersteunt bij de implementatie van kennisrijk en evidence-informed onderwijs en bij de invoering van de nieuwe kennisrijke minimumdoelen. Als professionaliseringsmedewerker kleuteronderwijs:

  • Vertaal je wetenschappelijke inzichten over kennisrijk en evidence-informed onderwijs naar toegankelijke, praktijkgerichte content (blogs, infographics, nieuwsberichten) voor leraren en schoolleiders kleuter- en basisonderwijs.
  • Draag je bij aan de productie van audioreportages met de ondersteuning van het leren van kinderen en de implementatie van de minimumdoelen basisonderwijs als rode draden.
  • Werk je mee aan de ontwikkeling van laagdrempelige online kennisdelingsmodules over kennisrijke curricula en evidence-informed werken.
  • Deel je jouw praktijkexpertise bij de realisatie van andere projectdoelstellingen op maat van het kleuter- en basisonderwijs.

Naast je bijdrage aan de realisatie van “Vlaanderen Kennisrijk Kansrijk”, draag je bij aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe producten en opleidingen rond effectieve didactiek, klasmanagement en/of effectieve curricula gericht op de professionalisering van leraren kleuteronderwijs.

  • Je beschikt over een bachelordiploma kleuteronderwijs, eventueel aangevuld met een masterdiploma pedagogische wetenschappen (onderwijskunde) of (cognitieve) psychologie.
  • Je hebt ruime en actuele praktijkervaring als leraar kleuteronderwijs, of in een nauw verwante functie.
  • Je hebt grondige kennis van en ervaring met evidence-informed onderwijs, kennisrijke curricula, effectieve didactiek en klasmanagement in het kleuteronderwijs.
  • Je hebt sterke schriftelijke en mondelinge communicatievaardigheden: je kan wetenschappelijke inzichten en praktijkervaringen en -voorbeelden vlot vertalen naar toegankelijke, inspirerende content (podcasts, blogs, infographics, kennisdelingsmodules…).
  • Je bent een teamspeler die vlot samenwerkt binnen een heel dynamisch team van praktijkexperten en onderzoekers.
  • Je bent bereid om regelmatig scholen te bezoeken en nauw samen te werken met leraren en schoolteams kleuter- en basisonderwijs.
  • Je werkt gestructureerd, zelfstandig en resultaatgericht. Je kan goed plannen en prioriteren.
  • Ervaring met professionalisering en vorming van leraren is een pluspunt.
  • Je beantwoordt aan het profiel van de Thomas More-medewerker (https://thomasmore.be/nl/hogeschool-met-lefv).

jobs.title: Senior Manager MES / Manufacturing Transformation | m/w/d
jobs.description:
Your mission

You’re a team player, authentic, open, and face challenges with a positive mindset? Then you’re a perfect fit for us! 

  • Take end-to-end ownership of international MES and Manufacturing Transformation programs – from program setup, governance, solution design, and implementation through to rollout, go-live, and stabilization – while keeping scope, roadmap, budget, resources, risks, and dependencies firmly under control.
  • Across complex multi-site programs, you bring together business functions, IT, Quality, sites, vendors, and system integrators, providing clear direction to project teams throughout demanding and critical phases.
  • Functional projects and workstreams covering process optimization and harmonization, solution design, system integration, data flows, and data migration are managed with confidence, while validation activities can also be supported conceptually at both program and project level.
  • With a comprehensive understanding of the relevant functional and technical concepts, you identify dependencies early and work closely with experts to develop and evaluate robust solutions.
  • Particularly during rollout, readiness, and go-live phases, you drive decisions and follow them through, ensure successful delivery, manage escalations, and represent the program confidently towards management, steering committees, and other relevant stakeholders.


Your profile

  • Consulting experience in leading complex international programs and projects within the life sciences or pharmaceutical industry forms the foundation of your expertise.
  • Strong knowledge of MES and Manufacturing IT is complemented by hands-on experience in the implementation, integration, and multi-site rollout of corresponding solutions.
  • Pharmaceutical manufacturing processes and their interfaces with Quality, Automation/OT, ERP/SAP, and other relevant systems are areas in which you are highly confident.
  • A solid understanding of GxP, Computerized Systems Validation, and pharmaceutical Quality processes enables you to translate regulatory requirements effectively into program planning, governance, and delivery.
  • Excellent German and English skills, combined with a willingness to travel internationally, enable you to operate confidently across complex global program environments.


Your start with us

At our company, you’ll find a work environment where initiative, collaboration, and mutual support are truly valued. You can expect exciting projects, a fair salary, plenty of development opportunities, and a flexible working model tailored to your needs.
 
Your journey with us starts with a well-structured onboarding, including two welcome days at our Frankfurt office, a buddy program, and access to internal networks to help you feel at home from day one. We offer full flexibility with flexible working hours, remote work options, and even the chance to work temporarily from abroad.
 
With 30 vacation days plus additional paid leave for special occasions, as well as a time value account for extended breaks like sabbaticals, we ensure you have the space to recharge and balance life and work.
 
Our internal training curriculum, additional learning formats, and tailored development paths support your individual career goals. Regular events, cross-location networks, and our feedback platform miaX create space for exchange, ideas, and collaboration.
 
We support your well-being with a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership and exclusive perks through our Corporate Benefits platform. You can also privately use your company IT equipment, and stay mobile with flexible options like JobRad, a company car, or a BahnCard. And because we value your network, we reward successful referrals with an attractive bonus.
 
We work in a hybrid model: depending on the project requirements, you will work remotely, in one of our offices or directly at the customer's premises.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer AI & Automation (d/m/w)
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

Du entwickelst produktive Softwarelösungen, die Geschäftsprozesse automatisieren, Daten nutzbar machen und Mitarbeitende im Alltag unterstützen. Dabei kombinierst Du fundiertes Software Engineering mit modernen KI-Technologien, um skalierbare Anwendungen mit echtem Mehrwert für unsere Fachbereiche zu entwickeln:

  • Entwicklung produktionsreifer Software-, AI- und Automatisierungslösungen – von der Idee bis zum Go-Live
  • Konzeption und Umsetzung intelligenter Anwendungen, AI-Agenten und Assistenzsysteme auf Basis moderner LLM-Technologien
  • Entwicklung robuster Backend-Services, APIs und Frontends zur Integration interner und externer Systeme
  • Analyse bestehender Geschäftsprozesse sowie Identifikation und Umsetzung sinnvoller Automatisierungs- und Digitalisierungspotenziale gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen
Bei uns arbeitest Du nicht an isolierten Proof-of-Concepts oder reinen Experimenten, sondern an produktiven Anwendungen, die täglich von Mitarbeitenden genutzt werden und einen direkten Beitrag zum Unternehmenserfolg leisten. Der Schwerpunkt dieser Rolle liegt auf professioneller Softwareentwicklung. KI-Technologien sind dabei ein Werkzeug, um innovative und skalierbare Lösungen zu schaffen.


Dein Profil

Das bringst du mit 

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung
  • Sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in Typescript sowie Erfahrung mit modernen Softwarearchitekturen
  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Backend-Services, APIs und der Integration unterschiedlicher Systeme und Datenquellen
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Technologien wie OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, LangGraph oder vergleichbaren Frameworks
  • Fundiertes Verständnis von RAG-Systemen, Embeddings, Vektor-Datenbanken und semantischer Suche
  • Kenntnisse in Git, CI/CD, Testing sowie im Einsatz von Docker und Cloud-Technologien
    Erfahrung im Aufbau produktiver Softwarelösungen über Prototypen und Proof-of-Concepts hinaus
  • Strukturierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise sowie Freude an der Lösung komplexer technischer Herausforderungen
  • Deutsch und Englisch mindestens auf B2-Niveau
Das wäre ein Plus 
  • Erfahrung mit Machine Learning über die Nutzung von LLMs hinaus (z. B. Modelltraining, Klassifikation oder Forecasting)
  • Erfahrung mit Microsoft Copilot Studio oder der Power Platform
  • Erfahrung mit ERP-, CRM-, PIM- oder E-Commerce-Systemen (insbesondere SAP)
  • Erfahrung mit Process Automation und Workflow-Orchestrierung
Das zeichnet dich aus 
  • Du entwickelst gerne Lösungen, die produktiv eingesetzt werden und echten Mehrwert schaffen
  • Du möchtest nicht nur AI-Tools nutzen, sondern intelligente Systeme entwickeln und weiterdenken
  • Du hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und erkennst Potenziale für Automatisierung und Digitalisierung
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung, arbeitest eigenständig und bringst eigene Ideen ein


Das erwartet dich

  • Die Möglichkeit, den Einsatz von KI bei einem internationalen Unternehmen aktiv mitzugestalten
  • Spannende Projekte mit direktem Einfluss auf Unternehmensprozesse und Entscheidungen
  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum, Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Ein motiviertes und erfolgreiches Team, das offen zusammenarbeitet und Wissen teilt
  • Internationale Zusammenarbeit in einem modernen und multikulturellen Umfeld
  • Flache Hierarchien und eine Unternehmenskultur, die Eigeninitiative fördert
  • Moderne Arbeitsumgebung mit flexiblen Hybrid- und Remote-Möglichkeiten
  • Exklusive Vorteile wie Hansefit, Mitarbeiterrabatte, Getränkeversorgung, frisches Obst und Essenszuschuss


Wann es für dich los geht

Die Stelle ist ab sofort zu besetzen. 

Wenn Du gerne Verantwortung übernimmst, nachhaltige Software entwickeln möchtest und AI für Dich ein Werkzeug zur Lösung echter Probleme ist, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung. 

Bitte sende uns Deinen Lebenslauf sowie Links zu GitHub-Projekten, technischen Referenzen oder eigenen Softwareprojekten. Wir möchten sehen, was Du bereits entwickelt hast und wie Du technische Herausforderungen löst.

jobs.title: Tech Talent Acquisition Intern / Apprentice
jobs.description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

Final-year internship or apprenticeship

Interested in recruitment, technology, and what it takes to build great teams?

Join Pigment and work alongside our three-person in-house Tech Talent Acquisition team, helping us attract talent for our Engineering and Product teams. You’ll learn how to identify and engage candidates, build your interviewing skills, and contribute to projects that improve the way we hire.

You’ll start with a strong focus on sourcing, with opportunities to take on more responsibility as you learn. Depending on your interests, you could also contribute to, or take ownership of, a dedicated campus or employer branding project.

What you’ll do

Find and engage tech talent

  • Learn about our Engineering and Product roles and understand hiring needs alongside recruiters and hiring managers.

  • Identify potential candidates through LinkedIn, relevant communities, and other sourcing channels.

  • Write personalised outreach that sparks conversations and helps candidates understand our opportunities.

  • Build and maintain talent pools, keeping candidate information and follow-ups up to date.

  • Track response rates and candidate progression to understand what works and refine your approach.

Develop your recruitment and interviewing skills

  • Shadow recruiters and participate in hiring discussions to learn how we assess candidates.

  • Review applications and help identify relevant profiles using agreed criteria.

  • Depending on your interests and progress, gradually conduct initial interviews with coaching from the team.

  • Help keep candidates informed and supported throughout their recruitment journey.

Contribute to or own projects that interest you

Alongside recruitment, you’ll have the opportunity to support or lead a defined project, with guidance from the team. This could include:

  • Employer branding: help tell the stories of our Engineering and Product teams through employee content, social media, and tech events.

  • Campus program: develop school and university relationships, coordinate student events, and help organise internship and apprenticeship recruitment campaigns.

  • Recruitment improvements: test new sourcing approaches, improve candidate communication, or contribute to our referral programme.

  • AI and recruitment tools: explore practical ways to support research, outreach preparation, and everyday workflows, and share what you learn with the team.

Your project scope will reflect your interests, the team’s priorities, and the duration of your internship or apprenticeship.

Who you are

  • You’re looking for a final-year internship or an apprenticeship as part of your studies.

  • You are fluent in English, both written and spoken, and comfortable communicating in an international environment.

  • Recruitment interests you: you enjoy meeting people, understanding their motivations, and helping them explore opportunities.

  • You’re curious about tech: you want to understand what Engineering and Product teams do and the skills they need.

  • You’re interested in AI: you’re keen to explore new tools and think critically about where they can be useful.

  • You enjoy projects: you like turning ideas into concrete actions and following through.

  • You’re a curious learner: you ask questions, welcome feedback, and take the initiative to explore unfamiliar topics.

  • You work well in a team: you share ideas, communicate openly, and support the people around you.

  • You’re organised, attentive to detail, and interested in using simple data to improve your work.

Previous experience in recruitment, project coordination, or a student organisation is welcome, but no prior tech recruitment experience is required.

What you’ll gain

  • Practical skills in tech sourcing, candidate engagement, and interviewing.

  • Coaching and regular feedback from an experienced Talent Acquisition team.

  • Direct exposure to Engineering and Product hiring needs.

  • The opportunity to take a project from idea to delivery and see the impact of your work.

  • Growing autonomy as you develop your skills and confidence.

jobs.description:
Zakres obowiązków: - zarządzanie i organizacja pracy Działu Utrzymania Ruchu,
- nadzór nad sprawnością techniczną maszyn, urządzeń oraz infrastruktury zakładu,
- zapewnienie ciągłości pracy parku maszynowego wykorzystywanego przy naprawach i modernizacji taboru kolejowego,
- planowanie i nadzorowanie przeglądów, konserwacji, remontów oraz napraw maszyn i urządzeń,
- organizowanie działań prewencyjnego utrzymania ruchu oraz reagowanie na awarie i przestoje produkcyjne,
- nadzór nad urządzeniami technologicznymi i transportowymi, w tym suwnicami, podnośnikami, wózkami widłowymi, sprężarkami oraz innymi urządzeniami wykorzystywanymi na terenie zakładu,
- nadzór nad instalacjami elektrycznymi, energetycznymi, pneumatycznymi, wentylacyjnymi oraz innymi instalacjami technicznymi,
- koordynacja prac związanych z modernizacją i rozbudową infrastruktury technicznej zakładu,
- nadzór nad utrzymaniem w należytym stanie technicznym bocznicy kolejowej, torów, rozjazdów oraz infrastruktury kolejowej,
- koordynowanie przeglądów, napraw i prac utrzymaniowych na bocznicy kolejowej,
- współpraca z działami produkcji, technologii, jakości, BHP, magazynem oraz administracją,
- współpraca z firmami zewnętrznymi, serwisami i podwykonawcami realizującymi prace techniczne,
- planowanie budżetu Działu Utrzymania Ruchu oraz nadzór nad kosztami utrzymania infrastruktury i parku maszynowego,
- planowanie zakupów części zamiennych, materiałów eksploatacyjnych, narzędzi i wyposażenia technicznego,
- analiza przyczyn awarii oraz wdrażanie działań mających na celu ograniczenie przestojów,
- prowadzenie i nadzór nad dokumentacją techniczną, przeglądami oraz naprawami urządzeń,
- nadzór nad terminowością badań, przeglądów i kontroli urządzeń podlegających dozorowi technicznemu,
- zapewnienie przestrzegania przepisów BHP, PPOŻ., ochrony środowiska oraz zasad bezpiecznej eksploatacji maszyn i urządzeń,
- raportowanie stanu technicznego infrastruktury i parku maszynowego oraz realizacji planów utrzymania ruchu.

- wyks

jobs.title: Producer [AI]
jobs.description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does a AI Producer do at WPP Production?

We are looking for an AI Producer to support the delivery of innovative, technology-enabled content and campaigns across multiple channels and formats. This role is ideal for a producer with agency or production-house experience who is curious about emerging AI workflows and excited to help shape the future of creative production.

The AI Producer will manage projects end-to-end while collaborating with creative, strategy, production, motion, CGI, OOH, and technology teams to deliver high-quality work on time and on budget. The role requires a strong understanding of integrated production workflows, emerging AI tools, and the operational and legal considerations involved in modern content creation.

The successful candidate will be highly organised, solutions-oriented, eager to learn, and passionate about production, technology, and creativity.

Key Areas of Responsibility

Communication

  • Act as a key day-to-day contact for clients, agency partners, and internal stakeholders across projects
  • Support communication between creative, production, AI, CGI, motion, and post-production teams
  • Ensure project timelines, deliverables, and priorities are clearly communicated to all stakeholders
  • Maintain awareness of client satisfaction and proactively escalate risks or concerns
  • Help guide conversations around AI-enabled workflows and production efficiencies

Collaboration

  • Work collaboratively with interdisciplinary teams including creatives, strategists, technologists, editors, motion designers, CGI artists, and external vendors
  • Foster strong working relationships across local and global production teams
  • Support and mentor junior team members where appropriate
  • Contribute to a positive, collaborative, and solutions-focused production culture

Process

  • Manage medium- to large-scale integrated production projects from briefing through delivery
  • Support productions across AI-led content creation
  • Coordinate schedules, budgets, approvals, assets, deliverables, and production workflows across multiple projects simultaneously
  • Help evaluate and implement AI tools and workflows within production pipelines
  • Maintain clear documentation including timelines, trackers, meeting notes, status reports, and risk management
  • Ensure projects are delivered on brief, on brand, on time, and on budget

Financial Management

  • Assist with project scoping, budgeting, estimates, and reconciliations
  • Track project costs, vendor management, POs, billing, and financial reporting
  • Partner with production, finance, and operations teams to ensure commercial accuracy and efficiency
  • Support cost-effective production solutions while maintaining creative quality

Legal & Compliance Awareness

  • Maintain a basic understanding of legal, compliance, and usage considerations related to AI-generated content and production workflows
  • Support adherence to licensing, talent usage, rights management, and content governance requirements
  • Ensure production processes align with client, platform, and company compliance standards
  • Escalate legal or compliance concerns to relevant teams when needed

 

Day-to-Day Responsibilities May Include

  • Developing and maintaining project scopes, timelines, and budgets
  • Coordinating with WPP Production's global production network to support integrated campaign launches
  • Managing day-to-day communication with clients, agencies, suppliers, and internal teams
  • Supporting productions involving AI-generated content
  • Liaising with vendors and partners to obtain briefs, schedules, assets, and technical specifications
  • Managing trackers, reporting documents, and workflow systems
  • Assisting with production operations, resourcing, and traffic coordination
  • Supporting safe innovation and experimentation with new production technologies and AI tools

 

Requirements

  • 3–5+ years of production experience within an integrated agency, creative agency, production company, or studio environment
  • Experience working across integrated content production including OOH, CGI, motion, film, digital, and social content
  • Basic understanding of AI tools, AI-assisted creative workflows, and emerging production technologies
  • Strong knowledge of production and post-production processes from brief through final delivery
  • Understanding of asset management, formats, usage rights, and content delivery specifications
  • Awareness of legal and compliance considerations related to production and AI-generated content
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders in fast-paced environments
  • Strong communication, organisation, and problem-solving skills
  • Proven ability to deliver projects on time and within budget
  • Natural problem solver and passion for innovation

#LI-HYBRID

#LI-RH1

 

 

Why work here: 
At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact 
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Data
We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Director
jobs.description:
Life at Plume

At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life's moments better. Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale.

We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We're expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data. 

With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day.

Role Description:
Plume works with Internet Service Providers (ISPs) to run the connected experience inside their
subscribers' homes and small businesses. Our platform sits between their network and the people using
it, managing WiFi performance, security, device visibility, care and the digital services layered on top. We
are used at scale by some of the largest ISPs across North America, Europe, Asia and the Middle East.
The UK and Ireland are mature and concentrated markets. The number of ISPs that matter is small, they
are well known to us, and most already have an established approach to managing the connected home.
Success here depends on building credibility at a senior level, shaping how these organisations think
about the experience they deliver to their subscribers, and then proving that value at scale.
We are looking for someone who is at their best in a small number of large, complex accounts rather
than in a broad prospecting territory.
It is a role with real ownership. You will be the face of Plume in the region, working directly with our
executive team and with senior leaders at some of the best-known ISPs in the market.

Responsibilities:
• A named list of UK and Ireland ISPs, covering both new logos and the growth of existing
deployments into new services, subscriber tiers and lines of business.
• A multi-million-dollar annual quota carried across new business and installed base expansion.
• The full cycle: executive access, discovery, business case, technical validation and POC,
commercial modelling, procurement, contract, and a clean handover into delivery. You stay
accountable through launch.
• The relationship map inside each account. Not a single champion, but the CTO, the Chief Product
or Consumer officer, the owner of customer care and operations, and whoever holds the broadband
P&L.
• A virtual team pulled from solutions engineering, product, delivery, finance, legal and executive
sponsorship. You direct it. You do not wait for it.
• Accurate forecasting. Deals of this size move, and we would rather know early than late.
• A clear read on the market: how ISPs in the region are approaching the connected home, where
their priorities are shifting, and what that means for our roadmap. You are our eyes in the territory.

Qualifications:
This role calls for someone who already understands how ISPs buy. Their decision cycles, stakeholder
structures and commercial models are specific to the industry, and the experience we are looking for
reflects that.
• A track record selling hardware, software, cloud or platform solutions directly to ISPs, with evidence
of recurring or subscription-based commercial models. Your experience should be with ISPs as the
buyer, rather than with a telco's enterprise IT function as one account among many.

Create compelling campaigns, brands and experiences for causes that matter. In this role, you will work closely with account directors, strategists, designers, writers and analysts to ensure that we're delivering innovative, beautiful and flawless work that exceeds the expectations of the organisations we work with. You will bring creative vision and impactful leadership to nonprofits, advocacy campaigns and brands' social impact teams.

We're interested in the originality, honesty and proven success of your concepts and appeals.

The company

Blue State is a purpose-driven agency. We partner with leading causes, brands, and campaigns and create real change. From AARP and Doctors Without Borders to Amnesty International and Oxfam, we transform how brands and causes raise money, influence policy, build platforms, and grow communities of supporters. Led by the most creative and analytical minds from the political, nonprofit, and brand worlds, Blue State is an independent agency in the US and London.

  • Lead and inspire: Working closely with your colleagues, you'll develop a vision for our client's creative success. You'll guide the development and implementation of campaigns, appeals and creative platforms, from initial presentations through final delivery.

  • Group Income Protection (GIP)
  • Group Life Assurance (GLA)
  • Optional holiday travel insurance
  • Pre-tax season ticket loans
  • Cycle to work (up to £2000)
  • Remote work flexibility

We approach in-office working with a hybrid model, with presence in our office required at two days per week.

The team

You'll be a senior member of the London team bringing in new clients and, as a leader, defining and improving the work we're creating. You will also be a part of our global creative director team who meet regularly for creative inspiration.

Some things we're looking for

  1. 6+ years in senior creative role, ideally with hands-on designing experience. At least some of this experience working on fundraising and mobilisation campaigns.
  2. Experience in leading and collaborating with teams of designers, copywriters, strategists and creatives - taking insight that has been shaped and developing compelling, digitally-driven ideas and products.
  3. Strategy-led: able to clearly articulate design or strategy related dilemmas, and offer multiple solutions with a clear link back to the strategy and insights. 
  4. Comfort and passion for creative testing, co-creation with clients and audiences, and constructively consolidating feedback from global stakeholders to improve the work. 
  5. Impeccable presentation skills: able to explain the reasons behind a particular design or creative strategy, and guide clients through difficult decision points. Experience in pitching a strong advantage.
  6. Deep knowledge of persuasion strategies & tools: copywriting, social influence, brand advocacy, fundraising, UX and experience design.
  7. Strong sense of communications and its operating model: how impactful messages are created, journeys constructed and users driven on a journey from awareness to advocacy. 
  8. An area of expertise or passion in the design world (be it fundraising, design, UX, communications or social change) that you can harness and upskill wider team members with as a thought leader within the wider company.
  9. Industry-leading quality of work: you produce inspiring work that stands out, is flawless in execution, and innovative in thought. You are both a doer and a thinker, and your work reflects that.

Skills and experience

Money is DoorDash's organisation responsible for the financial products and infrastructure that enable transactions across DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo. The domain owns how consumers pay, how merchants and couriers are paid, and how money is recorded, reconciled and reported, covering payment processing, payment methods, payouts, invoicing, financial ledgers and regulatory compliance.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to help scale Money Domain. You will lead important engineering wide initiatives across Invoicing Platform, Payment Instruments, amongst others; working with Engineering, Product, Operations, and business leaders to deliver dependable, scalable Money capabilities for the business. Programs will span backend services, partner and merchant integrations, and regulatory / compliance products. You will report into the centralised global Technical Program Management team in Engineering, through a manager based in London. This is a hybrid role based in our London office in Cannon Street.

  • Drive Money Domain's Most Strategic Programs - You will partner closely with Engineering and Product leadership, Strategy & Operations, and cross-functional teams to turn Money Domain's strategy into executable technical programs. 
  • Lead Complex Cross-Organization Execution — Money Domain interacts with capabilities across consumer, merchant, courier, order and enterprise domains, payment processing, payouts, fraud and risk, regulatory compliance, accounting, financial data and platform infrastructure. jobs.title: FP&A Analyst
jobs.description:
📍 Manchester, UK (Hybrid, 2 days WFH) | 💰 £45,000 - £55,000

Street Group is a fast-moving B2B SaaS business, grown in Manchester but on a UK-wide mission to make moving house as easy as buying a car. We're PE-backed and scaling fast with an ambitious growth plan, and we're looking for an FP&A Analyst to help us get there.


As we grow, our revenue streams are becoming more varied by the month. That means more reporting, more complexity, and a finance function that needs to proactively help drive growth.


This is an opportunity to help expand our FP&A function, you won't be slotting into a fixed process. You'll be shaping it while owning the data and supporting the models that feed our board packs and investor reporting.


If you want ownership early, enjoy explaining what the numbers mean as much as producing them, and already use AI to take the manual work out of finance, we think you might do great work here.


Why this role exists now


We're growing quickly, and our finance team is growing with us. As our revenue streams expand, so does the appetite for clear, timely insight from our board and investors. That's where you come in. Join us early, help shape how FP&A works here, and see your work make a real difference from day one.


The role

You'll work closely with our FP&A Lead and the wider finance team, owning the data behind our FP&A outputs and turning it into insight the business can act on.

Day-to-day, that means owning our performance trackers and reporting models, drafting the monthly board and management packs, and supporting VCP performance and reporting. You'll help implement new tools and own the data behind them, build dashboards to track commercial and financial performance, and reconcile data across multiple systems so everything stays accurate and consistent.

You'll also support three-statement modelling and our annual budget and rolling forecast cycles, and pick up ad hoc commercial insight and improvement projects as they come up. Throughout, you'll use Claude to automate routine reporting and modelling, so your time goes on the insight that matters.


Who we're looking for

  • 2-4 years in an FP&A, commercial finance or analytical role, and part-qualified or newly qualified (ACA, ACCA or CIMA).

  • A meticulous and detail-driven individual with a strict commitment to accuracy and precision in all financial modelling and reporting.

  • Experience building driver-based models for budgets and forecasts, and producing management information or board and management packs.

  • A solid understanding of double-entry and comfort with three-statement modelling.

  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including complex formulas and sensitivity and scenario modelling.

  • An AI-native mindset: you already use Claude, Copilot or a similar tool in your finance work, and you would rather simplify and automate a manual process than plough through it.

  • The ability to explain numbers in plain language to non-finance stakeholders.

  • Someone self-motivated and comfortable managing their own workload without close oversight.

  • SaaS, subscription or tech experience is a bonus, not a requirement. Time at a growing, PE-backed business would be particularly interesting to us.

Why you might not want to apply

  • We'd rather be honest up front, because this role won't be for everyone.

  • If you want clearly defined, settled role boundaries , ours are still forming and will keep evolving as we scale.

  • If you'd rather process numbers than own and explain them. This role is about the story behind the figures as much as the figures themselves.

  • If pace, ambiguity and shifting priorities aren't for you. We move quickly, and priorities change as the business grows.

Who are Street Group?

We're an award-winning PropTech business based in Manchester, founded in 2015 by brother and sister duo, Tom & Heather Staff. Most of us have personal experience of how painful moving can be, and Tom and Heather saw an opportunity to change this: utilising technology, as well as our incredibly talented team, to improve the industry for everyone.

Our products, Street.co.uk, Spectre & Cortex, form a powerful trio, working harmoniously together to transform an agent's job. From securing more leads and winning new instructions to streamlining business operations and growing market share, our products are supercharging 1,000s of agencies across the UK.

We recognise that women and people from underrepresented groups often apply for jobs only when they meet every single requirement listed. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria, please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application!

Why join Street Group?

🏠 Hybrid working (2 days WFH)
🏖️ £1,000 holiday after year 1
💪 Culture supporting growth
📚 £500 L&D budget
🎂 Birthday off
🙋 2 paid volunteering days
👶 Enhanced parental pay
🧠 Mental health support (Health Assured)
🕒 Flexible hours
🚂 Season ticket loans
🌷 Paid menopause leave
🌞 Holiday buying scheme
🚀 Ambitious growing business
👩🏿‍💻 Cutting-edge tech
🐶 Office dogs
🍻 Stocked fridge + Friday beers
🎊 Offsites & events
🚴 Cycle to work
🚗 EV salary sacrifice
🌍 Climate-positive


Salary

£45,000 - £55,000, dependent on experience. Sometimes the right person is more or less experienced than we expected. If you think that might be you, please apply and let us know.


We care deeply about helping the tech industry become a more inclusive and diverse place, and we work hard to set an example. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the UK and be able to perform the work specified.


Interview process

3 stages: Screening call with one of our Recruitment Team > Panel interview with our Financial Controller & FP&A Lead> Final interview with our Financial Director.

We want our interviews to be as inclusive as possible, so if you need any adjustments, or there's anything you think we should be aware of during the process, please let us know.


A note on using AI in your application

As a fast moving tech company, we embrace AI and encourage its use throughout our application process. Our goal, though, is to get to know and hire the authentic you: your skills, experience and values. We don't want to hire an AI-generated version of you. AI is a valuable tool, not something that should overshadow you as an individual.


How we use AI in the hiring process

Candidate experience is really important to us, and our Talent team use AI notetakers on interviews so they can focus fully on the conversation with you. All decisions are made by humans, not AI. Let us know if you have any questions.

Compensation: £45K – £55K

Vad roligt att du är intresserad av att jobba hos oss! Då värderar du förmodligen, precis som vi, ett jobb som är viktigt på riktigt. Här på Kalmar kommun arbetar vi tillsammans för att hela tiden göra Kalmar ännu bättre - för alla som lever sina liv här, driver företag eller besöker vår fina kommun.

Socialförvaltningens uppdrag är att främja människors sociala och ekonomiska trygghet, jämlikhet i levnadsvillkor och aktiva deltagande i samhällslivet. Vi arbetar därför processorienterat så att våra brukare får sitt behov av stöd och hjälp tillgodosett med god kvalitet – våra processer hjälper oss att skapa värde för dem vi finns till för.

Välkommen till oss!

1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Vill du arbeta i en verksamhet där tidiga insatser gör verklig skillnad? Är du nyfiken och intresserad att möta människor i viktiga skeden i livet för att göra tidiga insatser som kan förändra en persons framtid? Trivs du med ett kreativt och varierande arbete? Då kan du vara den vi söker!

Hos oss blir du en del av ett engagerat team som består av åtta erfarna socialsekreterare och en chef. Vi värdesätter samarbete, kunskapsutbyte och arbetsglädje. Här finns stor kompetens inom vuxenområdet och en vilja att tillsammans utveckla verksamheten. Vi erbjuder ett omväxlande arbete där du kombinerar myndighetsutövning, samverkan och förebyggande insatser. Vi arbetar tätt ihop i teamet, samarbetar med kollegor i förvaltningen samt samverkar med externa aktörer. De varierande arbetsuppgifterna möjliggör att arbeta tillsammans såväl som självständigt, hemarbete tillämpas därför i viss utsträckning.

Som socialsekreterare i mottagning vuxen är du den första kontakten med vuxna personer och andra aktörer som söker kontakt med socialtjänsten. Vi arbetar med ett tydligt förebyggande perspektiv och strävar efter att ge rätt stöd i rätt tid. Du kommer ha en viktig funktion i att arbeta uppsökande och rådgivande, informera och vägleda individer såväl som allmänheten i frågor knutna till socialtjänstens arbete och till samhällets insatser i övrigt. Huvudsakliga ärenden innefattar ekonomiskt bistånd, skadligt bruk och beroende samt våld i nära relation. Enheten har det huvudsakliga ansvaret gällande myndighetsutövningen kopplat till våld i nära relation.

Vi arbetar processorienterat och tror på människors förmåga att växa och förändras. Därför arbetar vi med individens behov i fokus och med en helhetssyn som hjälper oss att se sambanden bakom varje situation. Som medarbetare kommer du ha möjlighet att påverka. Hos oss förväntas du inte bara bidra i det dagliga arbetet, utan också vara med och utveckla verksamheten. Vi värdesätter engagemang, delaktighet och nya idéer, eftersom vi vet att de bästa resultaten skapas tillsammans.

Du får möjlighet att vara med och påverka förbättringsarbetet av våra arbetssätt och bidra till framtidens socialtjänst.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som har socionomexamen eller motsvarande utbildning och har erfarenhet av handläggning inom exempelvis ekonomiskt bistånd, våld, skadligt bruk och beroende, psykisk funktionsnedsättning eller andra delar inom socialtjänsten. Vi söker dig som har god kunskap om gällande lagstiftning och samhällets olika stödinsatser. Vi ser erfarenhet av utrednings- och bedömningsinstrument som FREDA, SARA eller PATRIARK som värdefullt, liksom kunskap i verksamhetssystemen Lifecare och Cosmic Link.

Du har god förståelse för socialtjänstens uppdrag, är trygg i myndighetsrollen och ser värdet av att arbeta tillsammans med andra för att hitta hållbara lösningar. För att trivas hos oss tycker du om att samarbeta och bygga goda relationer, samtidigt som du känner dig trygg i att självständigt driva dina ärenden framåt. Du är strukturerad och ansvarstagande, har förmåga att prioritera i en varierad arbetsvardag och behåller lugnet även när tempot är högt. Vi tror att du är nyfiken, lösningsfokuserad och ser möjligheter där andra ser hinder.

Hos oss får du arbeta i en verksamhet där samverkan, utveckling och delaktighet är en naturlig del av vardagen. Därför söker vi dig som inte bara vill bidra med din kompetens i det dagliga arbetet, utan också vill vara med och utveckla våra arbetssätt och verksamheten som helhet.

Detta är en arbetsplats för dig som vill kombinera myndighetsutövning med förebyggande arbete, rådgivning och utveckling av framtidens socialtjänst!

Då tjänsteresor förekommer är giltigt B-körkort ett krav för tjänsten.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet:, tillträde: Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.
Arbetstid: Dagtid.

Som tillsvidareanställd i Kalmar kommun kommer du att krigsplaceras på din arbetsplats och förväntas bidra med ditt arbete vid höjd beredskap.

Vissa tjänster inom Kalmar kommun är placerade i säkerhetsklass, vilket innebär att en säkerhetsprövning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen kan komma att genomföras före beslut om anställning.

Du som vill söka jobb hos oss men har skyddade personuppgifter ska inte ansöka via Visma Recruit. Du tar kontakt med chefen som står angiven i annonsen så får du hjälp med din ansökan.

Fondée en 1856, la Banque Internationale à Luxembourg (BIL) est la plus ancienne banque universelle du Grand-Duché. Depuis sa création, elle joue un rôle actif dans les principales phases du développement de l'économie luxembourgeoise. Elle exerce aujourd'hui les métiers de banque de détail, banque privée et banque des entreprises et participe aux marchés de capitaux. Avec plus de 2.000 collaborateurs, la Banque est présente au Luxembourg, en Suisse et en Chine.

Acteur majeur de la place financière luxembourgeoise et signataire des « Principles for Responsible Banking » de l'UNEP FI (United Nations Environment Programme Finance Initiative), la BIL s'engage pour la construction d'une économie durable.

Votre mission :

Vous serez responsable de la prise en charge des demandes clients reçues via les différents canaux de communication.
Vos responsabilités :  
• Vous accompagnez les clients lors de l'Onboarding Digital.
• Vous maîtrisez et promouvez activement les solutions de self-service, et accompagnez les clients dans l'utilisation de BILnet et LuxTrust.
• Vous répondez aux appels des clients, identifiez leurs besoins, traitez leurs objections et transformez chaque contact en opportunité.
• Vous traitez les messages sécurisés envoyés par les clients et intervenez de manière proactive lorsque nécessaire.
• Vous mettez en place et à jour les contrats Multiline, Ebics et E-reporting.
• Vous documentez chaque appel afin d'alimenter la base de données.
• Vous orientez les clients, internes ou externes, vers le département approprié lorsque la résolution immédiate n'est pas possible, et vous signalez les problèmes récurrents afin d'identifier des solutions durables.
• Vous prenez les rendez-vous clients pour les gestionnaires de clientèle.

Vos compétences :

• Diplôme de niveau Bac+3 ou expérience équivalente.
• Esprit d'équipe développé.
• Excellentes capacités relationnelles, de communication et d'écoute.
• Solides compétences informatiques et digitales.
• Bonne capacité d'analyse et forte orientation solution.
• Capacité à identifier et à transformer les opportunités commerciales.
• Autonomie, sens de la persuasion et excellente organisation.
• Maîtrise des outils BILnet, Salesforce, T24 et MS Office.
• Bonne connaissance des produits distribués au sein de la Banque.
• Parfaite maîtrise du français et de l'anglais. La connaissance du luxembourgeois et de toute autre langue constitue un avantage.

La BIL offre une large gamme de projets stimulants et un important choix de carrières. Nous vous aiderons à trouver la voie qui répond le plus à vos compétences et à vos attentes. Votre développement personnel est notre priorité et nous vous encourageons à vous impliquer le plus possible pour que votre expérience soit la meilleure.
La BIL est convaincue que la diversité et l'inclusion contribuent à accroître la performance collective de la Banque. Nous nous engageons à créer une culture inclusive qui encourage le développement individuel de nos employés.

About the company

We are delighted to represent a well-known, well-established asset manager in their search for a Risk Analyst for a 6 months contract. You will provide independent oversight and challenge across financial and non-financial risks, ensuring alignment with the company's global risk framework and local regulatory requirements.

About the role

• Develop, review, and enhance risk policies, procedures, and frameworks in line with regulatory requirements and best practices
• Contribute to governance committees and escalation processes, ensuring clear and effective risk communication
• Ensure alignment with the global FT risk framework and local regulatory expectations
• Define and monitor key risk indicators (KRIs), limits, and risk profiles across asset classes
• Perform in-depth portfolio risk assessments, including for illiquid and private assets
• Review valuation approaches and key assumptions, ensuring robustness and consistency
• Conduct risk analysis using appropriate methodologies (e.g. VaR, stress testing, scenario analysis)
• Provide independent challenge to portfolio management and support investment decision-making
• Identify emerging risks and translate findings into actionable insights
• Design and execute testing of key controls within the risk framework
• Support internal and external audits, ensuring timely and high-quality responses
• Enhance risk models, processes, and reporting capabilities
• Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and improve efficiency
• Support the use of data and visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI) to strengthen risk insights

Profile sought

• Bachelor's degree (or higher) in economics, finance, or a quantitative discipline
• 3-5 years experience in the fund industry in Luxembourg, ideally in a risk management role
• Strong understanding of Luxembourg and EU regulatory frameworks (UCITS, AIFM)
• Solid knowledge of risk management concepts, asset management, and financial markets
• Experience with valuation methodologies and risk models (e.g. DCF, multiples, VaR, stress testing)
• Understanding of private/alternative asset classes (Real Estate, Private Equity, Private Credit)
• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret and communicate complex topics clearly

• Proficiency in English (written and spoken); French is an advantage

Compliance Manager, Vice President
Senningerberg, Luxembourg, Luxembourg

Job Information

Job Description

As part of Compliance, Conduct and Operational Risk (CCOR), you are at the center of keeping JPMorgan Chase strong and resilient. You help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks, and using your expert judgment to solve real-world challenges that impact our company, customers and communities. Our culture is all about thinking outside the box, challenging the status quo and striving to be best-in-class.

As an experienced Compliance Manager in the JP Morgan Asset Management Compliance Team you will support and engage with the business and other control functions across a multitude of areas and locations. You will provide timely solution-oriented advice and other support demonstrating strong business understanding and integrity and will provide thoughtful and well-articulated independent challenge to the business. You will contribute to the preparation and execution of the Compliance Control Plan for the management company, including its branches, and design and deliver relevant training to the organisation. One of your drivers is to seek opportunities for more efficient ways of working, through use of technology or changes to processes. Being part of a team, sharing experience and knowledge and support the development of colleagues, is important for you as is stakeholder management. You will have opportunities to work on regional and global initiatives.

You will report to the Conducting Officer responsible for the Compliance function in Luxembourg.

Job responsibilities

• Provide advice, challenge and guidance on all aspects of our EMEA Funds business (including alternative funds across a broad range of strategies), supporting the business in ensuring applicable regulations are adhered to
• Collaborate with Tech & Cyber CCOR colleagues to identify and mitigate material technology related risks
• Assist the business with the development of procedures and enhancements relating to their control framework
• Keep abreast of regulatory change, industry trends and regulatory focus areas and support the regulatory change management process, including provision of advice to enable business to implement applicable changes and operate in a compliant and controlled manner
• Develop and deliver compliance training to colleagues across the organisation
• Design compliance policies and procedures
• Attend, report and contribute to committees and other governance forums.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

• Strong academic and/or professional qualifications
• Extensive experience in an internal control function role within the financial industry, or from an audit, legal or consultancy firm
• Good working knowledge and understanding of the EU and Luxembourg regulatory framework relevant for a Luxembourg management company with a broad international footprint, with a focus on the framework for alternative investment funds
• Ability to develop strong relationships across all levels of an organisation
• Strong oral and written communication skills (English), especially the ability to articulate complex issues to senior stakeholders
• Ability to consistently deliver high quality work in a fast-paced, dynamic and demanding environment with control focus and attention to detail, combined with ability to prioritize, manage stakeholders and meet tight deadlines.
• Strong analytical skills with an ability to deliver relevant and pragmatic advice

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

• Strong working and regulatory knowledge in investment guidelines and restrictions
• Fluency in other languages – in particular French and/or German
• Willingness to learn and develop new skills
  
About Us

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About the Team

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

Our Compliance teams work globally across all lines of business to advise internal stakeholders on the impact of regulatory requirements and how to balance these with the firm's needs. Their diverse mandate means they also provide input on new business strategies, product lines, policies, training, operational processes, risk mitigation and control.
