jobs.title: Data Scientist - Intern
jobs.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

Data Science Intern - January 2027

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Data Science team, a group of around 70 data professionals working at the heart of Mirakl's platform. Together, you'll be making the most of rich and diverse marketplace data to grow customer revenue, optimize operations, and ensure the safety of users and transactions.

2. Your Impact

  • Analyze and prepare data to ensure quality and relevance for algorithm development, following best practices for exploration and transformation
  • Prototype and iterate on algorithms, testing and refining ideas with the support of your mentor and team
  • Collaborate with Data Engineers to bring your solutions from experimentation to real-world production deployment
  • Build dashboards to showcase the relevance of your work and monitor performance in production
  • Present your findings weekly with the team, contributing to brainstorming sessions and tech watch initiatives

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • Currently enrolled in the final year of a Master's (Bac+5) in Computer Science at an engineering school or university
  • Familiarity with data preparation techniques and feature engineering
  • Understanding of statistics, machine learning, and deep learning algorithms
  • Interest in the industrialization and scaling of data science models beyond experimental work

Skills:

  • Cloud environment awareness (AWS, Google Cloud, or MS Azure)
  • Strong communication and ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams
  • Curiosity, autonomy, and a proactive approach to problem-solving

4. Tech Stack

Python & its data science ecosystem (pandas,sklearn), SQL for data querying and manipulation, TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, Databricks, Spark, AWS (Amazon Redshift, S3), Airflow, Delta Lake, streamlit, pydantic 

5. Languages

  • French – Fluent required
  • English – Professional level required

6. Compensation, Perks & Benefits

Internship stipend: Based on your Master's status

Perks & Benefits:

  • A workplace that supports well-being and balance: breakfasts, fitness and yoga classes, after-work events, game nights
  • Mentoring from senior technical experts and regular feedback to support your growth
  • Immersion in a collaborative, international team passionate about sharing knowledge
  • 2 remote work days per month
  • Access to Works Council discounts (tickets, etc.)
  • Gymlib pass for your well-being
  • Modern offices in the heart of Paris (near the Eiffel Tower)
  • Swile meal vouchers
  • Transportation covered (50% Navigo, bike, etc.)

7. Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.

Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

  1. Manual screening of your CV by a recruiter, followed by an AI-powered screening conversation (10 min) with Emma, Mirakl's AI Talent Ambassador, to explore your background and motivation for the role. You will need to complete this step within 3 days, otherwise we won't be able to move forward with your application.
  2. Interview with your future manager — Pierre Lourdelet, Data Scientist
  3. Interview with a future colleague, using structured STAR-method interviews to ensure transparency and fairness. 
  4. Welcome to Mirakl! 🎉

 

This is an internship position based in Paris, with up to two days of remote work permitted per month.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

  • 50 % de commission immédiate sur le matériel, les logiciels et les paiements générés par le commerçant au cours de son premier mois ;

Vos outils et votre organisation

SumUp fournit une formation initiale, un terminal de démonstration et des supports commerciaux. Un référent de secteur reste disponible pour vous accompagner.

Votre profil

  • Au moins un an d'expérience en prospection à froid, terrain ou téléphonique, au cours des six dernières années ;
  • À l'aise dans une démarche commerciale proactive auprès de professionnels ;
  • Autonome, persévérant(e), fiable et orienté(e) résultats ;
  • Disponible au moins trois jours par semaine ;
  • Numéro SIRET valide au démarrage.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Échange téléphonique avec notre équipe recrutement ;
  2. Entretien avec le ou la référente de votre secteur ;
  3. Décision rapide fondée sur votre expérience et votre motivation.

Envie de développer votre activité avec une rémunération sans plafond et des revenus récurrents potentiels ? Postulez dès maintenant !

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

jobs.title: Pipeline Programs Manager
Staff Engineer, People Technology
Account Executive
jobs.description:
Brukar du läsa omdömen innan du anlitar eller kontaktar ett företag? Du är inte ensam, 9 av 10 personer som är ute efter att engagera ett företag för att lösa ett behov läser omdömen innan de tar kontakt.

Sedan Reco startade har vi alltid strävat efter att kunna hylla företagen som dag ut och dag in gör allt för att jobba öppet och transparent med vad deras kunder tycker. Att lyfta fram de företag som vågar visa den uppriktiga bilden av vad deras kunder tycker – utan att det finns några garantier för den uppriktiga upplevelsen kunden delar i slutändan.

Nu söker vi en ny kollega som vill vara med och bygga upp Sveriges mest trovärdiga källa för kundomdömen!

Vad gör en Account Executive på Reco?

En Account Executive (AE) är ansvarig för att bygga en stark relation till de företag som själva tagit kontakt med Reco för att förstå vad tjänsten går ut på. Det gäller att etablera en kontakt med ansvarig beslutsfattare, förstå hur vi kan hjälpa dem för att sedan pedagogiskt och kärnfullt få dem att uppleva tjänsten kostnadsfritt. AE är ansvarig för att praktiskt upprätta testperioden för att sedan guida och utbilda företaget under de kommande två månaderna. Syftet är att identifiera vilka nyttor företaget upplever som nödvändiga för att efter testperioden utvärdera om företaget vill fortsätta eller avsluta samarbetet. AE mäts på på antalet lyckade test samt andelen företag som sedan konverterar till kommersiella avtal.

Account Executive jobbar i nära samarbete med våra skickliga Försäljningsutveckling Representanter (SDRs) och med understöd från Marknadsteamet. Vi är ett tajt team där vi tillsammans ser till att nå våra mål, men där varje individ ansvarar för sin egen leverans. Vi har ett tydligt fokus på individuell kompetensutveckling för att lyfta teamet och ständigt utveckla bolaget.

Vad söker vi för person?

Du är en person som andra alltid räknar med. De andra vet att du är avgörande när något behöver bli gjort - dels för att du är skicklig på att lyssna och förstå vad det egentligen är som behöver göras och dels för att du snabbt listar ut hur det ska gå till. Du vill bygga din egen karriär inom försäljning och är villig att kämpa hårt, lära dig av de bästa för att bli en av de bästa. Du har hög integritet som person samtidigt som du är mycket angelägen att överträffa kundens förväntan.

Detta får du:

    Möjlighet att påverka ditt lönekuvert - fast månadslön samt prestationsbaserad bonus
    Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter - Fokus på personlig och professionell utveckling
    Löpande coachning och uppföljningssamtal med närmsta chef, varje vecka
    En inspirerande teamkänsla med tydliga mål är viktigt för oss
    Spännande resor som är kopplade till våra övergripande och stimulerande mål

Dina kvalifikationer:

    Du har jobbat minst 3 år med kundrelationer på något sätt
    Minst 1 års erfarenhet av uppsökande försäljning
    Dokumenterat skicklig företagssäljare (B2B)
    Mycket god datorvana, Office- /Google-paketet
    Företagsekonomisk utbildning

Personliga egenskaper som vi tycker är viktiga:

    Självgående med ett stort eget driv
    Gillar att sätta micro-mål och långsiktiga mål
    Du är optimistisk och har hög energinivå
    Hög uthållighet och stark i motgång
    Vilja att lära och att utvecklas
    Strukturerad och planerad
    Kreativ och energisk problemlösare

Reco grundades 2007 och har sedan dess samlat in drygt 1.3 miljoner omdömen om drygt 40.000 företag. Bolaget har huvudkontor på Vasagatan i Stockholm och har ca 20 anställda. Reco växer stadigt med god lönsamhet och planerar att fortsätta att utveckla sin produkt för att öka tillväxten.

Ansökan 

I denna rekrytering samarbetar vi självklart med Talent&Partner. Du är välkommen med Din ansökan snarast då urval och intervjuer kommer att ske löpande. Dina ansökningshandlingar ska innehålla CV och ett personligt brev gärna foto. Skicka din ansökan idag via work@talentpartner.se

Ansökningar behandlas löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

jobs.title: Automotive Painter / Surface Treatment Specialist – ABS1 Oy, Lempäälä
jobs.description:
AUTOMOTIVE PAINTER / SURFACE TREATMENT SPECIALIST – ABS1 OY, LEMPÄÄLÄ

Are you an automotive painter or surface treatment specialist looking for a job where you can work hands-on, learn new skills and develop your expertise?

ABS1 Oy is expanding its production with a new product: fiberglass roof structures for vans. We are now looking for an Automotive Painter / Surface Treatment Specialist to join the team.

You don't need to know everything from day one. If you have a solid foundation in surface treatment and some experience or training in spray painting, you're already off to a good start. Fiberglass lamination will be taught on the job.

WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?

You will be part of the production of a new product and work with a variety of surface treatment tasks, including:

* cleaning and sanding surfaces

* filling and priming

* spray painting

* fiberglass lamination

Fiberglass lamination may be completely new to you – and that's perfectly fine. You will receive proper training and learn the process hands-on.

Quality matters in this role. Attention to detail, careful working and a good eye for the finished result are important, as your work will have a direct impact on the final product.

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

We are looking for a motivated and eager-to-learn professional who wants to develop their skills through practical work.

You have:

* vocational training and a solid foundation in surface treatment

* some experience or training in spray painting

* a careful and precise approach to your work

* a willingness to learn new things

* the ability to handle moderately physical work

Previous experience in fiberglass lamination is not required. What matters most is that you have the basics of surface treatment under control and are motivated to learn something new.

You can work in Finnish or English – English alone is enough for this position.

A WORKPLACE WHERE YOU CAN GROW

At ABS1 Oy, you'll be part of a fair and supportive team where good work is appreciated and rewarded.

This role gives you the opportunity to learn new skills and build your professional expertise. The goal is not simply to find someone for a short-term position, but someone we can build a longer-term working relationship with.

The employment starts as a temporary agency employment through Worknow. If everything goes well, there is an opportunity to transfer to ABS1 Oy's own payroll after six months.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION

Lempäälä, Ideaparkinkatu 11
Monday–Friday, 8:00–16:00, 37.5 hours/week
Salary €2,300–€2,500/month, depending on experience and skills
Start: As soon as the right person is found
Initially employed through Worknow, with the possibility of transferring to ABS1 Oy after 6 months

ABS1 Oy also has another location at Ideaparkinkatu 2. The workplace is easily accessible by public transport, with a bus stop nearby.

The work involves resins and paints, so there may be some fumes in the working environment. Respiratory protection and other appropriate protective equipment are used when necessary.

INTERESTED? SEND US YOUR APPLICATION!

For more information about the position, please contact:

Jenna Vuorinen
040 160 3159
jenna.vuorinen@worknow.fi [jenna.vuorinen@worknow.fi]

WORKNOW OY AS YOUR EMPLOYER

* Fast and smooth recruitment process

* We keep you informed throughout the process

* More comprehensive occupational healthcare than required by law, from the start

* A reliable employer – we do what we promise

Our priority is to help you find a job where you enjoy your work, develop your skills and succeed.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager - 1 Year Maternity Cover, Jutland Denmark
jobs.description:
This position is a one year maternity cover, with an expected start date of 1 November 2026. For the right candidate, the start date can be negotiated, and there is a possibility of extending the position beyond the initial one-year period.

About Teton

Our vision is to be the indispensable AI companion for care staff, transforming patient care, and ultimately operations and delivery across the entire healthcare industry.

Our product is an AI-powered companion for care staff, leveraging proprietary computer vision technology to alleviate the administrative inefficiencies and observational tasks that overburden care professionals, enabling them to provide better patient care.

Through a combination of in-room hardware, AI and desktop and mobile applications, Teton enhances workflow optimization, decision-making, and patient outcomes, creating a seamless healthcare experience for both patients and providers. Our solution provides unprecedented access to real-time data insights, creating a digital twin of patient states and care delivery that empowers healthcare providers with actionable intelligence for optimal decision-making.

Responsibilities:

You will be responsible for the customer journey from the moment the contract is signed through site planning, implementation, onboarding, and expansion. Key responsibilities include:

  • Coordinating the successful installation of Teton’s hardware on-site, working with the technical project manager, customer stakeholders like IT, Estate planning, and care staff to create an excellent customer experience.

  • Develop strong relationships with front-line customers through empathy and your ability to solve problems, which may mean joining a night shift and traveling around in Jutland.

  • Partner with our product and engineering teams to successfully calibrate and troubleshoot.

  • Provide excellent customer service, resolving issues promptly and professionally.

  • Partner with our business development teams to run successful QBRs, identifying and capitalising on expansion opportunities.

  • Contribute to our goal of continually enhancing our product and service based on customer feedback and needs.

Qualifications:

  • Experience as a Customer Success Manager in SaaS or other tech enabled services.

  • You have a background in the care sector, for example in elderly care, or a social science background, for example in anthropology or sociology.

  • You are proactive, passionate, and like to work in a dynamic team.

  • You enjoy visiting customers regularly and are committed to understanding their needs.

  • You are adept at onboarding and training new users.

  • You’re excited about being part of a team that implements solutions and initiates new customer relationships.

  • You’re great at structuring and planning.

  • You are curious and have an outgoing profile with excellent interpersonal skills.

  • You are based in Jutland and are comfortable travelling to customers. Some customer visits may require overnight stays.

  • Must have a valid drivers license.

  • Must speak Danish fluently, and be proficient in English.

What is working at Teton like?

We are a growing team of extremely hard working and talented people. The learning curves are steep and expanding one’s skill set is encouraged. It’s a workplace where you get your hands dirty and learn a lot. If you are looking for the vibe of large corporations, Teton might not be the place for you, but if you like to build products and strive to be the best in your field, we believe that Teton is a place where you will thrive.

We’re looking for a teammate

We are looking for people who believe in our long-term vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship rather than just another 9-5 job.

With us you will have an opportunity to truly make an impact on the world with the outcomes of your work. So, if you are looking for a ride not just a job – jump on board 😊

jobs.title: US Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
US Marketing Lead

Location: United States

Reports to: VP of Marketing

Employment type: Full-time

About Teton

Teton is building the autonomous operating system for care. Our technology gives senior living and care teams greater visibility into resident wellbeing, movement, sleep, and care delivery, helping them respond faster, work more efficiently, and provide more personalized care.

We are growing quickly across the United States and are looking for a US Marketing Lead to own our regional marketing strategy and execution.

The Role

The US Marketing Lead will be the territory owner for Teton’s growth and brand presence in the United States.

You will translate Teton’s global positioning and company priorities into a focused US marketing plan that creates demand, strengthens our reputation, and helps the sales team win. This is a hands-on role for someone who can set the regional strategy, build campaigns, produce sales materials, support events, coordinate PR, and measure what is working.

You will work closely with US Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Events, Growth, and external partners. You will report to the VP of Marketing and serve as the primary marketing partner for the US commercial team.

What You’ll Own

US Marketing Strategy

  • Develop and execute the US marketing plan in alignment with company revenue goals and global marketing priorities.

  • Identify the audiences, markets, partnerships, and channels most likely to drive growth.

  • Adapt Teton’s global campaigns and positioning for the US senior living and care market.

  • Maintain a clear regional campaign calendar, budget, and set of priorities.

  • Bring insights from customers, prospects, competitors, and the market back into the broader marketing organization.

Demand Generation and Campaigns

  • Partner with Growth Lead to build and run integrated campaigns across email, paid media, content, webinars, events, partnerships, and other relevant channels.

  • Create campaigns around Teton’s most important customer problems and product capabilities.

  • Own regional email strategy, segmentation, nurture programs, and campaign follow-up.

  • Work with Growth to improve lead generation, conversion, and account engagement.

  • Develop targeted programs for priority accounts, operator groups, and strategic market segments.

  • Ensure leads are properly captured, routed, followed up on, and measured in HubSpot.

Sales Enablement

  • Serve as the primary marketing partner to the US sales organization.

  • Develop and maintain US-specific sales decks, case studies, one-pagers, proposals, follow-up materials, and campaign assets.

  • Translate product capabilities into clear operational and commercial value for senior living operators.

  • Equip sales with the proof points, customer stories, and market insights needed to move opportunities forward.

  • Support account-based campaigns for strategic prospects and active opportunities.

  • Gather regular feedback from Sales and Customer Success to identify gaps in messaging, content, and enablement.

Events, Webinars, and Partnerships

  • Partner with the Events lead to determine which US conferences, webinars, executive gatherings, and field programs deserve investment.

  • Build pre-event, on-site, and post-event campaigns that generate meetings and measurable pipeline.

  • Support speaker submissions, presentations, sponsorships, customer participation, and event messaging.

  • Develop regional partnerships with associations, media organizations, technology partners, and other industry stakeholders.

  • Ensure events are connected to broader campaigns rather than treated as standalone activities.

Content, Customer Stories, and PR

  • Identify strong US customer stories and work with Customer Success to turn them into case studies, testimonials, videos, and campaign assets.

  • Develop content that reflects the priorities and language of US senior living operators.

  • Work with internal subject-matter experts to produce thought leadership, educational content, reports, and webinars.

  • Coordinate with Teton’s PR partners on announcements, contributed articles, awards, speaking opportunities, and media relationships.

  • Help establish Teton and its leadership as credible voices in the US senior living market.

Product Positioning and Market Intelligence

  • Localize global product positioning for US audiences while maintaining consistency with Teton’s overall narrative.

  • Develop messaging for different US customer segments, buyer roles, and stages of the sales process.

  • Monitor competitors, category trends, customer needs, and changes in the senior living market.

  • Partner with Product Marketing and Product to support launches and communicate new capabilities effectively.

  • Ensure US market feedback is reflected in future campaigns, content, and product messaging.

Measurement and Reporting

  • Define regional goals and report on campaign performance, lead generation, pipeline contribution, event results, and channel effectiveness.

  • Maintain clear dashboards and regular updates for Marketing and US commercial leadership.

  • Use performance data to improve targeting, messaging, campaign investment, and sales follow-up.

  • Establish a consistent process for evaluating what is working, what is not, and where the team should focus next.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you will have:

  • Established a clear and credible US marketing strategy tied to Teton’s commercial goals.

  • Built a consistent campaign engine that generates qualified demand and supports pipeline growth.

  • Improved the quality and consistency of US sales enablement.

  • Created a repeatable approach to US events, webinars, partnerships, and account-based programs.

  • Expanded Teton’s library of US customer proof points and case studies.

  • Increased Teton’s visibility and credibility with senior living operators and industry stakeholders.

  • Created transparent reporting that shows how US marketing contributes to revenue.

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of B2B marketing experience, ideally in healthcare technology, senior living, or enterprise software industry.

  • Experience owning a regional, vertical, or business-unit marketing strategy.

  • A track record of building integrated campaigns that contribute to pipeline and revenue.

  • Strong sales enablement experience and the ability to work closely with enterprise sales teams.

jobs.description:
Unleash AI Innovators, Securely

Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. Why this role?

 

As a Staff Product Manager in Snyk's Agent Security division, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping how modern organizations build and secure AI applications at scale. You'll join a collaborative, forward-thinking team and help drive our mission to embed security into every part of the AI-native development lifecycle. This is a unique opportunity to shape early-stage products from the ground up, operating with the agility of a startup while leveraging the scale of an industry leader.

  • Influence the broader innovation agenda by presenting roadmap and strategy to customers, leadership, and internal stakeholders.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to take new ideas from concept to product-market fit.

What You Bring

  • You have solid experience in technology, with strong experience in a product management role.

  • You bring a strong technical background and the ability to engage deeply with engineering and AI/ML concepts.

  • You are comfortable with high ambiguity and can design frameworks to execute effectively in fast-moving, uncertain environments.

  • You have a proven track record of taking early-stage products from concept to launch within SaaS or developer tooling.

  • You have strong communication and storytelling skills to influence across teams, leadership, and customers.

It’d Be Awesome If You Also…

  • Have hands-on experience in developer security, AI/ML products, or agentic systems.

  • Contribute to open-source or developer communities.

  • Have a background in software engineering or have worked in a startup or internal incubator environment.

  • Love solving complex problems with a collaborative team.

jobs.description:
**Hifix Oy hakee ajoneuvovarustelijaa osaksi kasvavaa tiimiämme!**

Etsimme käytännönläheistä ja oma-aloitteista ajoneuvovarustelijaa, joka nauttii käsillä tekemisestä ja haluaa työskennellä monipuolisten hyötyajoneuvojen varustelutehtävien parissa.

Työtehtäviin kuuluu erilaisten paketti- ja hyötyajoneuvojen varustelua asiakkaiden tarpeiden mukaan. Työ on vaihtelevaa ja sisältää sekä valmiiden tuotteiden asentamista että yksilöllisten ratkaisujen rakentamista.

**Työtehtäviisi kuuluu esimerkiksi:**

- hyötyajoneuvojen varustelu ja kalustaminen

- työkaluhyllyjen, laatikostojen ja muiden säilytysratkaisujen asennukset

- vanerointi ja ajoneuvojen sisätilojen rakentaminen

- kattotelineiden, astinlautojen ja muiden varusteiden asennukset

- lisävalojen ja muiden ajoneuvojen sähkövarusteiden asennukset

- erilaisten rakenteiden valmistus ja sovittaminen ajoneuvoihin

- asiakkaiden tilaamien yksilöllisten varusteluratkaisujen toteuttaminen

- tarvittaessa myös muut ajoneuvojen varusteluun ja asennukseen liittyvät työtehtävät


**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Toivomme sinulta ennen kaikkea hyvää tekemisen meininkiä, huolellisuutta ja oma-aloitteisuutta.

Arvostamme kykyä ratkaista käytännön ongelmia ja halua oppia uusia asioita.

Aikaisempi kokemus ajoneuvojen varustelusta on eduksi, mutta tehtävään voidaan kouluttaa sopiva tekijä, jolla on vahva käytännön osaaminen ja kiinnostus alaan.

**Eduksi katsomme erityisesti**

- kokemuksen hyötyajoneuvojen varustelusta

- puuntyöstötaidot ja kokemuksen vaneritöistä

- laiterakennus- ja metallityötaidot

- ajoneuvosähköjen tuntemuksen

- kokemuksen sähköasennuksista ja 12 V järjestelmistä

- teknisen piirustuksen lukutaidon

- hyvän työkalujen ja koneiden tuntemuksen


**Millainen henkilö sopii meille?**

Olet käytännönläheinen tekijä, joka haluaa nähdä oman työnsä lopputuloksen. Osaat käyttää erilaisia käsityökaluja ja koneita, etkä säikähdä uusia tai haastavia asennustehtäviä.

Meillä arvostetaan erityisesti sitä, että työntekijä pystyy miettimään itse ratkaisuja ja viemään työn alusta loppuun huolellisesti.

**Mitä tarjoamme?**

Hifix Oy:llä pääset tekemään monipuolista ja vaihtelevaa työtä hyötyajoneuvojen varustelun parissa. Työkohteet vaihtelevat ja työssä pääsee toteuttamaan sekä valmiita varustelukokonaisuuksia että asiakkaiden yksilöllisiä ratkaisuja.

Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamista monipuolisesti autojen, rakentamisen, sähköjen ja teknisten ratkaisujen parissa.

**Työsuhde**: vakituinen

**Työpaikka:** Lahti

**Aloitus**: sopimuksen mukaan

**Palkkaus**: sopimuksen mukaan / kokemuksen ja osaamisen perusteella

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro lyhyesti itsestäsi, aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi sekä siitä, millaista käytännön osaamista sinulla on.

jobs.title: Data Engineer Motorit // Gothenburg
jobs.description:
Do you want to help build a modern data platform from the ground up and create data products that will be used for much more than reporting? Together with Oddwork, Motorit is looking for two Data Engineers to join a new data team and help build the foundation for how Motorit and Bilia will work with data, analytics and AI going forward.

About the role

As a Data Engineer, you will be one of the first members of Motorit’s new Data team, working alongside a Lead Data Architect and another Data Engineer to build a modern Snowflake-based data platform from the ground up. We are looking for two Data Engineers with complementary strengths. Your expertise may lean towards Data Engineering & Platform, with a focus on pipelines, automation and CI/CD, or Data Modelling & Data Products, focusing more on modelling, harmonization and data quality. A key part of your role will be turning data from multiple systems into structured, reliable and reusable data products for Customer 360, analytics, AI and digital applications.

Your responsibilities will include:

    

Developing transformations, data models and data flows using SQL, dbt and Snowflake

    

Developing the platform's Silver, Business Rules and Gold layers

    

Harmonizing data and implementing business rules, mappings and reference data

    

Building data products for Customer 360, analytics, AI and digital applications

    

Developing automated tests and ensuring high data quality

    

Contributing to CI/CD, observability, performance and secure handling of PII

We are looking for someone who

Has a broad background in Data Engineering and modern data platforms and wants to use that expertise to build something new. You combine strong technical skills with curiosity about the data and the business behind it, enjoy solving complex problems and are comfortable taking ownership. You value close collaboration and a strong team culture, enjoy sharing knowledge and contributing to solutions together with others.

Experience with Python, dbt Core, Customer 360, master/reference data, GDPR and PII, metadata and lineage, or data products for AI/ML is considered a plus. Experience building a new data platform from an early stage is also highly valuable.

    

Proven hands-on experience with Snowflake

    

At least 3 years of relevant experience in Data Engineering and modern data platforms

    

Strong SQL skills

    

Experience with dbt or a similar transformation framework

    

Experience with data modelling and transforming data from multiple source systems

    

Understanding of data quality, testing and production deployment

    

Experience with Git and modern CI/CD practices

    

University degree within IT, technology or a related field

About Motorit

Motorit is a Swedish IT company developing digital solutions for the automotive industry, working closely with businesses across automotive, service and aftermarket. As part of Bilia, we are around 100 employees with offices in Gothenburg, Solna and Malmö. We develop and manage business-critical systems and digital solutions that support key processes across Bilia. By working closely with the business, the solutions we build have a direct impact on employees, customers and day-to-day operations. As an employee, you are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and have access to a range of benefits, including pension, health and wellness benefits as well as employee offers connected to Bilia. UNION REPRESENTATIVE: For union-related questions, please contact Magnus Kruger, Unionen representative, at unionen.motoritsisjon@motorit.se

jobs.title: Vi söker erfaren personlig assistent i Stockholm
jobs.description:
Prima omsorg i Norden AB är en assistansanordnare som strävar efter att hålla högsta tänkbara kvalitet på utförandet av assistansen. Vår målsättning är alltid högsta möjliga livskvalitet för de assistansanvändare som valt oss som anordnare. Vägen dit är utbildning och handledning. Det är vi övertygade om. Därför kan du som medarbetare hos Prima Omsorg förvänta dig att få mycket nyttig kunskap och kontinuerlig handledning kring dina arbetsuppgifter.

Vår glada och härliga tjej söker nu efter personlig assistent. Dagarna är väldigt varierande i arbetet med henne. Det finns dagar som är mycket lek och skratt och bus men också tillfällen där din roll är att förebygga och hantera frustrationer och problemskapande situationer. Därför är det viktigt att ständigt vara intresserad på hennes mående och vara följsam i olika miljöer. Arbetet ska kännetecknas av att stärka kundens självständighet och självbestämmande.

Den vi söker ska vara engagerad och arbeta med ett öppet sinne. Stor merit om du tidigare arbetat på skola med funktionsvariation, varit pedagog eller arbetat i liknade område. Din bakgrund behöver inte nödvändigtvis vara som personlig assistent utan kanske har du arbetat med personer med autismspektrum i annan typ av verksamhet.

Du ska vara positiv, uppmärksam, ansvarsfull och lekfull. Med ett stort ansvar att styra och planera dagen samt arbeta med tydlighet. Det är otroligt viktigt att skapa en relation och arbeta efter hennes behov och livsstil. Det skapar förtroende och trygghet för henne.  Kunden har ett stort intresse för att åka buss, tunnelbana och båt. Hon har EP och autism så tidigare erfarenhet av det är meriterande.

Du behöver ha följande egenskaper/intressen:
•    Tycka om att leka
•    Tycka om att hitta på saker
•    Kunna behålla lugnet i alla situationer
•    Ha barnasinnet och agera lekfullt
•    Stabil och trygg i dig själv (skinn på näsan)

Är du personen vi söker kommer du vara assistent till en fantastisk tjej med ett stort intresse för skoj och lek. Ett otroligt lärande och utvecklande arbete där möjligheten finns att bli hennes vän. Hon har ett omfattande tillsyns- och omvårdnadsbehov.

Vi söker dig som:
•    Är uppfinningsrik, motiverande och engagerande.
•    Är positiv, lugn, stabil och trygg i dig själv.
•    Har autismspecifik kunskap.
•    Är uppmärksam, tydlig och följsam i ditt arbetssätt.
•    Är ansvarsfull, tålmodig och har stor uthållighet.
•    Har stor förmåga att kontrollera och hantera dina egna känslor.
•    Ska kunna skriva, förstå och prata flytande svenska då daglig skriftlig dokumentation sker

Tjänsten innebär tider över hela dygnet. Dag kväll, natt och helg, tjänsten är på cirka 50-80 procent.

Som anställd hos Prima Omsorg gäller obligatorisk utbildning och pedagogisk handledning.

Innan arbetsstart behöver du uppvisa utdrag ur belastningsregistret, det beställer du här: https://polisen.se/Service/Blanketter/Blanketter-belastningsregistret/blankett-4429-LSS-belastningsregistret/

jobs.title: Teamchef till Securitas Borlänge/Ludvika
jobs.description:
Företagsbeskrivning

Securitas har en viktig roll i samhället och förvaltar ett av Sveriges viktigaste uppdrag - att skydda och hjälpa människor att känna sig trygga. Nu har du chansen att bli en del av Sveriges största säkerhetsföretag.

Som landets största arbetsgivare i vår bransch kan vi erbjuda dig utvecklingsmöjligheter och variation som få andra företag kan. Vi strävar efter ett enhetligt ledarskap med balans mellan förväntningar och förutsättningar. Tillsammans hjälps vi åt att bygga högpresterande och engagerade team genom mångfald och inkludering. Som en nyckelperson hos oss har du möjligheten att skapa en balanserad och positiv kultur där medarbetarna får ta plats och coachas till att prestera på toppen av sin förmåga.

Securitas Sverige krigsplacerar sin personal. Detta innebär i korthet att du som anställd kommer, i händelse av krig, ha kvar din anställning och arbetsledas av Securitas.

Du tar hand om människors säkerhet – Securitas tar hand om dig.

Om rollen

Vi söker nu en engagerad Teamchef till Borlänge/Ludvika som vill leda den dagliga operativa driften och säkerställa hög kvalitet i våra kundleveranser i hela länet.

Som Teamchef har du ett avgörande ansvar för att skapa struktur, stabilitet och ett bra arbetsklimat i den operativa vardagen. Du leder medarbetarna närmast verksamheten, säkerställer att våra åtaganden gentemot kund uppfylls och driver ett tydligt förbättrings- och kvalitetsfokus. Rollen kräver ett närvarande operativt ledarskap och en god förmåga att arbeta systematiskt och effektivt. Du kommer ha personalansvar för stora grupper i en 24/7-verksamhet.

Du kommer bland annat ansvara för;

    Leda och utveckla medarbetare i den dagliga operativa verksamheten
    Säkerställa att våra kundleveranser följer avtal, instruktioner och arbetsmiljökrav
    Genomföra löpande kommunikation, informationsmöten och on-/offboarding
    Vara första kontaktpunkt för medarbetare i operativa frågor
    Samla in kundfeedback och bidra till hög kundnöjdhet i samarbete med övriga funktioner
    Följa upp och säkerställa måluppfyllelse av relevanta KPI:er
    Driva det systematiska arbetsmiljöarbetet
    Bidra till en kultur som präglas av ansvarstagande, engagemang och effektivitet

Placering: Du fördelar dina dagar i veckan mellan våra kontor i Borlänge och Ludvika, så att båda orterna får ungefär samma närvaro av dig över tid.

Arbetstider: I huvudsak kontorstider, men avvikande tider kan förekomma enligt överenskommelse med chef vid ex arbetsplatsträffar och liknande.

Kravspecifikation

Vi söker dig som har;

    Erfarenhet av att utöva fullt personalansvar inklusive arbetsmiljöfrågor, uppföljning och medarbetardialog
    Har god förståelse för operativ drift och kundcentrerad leverans
    Har god administrativ förmåga och arbetar strukturerat med uppföljning av kvalitet, leverans och KPI:er
    Har förmåga att omsätta mål och instruktioner till praktiskt genomförande
    Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att arbeta självständigt och fatta beslut i operativ vardag
    Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning, exempelvis inom ledarskap, ekonomi, teknik, säkerhet eller annan för verksamheten relevant inriktning, eller av arbetsgivaren bedömd motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet
    Erfarenhet av att hantera personalfrågor i samverkan med chef och/eller HR-funktion
    B-körkort

Meriterande;

    Erfarenhet av säkerhetsbranschen eller annan driftintensiv verksamhet med höga krav på efterlevnad
    Erfarenhet av att arbeta i organisationer med tydlig linjestruktur och delegerat ansvar, samt samverkan mellan dessa.
    Vana av att leda team i förändring eller organisationsomställning
    Säkerhets‑ eller branschspecifika utbildningar

Du är en drivande och lösningsorienterad person med ett genuint intresse för människor och utveckling. Du har ett starkt säkerhetsfokus, möter vardagen med ett positivt synsätt och har förmågan att se möjligheter även i utmanande situationer. Att bygga relationer och skapa förtroende faller sig naturligt för dig, och du har en tydlig vilja att bidra till att laget och leveransen fungerar - både internt och externt.

En stor vikt kommer läggas vid personlig lämplighet.

Säkerhetsprövning

Observera att tjänsten är placerad i säkerhetsklass och innebär att du kommer att genomgå en säkerhetsprövning enligt Säkerhetsskyddslag (2018:585). För att utreda och bedöma om du uppfyller kraven för att bli godkänd enligt gällande regelverk kommer det genomföras säkerhetssamtal, bakgrundskontroll och registerkontroll. Bedömningen syftar till att utreda laglydnad, lämplighet, pålitlighet, lojalitet samt eventuella sårbarheter enligt Säkerhetspolisens föreskrifter och vägledningar. Uppgifter som inhämtas kan ex. komma från dig själv, öppna källor eller myndigheter. Vi tillämpar en helhetsbedömning om dig, din livssituation samt ekonomiska förhållanden vid prövning av din lämplighet.

I förekommande fall kan motsvarande kontroll göras av den som du sammanbor med, eller har en liknande relation med.

För att bli aktuell för tjänsten krävs därför (som lägst) att;

    Du/ni inte förekommer i Polismyndighetens olika register, ex misstankeregister, belastningsregister, osv.
    Du/ni har ordnad ekonomi; inte har betalningsanmärkningar, oreglerade skulder, förekommer hos inkassoföretag eller Kronofogden

Ytterligare information

Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringsverktyg. Vi jobbar med löpande urval, så om du är intresserad av tjänsten – skicka din ansökan redan idag!

Har du frågor kring rollen är du välkommen att höra av dig till rekryterande chef: asa.melander@securitas.se eller rekryterare alexandra.rehnberg@securitas.se.

    Tjänsten är en heltidstjänst på dagtid med tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Vi tillämpar 6 mån provanställning.
    Vi arbetar med urvalstester
    Vi kommunicerar i första hand via mail
    Sista ansökningsdag är 27 oktober 2026

För anställning inom Securitas Sverige AB krävs det att du har godkända betyg från första året i gymnasiet i svenska samt blir godkänd av Länsstyrelsen för anställning i auktoriserat bevakningsföretag enligt Lag (1974:191) om bevakningsföretag (den ansökan görs av Securitas). För att utreda och bedöma om du uppfyller kraven för att bli godkänd enligt respektive författning sker en bakgrundskontroll. Bedömningen avser laglydnad, lämplighet, pålitlighet, lojalitet samt eventuella sårbarheter.

Lön och anställningsförhållanden baseras på kollektivavtal mellan arbetsgivarorganisationen Säkerhetsföretagen och Unionen samt Ledarna.

Mer info om Securitas som arbetsgivare och vår rekryteringsprocess hittar du på securitas.se

jobs.title: Ph.D.-scholarship in numerical optimisation of wind assisted propulsion systems
jobs.description:
Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, has a vacancy for PhD Research Fellow in numerical optimisation of wind assisted propulsion systems

Western Norway University of Applied Sciences (Høgskulen på Vestlandet, HVL) has an open Ph.D. position with a project period of 4 years at the Department of Mechanical Engineering and Maritime Studies. The Ph.D. candidate will be part of an interdisciplinary project involving three research groups on energy and environmental technology, on wind, water and waves and on data science. 

Due to the nature of the work to be carried out in the project, the candidate will be a part of the Ph.D.-programme Computer Science: Software Engineering, Sensor Networks and Engineering Computing. (https://www.hvl.no/en/research/phd-programmes/phd-programme-in-computer-science/). The research programme in Computer Science currently includes 20 professors and associate professors, more than 30 PhD and post-doctoral fellows, and a large number of master’s students.

This programme is located at the Faculty of Technology, Environmental and Social Sciences at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences. PhD research fellows receive an annual work expense funding which can be used for conference participation, research visits, and equipment.

Workplace will be at HVL Campus Bergen.


Tasks and areas of responsibility:

Wind Assisted Propulsion Systems (WAPS) are moving from demonstration to commercial scale. Rotor sails and rigid wing sails are currently installed on tankers, bulkers, and Ro-Ro vessels, and a growing number of wind-cargo ships are being purpose-built for sail propulsion. Sails reduce the ship’s onboard energy demand, and with it fuel consumption and emissions.


This PhD project will develop simulation and optimisation methods for modern sail design based on the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) and Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) as part of the optimisation loop. The developed method will be applied to optimise both existing sail technologies and novel concepts depending on ship size, route, and operation in order to determine fuel and emission savings.
 

The project will extend an existing Julia LBM in-house code, with established HPC LBM frameworks as references, benchmarks, and potential building blocks combined with Bayesian optimisation.

As part of the required duties (25% of the position), the candidate will join the team focusing on regional development at the faculty and the department. This might include:


• Promote more externally funded research projects in collaboration between our research environment and the shipping industry.
• Interact with regional, national and international partners, and work to promote cooperation between the department and the surrounding society (e.g., bachelor and master theses).
• Mobilization to promote research-based innovation in the shipping industry in collaboration with our participation in the project FORREGION Vestland.
• Supporting the department in our work related to lifelong learning in the shipping industry, with emphasis on strengthening the portfolio of flexible and decentralized education.


Qualifications (requirements):

•Admission to the PhD programme requires that the applicant holds a master’s degree in computer science or a closely related field, such as a master’s degree in informatics, software engineering, communication systems, engineering computing, scientific computing, or computational engineering.
•Candidates from other natural sciences or engineering disciplines holding a master’s degree with a strong emphasis on ICT and computing, for example mechanical, marine or aerospace engineering, applied mathematics or computational physics, may also qualify for admission to the PhD programme.
•Admission into the programme requires that the applicant has obtained strong grades for both the master’s thesis and the course work of the master’s degree. Specifically, admission into the programme normally requires that the applicant has obtained:
- a grade of B (Norwegian/ECTS scale) or better on the master’s thesis,
- an average grade higher than C (Norwegian/ECTS scale) on the coursework associated with the master’s degree
•Documented programming skills beyond scripting in Julia, or in a language Julia can call (Python, C, C++, Fortran).

The PhD research fellow must enrol in the PhD programme in Computer Science: Software Engineering, Sensor Networks and Engineering Computing at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, and must meet the formal admission requirements for admission into the PhD programme. The position is announced for a period of 4 years with 25% of the 4-year period will be designated to duties such as teaching, development and administrative tasks.

The PhD candidate will be assigned two academic supervisors at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences. An application for enrolment should first be submitted after an appointment is made and the supervisors will help with this procedure. The candidate must be enrolled as a PhD student within 3 months from the start of the employment.


Favoured qualifications (not requirements):

- Master’s thesis in computational fluid dynamics, ideally applied to wings, foils, rotors, or similar configurations.
- Knowledge of and experience with Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) and/or Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD)
- Knowledge of and experience with optimisation methods.

 

Personal abilities:

- Ability to contribute towards a good work environment and in teamwork.

jobs.title: Lead Commissioning Engineer
jobs.description:
Reporting to the Overall Commissioning, Start-Up (CSU) Manager, the Lead Commissioning Engineer will play a key role in supporting all aspects of discipline testing, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up, and plant performance testing. This full-time position requires strong experience in complex industrial projects and extensive knowledge of commissioning processes, exceptional organizational, technical, and leadership skills to ensure successful project completion and handover while managing all aspects of mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, and commissioning activities in accordance with industry standards and project objectives.



Key Responsibilities:

    Project Coordination: Act as the primary interface between multiple project teams, ensuring seamless communication and coordination across all engineering disciplines during the commissioning and start-up phases.
    Support Planning: Assist in the development of detailed plans for testing, pre-commissioning, commissioning, and start-up activities, coordinating with other teams to align project milestones and schedules.
    Technical Oversight: Provide expert guidance across all facets of discipline testing, pre-commissioning, and commissioning, ensuring that all project activities meet industry standards and project requirements.
    Documentation Management: Oversee the preparation, review, and control of documentation related to commissioning activities, including test reports, punch lists, as-built documentation, and procedural manuals.
    Interface Management: Facilitate effective communication between the CSU Manager, project engineering, operations, and construction teams to resolve issues and align objectives for successful project delivery.
    Problem-Solving: Identify and troubleshoot technical and logistical issues that arise during commissioning and start-up, implementing timely solutions to avoid delays and ensure adherence to safety standards.
    Safety and Compliance: Ensure that all project support activities comply with relevant health, safety, and environmental regulations, promoting a strong safety culture and leading by example.
    Performance Testing: Support the coordination and execution of plant performance testing, ensuring that all systems meet specified performance standards and project objectives.
    Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for process optimization, recommending improvements to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of commissioning and start-up activities.
    Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with stakeholders to understand project requirements and provide technical support and expertise, ensuring that all team members are aligned with project goals.

Technical Skills:

    Strong understanding of industrial commissioning processes and interdisciplinary coordination
    Proficiency in project management and interface management tools (e.g., Primavera, MS Project, Monday.com, MS Office)
    Knowledge of risk assessment methodologies and safety management protocols
    Familiarity with Completions Management Applications
    Strong technical writing skills for documentation and report preparation



Qualifications:

    Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Process, or related field). A master’s degree is advantageous.
    10 years of experience in project support and interface management for industrial projects, with a strong background in testing, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up, and plant performance testing.
    Familiarity with large-scale industrial projects, preferably in hydrogen-based or green steel production.
    Strong knowledge of industry standards, best practices, and regulatory requirements for commissioning and start-up processes.
    Excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to addressing technical challenges.
    Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with a proven ability to manage cross-disciplinary interfaces.
    Proficiency in relevant software and project management tools.
    Fluent in English;

jobs.title: Senior Planning Engineer
jobs.description:
Summary

·      Lead the development, integration, and control of the project schedule and planning systems across engineering, procurement, construction, pre‑commissioning, commissioning and start‑up (EPCx/CSU).

·      Provide rigorous schedule analysis, progress measurement, forecasting and reporting to ensure safe, on‑time, on‑budget delivery in accordance with H2GS objectives and HSE requirements.

·      Act as the planning focal point for stakeholders (Client, EPCs, OEMs, construction, CSU, operations), ensuring a single, credible source of schedule truth and timely decision support.

Objectives

·      Own the integrated planning framework that underpins cost, resource, and scope control, and drive proactive schedule risk management and recovery planning.

Key Accountabilities

·      Planning Leadership: Establish and maintain L1–L4/L5 schedules and the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS); define planning standards, calendars, coding structures, and rules of credit.

·      Schedule Development & Control: Build and baseline the overall schedule; maintain logic, float, constraints; manage change control and scenario/what‑if analyses for mitigation and acceleration.

·      Progress Measurement & Reporting: Implement physical % complete, earned value rules, quantity tracking and man‑hour curves; issue weekly and monthly progress reports, critical path and near‑critical analysis, float/contingency consumption.

·      Engineering & Procurement Integration: Monitor engineering deliverables vs IFC needs; align MTO, requisitions, POs and logistics to construction/CSU need‑dates; track vendor schedules and sub‑supplier impacts.

·      Construction & CSU Interface: Synchronise systemisation, subsystem handovers, punch clearance, MC/Pre‑Comm/Comm windows and RFSU milestones; ensure ePTW windows and SIMOPS are reflected in the plan.

·      Primavera System Administration: Act as first‑line admin for Primavera P6: user profiles & privileges; global calendars; EPS/OBS; standard WBS/RBS, project/activity/resource codes; maintain portfolio integrity.

·      Portfolio & Interfaces: Maintain inter‑project links (utilities, power, infrastructure) and alignment of external interfaces; conduct portfolio health checks and integrated impact assessments.

·      Reporting & KPIs: Generate corporate and project KPIs (SPI/CPI, PPC/Last Planner, critical path stability, schedule variance, risk exposure); produce S‑curves, histograms, dashboards (Power BI/MS Excel).

·      Schedule Risk: Perform qualitative and (where applicable) quantitative schedule risk analysis (QSRA/Monte Carlo); develop risk‑response and recovery plans with discipline leads.

·      Governance & Assurance: Lead schedule reviews, readiness gates, and independent planning assurance; ensure compliance with contract requirements and change management processes.

People Leadership: Lead and mentor site planners/schedulers; ensure consistency with standard durations and coding structures; develop local capability.

Qualification & Experience

·      Degree in Engineering or related discipline (B.Sc./B.Eng/M.Sc.). Professional membership preferred.

·      10+ years’ experience planning large industrial EPC/CSU projects (energy, process, metals); hydrogen/green steel experience advantageous.

·      5+ years Primavera P6 (incl. admin), with SAP PS exposure; evidence of integrated planning across Eng/Proc/Constr/CSU.

·      Demonstrated delivery of integrated L3–L5 schedules, portfolio links, and KPI/reporting automation.

·      Evidence of schedule risk analysis (QSRA), recovery planning and claims/time‑impact analysis is desirable.

·      Fluency in English; Swedish is beneficial but not mandatory. Valid right to work in Sweden (or mobility pathway).

jobs.title: Lead Data Architect Motorit // Gothenburg
jobs.description:
Do you want to set the technical direction for a new data platform while staying close to the technology as it is being built? Together with Oddwork, Motorit is looking for a Lead Data Architect to play a central role in its investment in data and AI and shape how Motorit and Bilia work with data going forward.

About the role

As Lead Data Architect, you will be a key member of Motorit’s new Data team, helping build a modern Snowflake-based data platform from the ground up. Your leadership will be technical rather than managerial, meaning the role does not include people management or personnel responsibility. Instead, you will set the technical direction, establish common principles and guide the Data Engineers in architectural and technical decisions. You will stay close to the implementation, working alongside the team to turn architecture into solutions that work in practice. A key part of your role will be creating a common structure for data across multiple systems, ensuring it is harmonized, modelled and quality-assured to support reusable data products across the business.

Your responsibilities will include:  

    

Leading and developing the target architecture for the Snowflake-based data platform

    

Establishing principles for data modelling, data products and Customer 360

    

Defining principles for business rules, mappings and reference data

    

Ensuring sustainable architecture for GDPR, PII, security and access

    

Establishing principles for data contracts, metadata, lineage, data quality and observability

    

Providing technical guidance to the Data Engineers while remaining close to implementation

We believe you have:

Has an extensive background in data architecture and modern data platforms and enjoys combining long-term architecture with practical implementation. You can see the bigger picture, set a clear technical direction and make important technical decisions while remaining close to the team and technology. You value a strong team culture, enjoy sharing knowledge and believe the best solutions are built through close collaboration.

Experience with dbt, DataOps and CI/CD, Customer 360, master/reference data, API and event-driven data sources, or data products for analytics and AI/ML is considered a plus. Experience establishing a new data platform or data organization from an early stage is also highly valuable.

Above all, we are looking for someone who enjoys building, not just designing

    

At least 5 years of relevant experience in data architecture and modern data platforms

    

Preferably with a few years of experience in a technical leadership role.

    

Proven and extensive hands-on experience with Snowflake

    

Strong understanding of data modelling and harmonizing data from multiple source systems

    

Strong SQL skills and knowledge of modern transformation patterns, preferably dbt

    

Experience with data governance, data quality, metadata and lineage

    

Good understanding of information security, GDPR and PII

    

Ability to combine long-term architectural principles with pragmatic technical decisions

    

Ability to communicate complex technical topics with both engineers and business stakeholders

    

University degree within IT, technology or a related field

About Motorit

Motorit is a Swedish IT company developing digital solutions for the automotive industry, working closely with businesses across automotive, service and aftermarket. As part of Bilia, we are around 100 employees with offices in Gothenburg, Solna and Malmö. We develop and manage business-critical systems and digital solutions that support key processes across Bilia. By working closely with the business, the solutions we build have a direct impact on employees, customers and day-to-day operations. jobs.title: Senior Mechanical / Piping Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Mechanical / Piping Engineer with extensive experience in commissioning large-scale plants, including oil and gas facilities, steel plants, and similar industrial environments. The ideal candidate will have a solid background in mechanical engineering and design and a deep understanding of rotating equipment, piping systems, equipment installation, and preservation techniques. This role also requires experience in planning, scheduling, and reporting on commissioning activities in compliance with relevant standards and specifications.

The Mechanical Commissioning Engineer will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure systems are commissioned and handed over for safe and efficient operation. This position requires strong technical knowledge, hands-on experience with mechanical systems and processes, and extensive knowledge and understanding of Commissioning and Completions.

Key Responsibilities:

    Mechanical Systems Commissioning:
    Lead the commissioning of mechanical systems, including rotating equipment (pumps, compressors, turbines), piping systems, furnaces, conveyor systems, HVAC, and other mechanical components for large industrial plants.
    Ensure compliance with relevant standards and specifications during the commissioning process.
    Oversee equipment installation and conduct mechanical testing to ensure proper functionality.
    Input into Engineering and Design:
    Provide technical input into the engineering design process, ensuring commissioning requirements are integrated into design specifications.
    Collaborate with design and engineering teams to resolve design-related issues during the commissioning phase.
    Planning and Scheduling:
    Develop detailed commissioning plans and schedules, coordinating activities with other engineering disciplines and contractors.
    Ensure that all commissioning activities are executed on time and within project budgets.
    Preservation and Equipment Management:
    Oversee the preservation of mechanical & other equipment during construction and pre-commissioning to ensure equipment remains in optimal condition before start-up.
    Implement and monitor preservation strategies to prevent corrosion, contamination, or degradation of equipment.
    Piping Systems:
    Ensure that piping systems are installed and commissioned according to design specifications, including pressure testing and leak detection.
    Conduct inspections and tests to verify that piping installations meet industry standards.
    Reporting and Documentation:
    Prepare and submit commissioning reports, tracking progress, identifying issues, and recommending corrective actions.
    Maintain accurate records of all commissioning activities, test results, and equipment certifications.
    Compliance with Standards:
    Ensure all commissioning activities adhere to relevant industry standards, safety regulations, and project specifications.
    Coordinate with quality assurance and safety teams to ensure all work is performed in compliance with HSE requirements.

Qualifications:

    Education:
    Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
    Experience:
    10+ years of experience in mechanical systems commissioning, with a focus on large industrial plants, oil and gas facilities, and/or steel plants.
    Proven expertise in the installation and commissioning of rotating equipment, piping systems, and mechanical components.
    Experience with project planning, scheduling, and reporting for complex commissioning projects.
    Skills and Expertise:
    Strong knowledge of relevant mechanical standards and specifications.
    Proficiency in the use of mechanical testing tools and methodologies.
    Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.
    Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams and contractors.

Preferred Qualifications:

    Certification in mechanical commissioning or related fields.
    Experience with advanced preservation techniques for large-scale industrial equipment.

Additional Information:

    Willingness to work on-site during commissioning phases and travel to project locations as required.
    Strong leadership and project management skills are highly desirable.

jobs.title: Preservation Lead
jobs.description:
The Preservation Lead is responsible for implementing, maintaining, and managing a preservation system that ensures the integrity and longevity of plant and equipment throughout various stages of construction, operation, and maintenance. This role involves developing, reviewing, and approving preservation procedures and ensuring cleanliness to prevent deterioration, corrosion, and contamination. Additionally, the Preservation Engineer may provide input on preservation ordinances and participate in the planning, programming, and budgeting of preservation projects.

The Preservation Lead collaborates with multiple teams, including construction, commissioning, maintenance, and operations, to ensure that all preservation activities are carried out effectively. This position requires a strong technical background, an understanding of preservation techniques, and the ability to manage preservation-related documentation.

Key Responsibilities:

Preservation System Management:

    Develop, implement, and maintain a comprehensive preservation system to ensure the integrity and protection of plant and equipment.
    Develop & implement comprehensive preservation procedures including information from the OEM's and Technology providers to ensure the integrity and protection of the equipment.
    Ensure that preservation procedures are followed during construction, storage, transportation, and operational phases.
    Monitor and update preservation activities throughout the lifecycle of equipment and plant assets to prevent deterioration, corrosion, or damage.

Technical Review and Procedure Approval:

    Provide technical input for the development and review of preservation and cleanliness procedures.
    Approve preservation methods, materials, and protocols to maintain the safety and operability of equipment.
    Review and recommend preservation standards based on project specifications, manufacturer guidelines, and industry best practices.

Inspection and Documentation:

    Conduct regular inspections to ensure compliance with preservation and cleanliness procedures.
    Maintain accurate records of preservation activities, including inspection reports, test results, and equipment conditions.
    Develop and maintain comprehensive preservation documentation, including preservation manuals and checklists.

Coordination and Collaboration:

    Work closely with project managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to ensure preservation requirements are integrated into project schedules and work plans.
    Coordinate with procurement and logistics teams to ensure that preserved equipment is properly stored and handled during transportation and delivery.
    Provide preservation-related training to staff and contractors as needed.

Historic Preservation Ordinances (if applicable):

    Interpret and implement local historic preservation ordinances and guidelines, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards.
    Participate in surveys, assessments, and planning efforts related to historic preservation projects (if applicable to the role).

Planning and Budgeting:

    Assist in the planning, programming, and budgeting of preservation activities to ensure that preservation objectives are met within the allocated resources.
    Provide input on preservation-related expenditures, including materials, tools, and external services, and ensure cost-effective execution of preservation programs.

Risk Mitigation:

    Identify potential risks related to the degradation of plant and equipment and develop risk mitigation strategies to minimize damage or loss.
    Implement preventive measures and corrective actions to address any issues related to equipment preservation.

Qualifications:

Education:

    Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field or equivalent field experience.

Experience:

    7-10 years of experience in equipment preservation, maintenance, or related fields, preferably within an industrial or plant environment.
    Experience in developing and managing preservation systems for large-scale projects.
    Ability to identify and recommend preservation techniques and materials relative to equipment types

Technical Skills:

    Strong understanding of corrosion prevention techniques, equipment preservation methods, and related industry standards (eg, NACE, ISO).
    Knowledge of equipment storage, maintenance, and cleanliness protocols during various stages of construction, operation, and storage.
    Familiarity with regulatory compliance, including local preservation ordinances and safety standards (if applicable).

Soft Skills:

    Strong communication and collaboration skills.
    Detail-oriented with excellent organizational and record-keeping skills.
    Ability to manage multiple preservation projects simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications:

    Certification in equipment preservation, corrosion prevention, or related disciplines (eg, NACE Certification, API Certification).
    Knowledge of historic preservation practices and ordinances (for projects that involve local historic sites).

Additional Information:

    Willingness to travel to various plant or equipment locations as needed.
    Familiarity with relevant software tools for managing preservation activities (eg, CMMS, project management software).

Salary and Benefits:

Competitive salary commensurate with experience. Benefits include health insurance, retirement plans, and opportunities for professional development.

jobs.title: Commissioning HSE Lead/Manager
jobs.description:
Job Summary: The HSE Commissioning Lead / Manager will report to the Overall Commissioning, Start-Up (CSU) Manager and is responsible for developing and implementing HSEQ standards and procedures to ensure a safe and compliant commissioning process. This full-time role will require extensive experience in HSEQ management through construction, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up, and plant performance testing phases, with an emphasis on HSE in transition, Permit to Work (PTW), and incident prevention.

Key Responsibilities:

    HSE Leadership: Provide strong leadership and guidance on all HSEQ matters during the commissioning and start-up phases, fostering a culture of safety and compliance across the project.
    HSEQ Planning: Develop and implement HSEQ policies, plans, and procedures specific to commissioning and start-up activities, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
    Risk Assessment: Conduct comprehensive risk assessments and hazard identification (HAZID) for all pre-commissioning, commissioning, and start-up activities to minimize risks and prevent incidents.
    Permit to Work (PTW): Oversee the Permit to Work system, ensuring strict adherence and proper training for all personnel involved in commissioning and start-up. Ensure all PTW documentation is accurate and aligned with HSE standards.
    HSE Transition Management: Manage HSE aspects of transition activities from construction to commissioning to start-up, ensuring seamless transitions and compliance with all safety requirements.
    Incident Investigation: Lead or support investigations into any HSE incidents, conducting root cause analysis and developing corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
    Training and Awareness: Deliver HSEQ training, inductions, and safety briefings to personnel involved in commissioning, ensuring a thorough understanding of project-specific HSE requirements and procedures.
    HSEQ Audits and Inspections: Conduct regular HSE audits, inspections, and site visits to identify non-compliance, promote safe practices, and ensure adherence to HSEQ protocols.
    Documentation and Reporting: Maintain detailed records and documentation of all HSEQ activities, including incident reports, audit findings, and training records. Generate regular HSE performance reports for the CSU Manager and project stakeholders.
    Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve HSEQ practices and processes within the commissioning phase, driving the adoption of innovative safety solutions and best practices.

Technical Skills:

    In-depth knowledge of HSEQ standards and regulations for commissioning and start-up
    Proficiency in PTW systems and risk assessment tools, including Bowtie, FMEA, or HAZOP
    Expertise in HSEQ management systems and software, such as Enablon, Intelex, or SAP EHS
    Strong technical writing and reporting skills for HSEQ documentation and incident investigations
    Familiarity with ISO 45001, ISO 14001, and ISO 9001 standards

Preferred Qualifications/Skills:

    Advanced qualifications in HSEQ, Occupational Health and Safety, or a similar field
    Certification in HSEQ (e.g., NEBOSH, IOSH, ISO Lead Auditor)
    Extensive experience in green energy or hydrogen-based projects
    Proficiency in Swedish is advantageous but not essential
    Strong background in safety transition management and incident investigation techniques

Qualifications:

jobs.title: DRI Commissioning Lead
jobs.description:

    Review vendor documentation and procedures
