jobs.title: Mechanical / Piping Commissioning Engineer
jobs.description:
The Lead Mechanical / Piping Commissioning Engineer will report directly to the Overall Commissioning, Start-Up (CSU) Manager and will be responsible for overseeing the commissioning, start-up, and performance testing of mechanical equipment and piping systems. This full-time role will require extensive expertise in mechanical equipment, both static and rotating along with piping systems and a deep understanding of nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management, piping testing, and related commissioning activities, It will also require exceptional organizational, technical, and leadership skills to ensure successful project completion and handover while managing all aspects of mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, and commissioning activities per industry standards and project objectives.

Key Responsibilities:

    Project Leadership: Lead the commissioning and start-up activities for mechanical and piping systems, working closely with multidisciplinary teams to ensure smooth project execution.
    Commissioning Planning: Develop and execute detailed commissioning plans, schedules, and procedures for all mechanical and piping systems, including nitrogen-helium leak testing, pre-commissioning, and start-up activities.
    Technical Oversight: Provide expert guidance on mechanical equipment and piping processes, such as flange management, piping testing, and system performance testing, ensuring adherence to industry standards and project specifications.
    Testing and Inspection: Oversee and conduct testing and inspections of piping systems and mechanical equipment to verify integrity and compliance with safety and quality requirements.
    Documentation: Maintain accurate records and documentation of commissioning activities, including test reports, checklists, punch lists, and as-built drawings.
    Problem Resolution: Identify and troubleshoot issues related to mechanical and piping systems during the commissioning phase, working closely with engineering and operations teams to implement solutions.
    Safety and Compliance: Ensure that all commissioning activities comply with health, safety, and environmental regulations, promoting a strong safety culture across the project.
    Performance Testing: Lead plant performance testing and assist in final handover to the operations team, ensuring all systems meet project performance criteria.
    Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with the CSU Manager, project engineers, and other stakeholders to align commissioning activities with overall project objectives and timelines.
    Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for process optimization and improvements in commissioning practices, contributing to the project's success.



    Technical Skills:

    In-depth knowledge of mechanical systems and piping processes
    Proficiency in nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management, piping integrity testing, and related procedures
    Familiarity with specialized software for piping design and commissioning, such as SmartPlant or Hexagon Piping
    Strong knowledge of relevant standards and regulations (ASME, ANSI, API)
    Excellent project management skills, including scheduling, resource allocation, and budget management.
    Certifications in piping and mechanical systems (eg, API 570, ASME B31.3)



Qualifications:

    Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or similar experience gained in a related field. A master's degree is advantageous as is Project Management experience.
    Minimum 10 years of experience in commissioning mechanical and piping systems, with a strong track record in large industrial projects.
    Expertise in nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management, piping testing, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up, and plant performance testing.
    Familiarity with green hydrogen processes and/or green steel production is a plus.
    Strong knowledge of industry standards and regulatory requirements for mechanical and piping systems.
    Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
    Strong communication and leadership abilities, with the ability to guide and mentor team members.
    Proficiency in relevant commissioning software and tools.
    Fluent in English; proficiency in Swedish is advantageous but not required.

jobs.title: Instrument and Controls Commissioning Lead Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

The Lead Instrument and Controls Commissioning Engineer will be responsible for overseeing the commissioning, start-up, and optimization of all instrumentation and control systems in the Stegra Hydrogen to Green Steel Project. Reporting directly to the Overall CSU Manager, this role requires extensive experience with major control systems, interfacing with various package types, protocols such as Modbus and Profibus, and advanced troubleshooting and tuning capabilities. The ideal candidate will play a critical role in ensuring the plant's instrumentation and control systems are fully operational, tuned, and optimized to support green steel production.

Key Responsibilities:

Commissioning Leadership:

    Lead all commissioning activities related to instrumentation and controls, ensuring compliance with project specifications and quality standards.
    Coordinate with multi-disciplinary teams, including mechanical, electrical, and process engineers, to ensure smooth integration of control systems.

System Interface Management:

    Oversee the configuration and integration of major control systems (eg, DCS, PLC, SCADA) and communication protocols such as Modbus, Profibus, and Ethernet/IP.
    Manage the interfaces with various package types, ensuring compatibility and seamless communication across systems.

Instrumentation Commissioning:

    Oversee commissioning of instrumentation equipment, including calibrations, loop checks, and functionality tests.
    Ensure accuracy in instrument loop tuning to optimize process control and plant operations.

Troubleshooting and Issue Resolution:

    Identify and resolve design and operational issues related to instrumentation, control loops, and process equipment.
    Provide technical support for complex troubleshooting, including root cause analysis and corrective actions.

Process Tuning and Optimization:

    Perform plant and process tuning to ensure optimal performance and efficiency across control systems.
    Lead testing, validation, and performance tuning of plant processes, utilizing advanced automation techniques.

Documentation and Reporting:

    Maintain comprehensive documentation of commissioning activities, test results, and instrument performance tuning.
    Prepare detailed reports for CSU Manager and project stakeholders, summarizing commissioning progress and technical issues.

Safety and Compliance:

    Ensure that all commissioning activities comply with health, safety, and environmental regulations.
    Promote a strong safety culture, implementing best practices and ensuring that all personnel follow established HSE protocols.

Stakeholder Collaboration:

    Liaise with control system vendors, contractors, and internal teams to align commissioning activities with project objectives.
    Provide technical support and guidance to stakeholders, ensuring control system requirements are met throughout commissioning and start-up.

Technical Skills:

    Control Systems Expertise: In-depth knowledge of major control systems (DCS, PLC, SCADA), including configuration, tuning, and troubleshooting.
    Communication Protocols: Extensive experience with communication protocols such as Modbus, Profibus, HART, and Ethernet/IP for system interfacing.
    Instrument Tuning and Calibration: Proficient in tuning instrument loops for temperature, pressure, flow, and level control to optimize process efficiency.
    Troubleshooting and Problem Solving: Advanced troubleshooting skills for resolving design, configuration, and operational issues with instrumentation and controls.
    Project Management: Strong project management skills, including planning, scheduling, and resource allocation for commissioning activities.
    Software Proficiency: Familiarity with relevant control and automation software tools (eg, Honeywell, Siemens, Rockwell, Emerson, Yokogawa systems) and industry-specific tuning software.

Preferred Qualifications:

    Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Instrumentation Engineering, Control Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or extensive industry-related discipline experience. A master's degree is advantageous.
    Professional Certifications: Certification in controls systems or automation engineering (eg, ISA CCST, IEC 61508).
    Experience: At least 10-15 years of experience in commissioning instrumentation and control systems for large industrial projects.
    Green Energy Experience: Experience in hydrogen or green energy projects is highly desirable.
    Language Skills: Fluent in English; proficiency in Swedish is beneficial but not essential.
    Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with standards such as IEC, ISA, ANSI, and other relevant regulations.

jobs.title: Electrical Commissioning Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Electrical Commissioning Engineer with a strong background in both engineering design and the commissioning of low, medium, and high voltage (LV/MV/HV) distribution systems, transformers, switchboards, and steel plant equipment. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in commissioning and start-up activities, as well as the ability to provide technical input into the engineering design process.

The Electrical Commissioning Engineer will play a critical role in ensuring that all electrical systems are commissioned effectively and safely, working closely with design, engineering, and operations teams to meet project objectives. This role requires a degree in Electrical Engineering and 10-15 years of experience in commissioning and start-up activities for industrial facilities.

Key Responsibilities:

    Commissioning of Electrical Systems:
    Oversee the commissioning and start-up of LV/MV/HV distribution systems, transformers, switchboards, and steel plant equipment.
    Develop and execute detailed commissioning plans, procedures, and test scripts for electrical systems.
    Ensure systems are commissioned per design specifications, safety standards, and project schedules.
    Technical Input into Engineering and Design:
    Provide engineering input during the design phase to ensure electrical systems are optimized for commissioning and operational performance.
    Collaborate with design and project teams to review electrical drawings and specifications.
    Identify and resolve design and installation issues that may impact commissioning activities.
    Knowledge and understanding of the applicable Electrical Equipment in Hazardous Areas standards and specifications.
    Testing and Validation:
    Conduct testing, troubleshooting, and validation of electrical systems to confirm operational readiness.
    Perform inspections, functional testing, and system performance assessments to ensure all equipment operates safely and efficiently.
    Document test results and prepare detailed reports for project handover.
    Safety and Compliance:
    Ensure all commissioning activities comply with safety regulations, electrical codes, and industry standards.
    Implement safety protocols during commissioning to mitigate electrical hazards and risks.
    Project Coordination and Documentation:
    Coordinate commissioning activities with other disciplines (mechanical, civil, automation, etc.) to ensure seamless integration of systems.
    Maintain accurate records of commissioning processes, test results, and any modifications or issues encountered.
    Identification of System and Subsystem boundaries, ability to mark up system boundaries on SLD's, Block Diagrams, P&ID's.
    Discrete knowledge and understanding of Completions and the application of completions through Construction through to Operations.

Qualifications:

    Education:
    Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
    Experience:
    10-15 years of experience in electrical commissioning and start-up activities, particularly for LV/MV/HV distribution systems, transformers, switchboards, and industrial equipment.
    Strong design and engineering background, with the ability to review and input into electrical system designs.
    Skills and Expertise:
    Expertise in commissioning and testing of LV/MV/HV electrical distribution systems.
    Familiarity with steel plant equipment, electrical protection systems, transformers, switchboards and equipment interfaces.
    In-depth knowledge of electrical codes, standards, and safety regulations.

Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities during system commissioning.

jobs.title: Completions Lead / Coordinator
jobs.description:
The main role of the Completions Systems Coordinator is to set up, populate, manage and control the Project Completions Management System. The Completions System Coordinator reports directly to the Completions Integration Manager. The Completion Systems Coordinator will ensure that all data required to populate the CMS is strictly controlled and managed. The Completions System Coordinator will be responsible for the preparation of completions status reports and provide input to the project completions and commissioning planning and look ahead. Responsibilities also include the management of punch list reporting, data verification and validation, developing effective system and sub-system breakdown structures, ensuring system backups are done, logged and stored and the management of change requests to commissioning data and information for the project. The Completion System Coordinator will also assist in the update of schedules and reports to effectively monitor commissioning progress and to provide early identification of problem areas. Additional duties include interfacing with the various EPC and sub-contractor completion personnel and commissioning managers to assist with monitoring and tracking the status of the construction handover status, the pre-commissioning and commissioning status and producing a consolidated overview of overall project completion.

The primary accountabilities for the Completions System Engineer are:

    Manage the day-to-day completions data as received from the various inspections and testing records.
    Maintenance and accuracy of information held in the database.
    Internal departmental company focal point for all completion and handover status from MC handover through to handover.
    Ensure that all vendor equipment is tagged per the project numbering system.
    Provide the main interface with the Certifying Authority.
    Produce commissioning status reports including the weekly progress reports
    Develop commissioning status reports as requested by the approved departmental supervisors and managers.
    Provide completion status input to the project control team.
    Input to the planning of commissioning activities in regard to test data requirements.
    Develop and Manage the Mechanical Completion and Commissioning Dossiers
    To assist the CSU discipline engineers and leads in scheduling mechanical completion and identification of commissioning system priorities
    To assist the construction and commissioning engineers with work planning and work priorities
    To monitor and report on the progress of all commissioning activities and assist in the preparation of commissioning progress reports and presentation material
    Assist in OEM/vendor call-off scheduling and managing OEM/vendor-specific commissioning test protocols.
    Take part in internal meetings with the site team and contribute to a common approach to commissioning status and concerns.

Experience Requirements: The Completions System Engineer shall preferably have a discipline background with a minimum of 10 years experience in Major Projects with at least 5 years of which has been spent in a Completions Coordinator role. The Completions Systems Coordinator will be fully conversant with Completions Management software and the technical requirements for system configuration, data population and revision management. Experience in project planning and coordination, handover assurance and verification processes and progress reporting and management is required.

jobs.title: Hydrogen Plant Commissioning Manager
jobs.description:
The Hydrogen Plant Commissioning Manager will oversee the transition from mechanical completion to pre-commissioning activities at a prototype Hydrogen to Green Steel Plant in Boden, Sweden. The successful candidate will ensure all systems are prepared for commissioning, working closely with the Engineering, Procurement, and Construction Management (EPCM) team and addressing any issues that may impact the commissioning schedule or safety requirements. This role is crucial in ensuring the plant meets all performance and safety standards during the commissioning phase.

Mechanical Completion Handover:

    Oversee the handover process from mechanical completion to pre-commissioning, ensuring all systems are fully completed, documented, and signed off according to project specifications.
    Work closely with the construction and EPCM teams to ensure a smooth transition and that all punch list items are addressed before pre-commissioning begins.

Pre-Commissioning Activities:

    Lead and manage the pre-commissioning phase, ensuring all systems (mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, and control) are ready for commissioning.
    Coordinate the commissioning team's activities to verify that all systems are installed correctly and are functioning as per design.
    Ensure the integrity of all hydrogen and related systems before commissioning.

Coordination with EPCM and Other Stakeholders:

    Liaise regularly with the EPCM contractor, the CSU Manager, and other relevant stakeholders to ensure alignment and collaboration throughout the commissioning process.
    Ensure that all systems and subsystems meet the standards required by the project scope and client expectations.
    Provide technical guidance and support to address any issues that arise during the handover and commissioning phases.

Issue Identification and Resolution:

    Proactively identify and resolve issues that may affect the commissioning schedule. This includes technical, operational, and resource-related challenges.
    Escalate any unresolved issues to senior management promptly with recommendations for resolution.

Safety and Regulatory Compliance:

    Prioritize safety in all aspects of the commissioning process. Identify any safety-related issues or concerns, and ensure that all team members and contractors comply with safety protocols.
    Implement and monitor safety procedures in coordination with the HSE team to ensure all hydrogen systems meet both local and international standards.
    Conduct regular safety audits and toolbox talks during the commissioning phase.

Documentation and Reporting:

    Ensure that all necessary documentation (e.g., inspection records, test reports, certifications) is completed, maintained, and submitted for project completion and handover.
    Provide regular updates and progress reports to the CSU Manager and senior stakeholders, highlighting key milestones, risks, and mitigation strategies.

Systems Testing and Performance Verification:

    Ensure all systems undergo pre-commissioning tests (including leak tests, integrity tests, and functional tests) to verify that they meet design specifications.
    Lead the commissioning team in preparing for and executing performance testing, ensuring the hydrogen plant operates safely and efficiently at startup.

Training and Knowledge Transfer:

    Support the CSU team by providing training and guidance to plant operators and technical staff, ensuring they are familiar with operational procedures and safety protocols for hydrogen systems.
    Facilitate knowledge transfer from the commissioning team to the operations team for smooth handover after start-up.

Schedule Management:

    Work closely with the planning and scheduling teams to integrate commissioning activities into the overall project schedule, ensuring alignment with project timelines.
    Identify and mitigate any risks that could impact the successful completion of the project within the agreed timeline.

Education:

    Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical) or a related field. Advanced degrees or certifications in commissioning or project management are a plus.

Experience:

    10+ years of experience in plant commissioning or construction, with a focus on hydrogen, chemical, oil & gas, or other industrial facilities.
    Proven track record of managing the commissioning of large-scale, complex projects, particularly within hydrogen or green energy industries.
    Extensive experience in coordinating with EPCM contractors and managing multidisciplinary teams.

Technical Skills:

    In-depth knowledge of mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, and commissioning procedures, particularly related to hydrogen plants or chemical processing facilities.
    Strong understanding of safety protocols and regulatory compliance related to hydrogen systems.
    Proficiency in the use of commissioning management software and tools.

Soft Skills:

    Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
    Strong problem-solving abilities with a proactive approach to identifying and mitigating project risks.

Ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure while maintaining focus on safety and quality.

    Strong technical knowledge of steel plant systems and operations.

jobs.title: Personlig assistent sökes till ung kvinna
jobs.description:
Vill du ha ett meningsfullt arbete där ditt lugn, din trygghet och din förmåga att skapa struktur gör verklig skillnad?

Vi söker nu kvinnliga personliga assistenter till en 20-årig tjej som bor i egen lägenhet i Skärholmen och har ett omfattande behov av stöd och tillsyn i vardagen.

Arbetet passar dig som är trygg, stabil och ansvarsfull, och som har kunskap och erfarenhet av autism, intellektuell funktionsnedsättning och utagerande beteende. Du behöver kunna behålla lugnet även i utmanande situationer och arbeta förebyggande för att skapa trygghet och minska stress.

Om tjänsten

Kunden har autism i kombination med en medelsvår intellektuell funktionsnedsättning. Hon har inget utvecklat tal och kommunicerar bland annat genom ljud och bilder.

Kunden är mycket känslig för förändringar och nya miljöer. När hon blir stressad eller orolig kan hon reagera kraftigt och visa ett utagerande beteende, inklusive självskadebeteende. Det innebär att du som assistent behöver vara uppmärksam på tidiga signaler, arbeta lågaffektivt och kunna förebygga och avleda situationer innan de eskalerar.

En stor del av arbetet handlar om att skapa en stabil, lugn och förutsägbar vardag.

Du behöver kunna:

·      följa kundens rutiner

·      vara observant på kundens signaler och behov

·      arbeta förebyggande och lågaffektivt

·      avleda och hantera utmanande situationer på ett tryggt och professionellt sätt

·      skapa lugn när omgivningen blir stressande

·      dokumentera och kommunicera viktiga händelser och observationer

·      bidra till kontinuitet och trygghet i kundens vardag.

Arbetstider

Kunden behöver assistans alla dagar i veckan.

·      Måndag: 15.00–22.00 samt 22.00–08.00

·      Tisdag–fredag: 16.00–22.00 samt 22.00–08.00

·      Lördag–söndag: 08.00-19.00 samt 19.00-08.00

Arbetstiderna varierar och omfattar dag, kväll och natt. Under nattpassen förekommer 4 timmars väntetid. Det innebär att du under dessa timmar finns på plats och är beredd att hjälpa till om kunden behöver stöd.



Vi söker dig som

·      är kvinna

·      är trygg, lugn och stabil som person

·      har ett professionellt och respektfullt förhållningssätt

·      har erfarenhet av autism och/eller intellektuell funktionsnedsättning

·      har erfarenhet av eller god förståelse för utagerande beteende och självskadebeteende

·      har kunskap om lågaffektivt bemötande och förebyggande arbete

·      trivs med tydliga rutiner och struktur

·      kan arbeta självständigt och samtidigt samarbeta med andra

·      har god svenska i tal och skrift.

Erfarenhet av arbete med personer med autism på omfattande stöd- och tillsynsnivå är starkt meriterande.

Vi erbjuder

·      Ett meningsfullt och ansvarsfullt arbete där du gör skillnad varje dag

·      Ett nära och engagerat team

·      Tydliga rutiner och arbetssätt

·      Möjlighet att utvecklas inom personlig assistans, autism och utmanande beteende

·      Ett arbete där kontinuitet och relation är mycket viktigt.

Låter detta som en tjänst för dig?

Skicka in din ansökan och berätta gärna om din tidigare erfarenhet av att arbeta med autism, utagerande beteende och personer med omfattande stödbehov.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet, trygghet och förmågan att skapa en stabil och förutsägbar vardag.

We are now looking for a Head of Security who will take overall responsibility for further developing our security capability and ensuring that security is an integral part of how we lead, develop, and operate our business.

This is a unique opportunity to combine strategic leadership, business development, and security management within an organization where security is essential to both business success and our contribution to society.

As a member of the Business Support Management Team, you will play an important role in enabling Ground Combat's continued growth and long-term success.

Your Role

As Head of Security, you will lead and develop the security function within Business Unit Ground Combat. You will have overall responsibility for ensuring a robust security capability that supports the business objectives while fostering a strong security culture and increased risk awareness throughout the organization.

This is a role that combines strategic leadership with operational involvement. You will serve as the business unit's primary advisor on security matters and work closely with Business Unit Management, the Business Area Security organization, and other key stakeholders to translate requirements, regulations, and strategic ambitions into effective practices and concrete actions.

Your key responsibilities will include:

· Leading the development of the Business Unit's security strategy and security capabilities.
· Ensuring that security, risk management, and compliance effectively support business objectives and strategy.
· Acting as a strategic partner to senior management on matters related to risk, security, and organizational resilience.
· Driving the continuous development of processes, governance, and ways of working within the security domain.
· Creating the conditions for a strong security culture characterized by high awareness and clear accountability.
· Leading and coordinating security-related initiatives, transformation efforts, and improvement programs.
· Representing the Business Unit in internal and external security forums, as well as in dialogue with customers, partners, and authorities.
· Overseeing a broad range of security disciplines, including protective security, information security, personnel security, physical security, risk management, incident management, and crisis preparedness.

Your Profile

We are looking for a confident and engaging leader who can create direction, commitment, and results within a complex organization. You are strategic in your thinking while remaining pragmatic and action-oriented when needed.

You build trust through integrity, clarity, and strong collaboration skills, and you thrive in a role where you can influence not only security, but also business performance, culture, and ways of working.

To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

· Several years of experience in senior security, risk management, or related disciplines.
· Proven leadership experience and a track record of driving development and change within complex organizations.
· A strong understanding of how security can be integrated into business governance and operational processes.
· Experience working with strategic initiatives, change management, and continuous improvement.
· The ability to engage stakeholders, build strong relationships, and collaborate effectively across organizational levels.
· Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English.

The position can be based in Karlskoga or Karlstad, depending on your location and preferred point of departure.

This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.

What you will be part of

Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.

Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.

Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations.

jobs.title: Office Manager til Holstedgaard
jobs.description:
Er du struktureret, har et skarpt digitalt overblik, og trives du i en alsidig hverdag med både it-projekter og tæt berøring med organisationens drift? Så er du måske vores nye administrative Office Manager på Holstedgaard.

Holstedgaard er en selvejende institution, et psykiatrisk botilbud med plads til 69 beboer fordelt på flere afdelinger i alderen 18-100 år. Vi har gennem mange år oplevet en positiv vækst og vokset i volumen. I takt med denne udvikling, møder vi også øgede krav til dokumentation, opfølgning og administrative opgaver. For at imødekomme disse krav og løfte vores faglighed endnu mere, opretter vi nu en helt ny administrativ stilling.

På Holstedgaard søger vi en engageret og selvstændig administrativ medarbejder, der kan samle trådene i vores dagligdag. Du vil få en central rolle i organisationen, hvor du sikrer, at vores administrative processer kører smidigt, og at vores digitale systemer altid er opdaterede. Da vi står over for flere spændende it-projekter og administrative udvidelser, leder vi efter en profil, der har stærke it-kompetencer og mod på at kaste sig over nye systemer.

Dine primære opgaver:

  • Systemadministrator på Planner4You: Du bliver vores interne superbruger og administrator på vores dokumentationssystem, hvor du sikrer struktur og datadisciplin.

  • Hjemmeside og ugentligt nyhedsbrev: Du får ansvaret for at opdatere vores hjemmeside, som står over for en større ændring (samt efterfølgende vedligeholdelse). Derudover står du for at udarbejde og udsende vores ugentlige nyhedsbrev i samarbejde med vores socialrådgiver.

  • Implementering af MyMedCards: Du bliver en drivende kraft i implementeringen og udrulningen af MyMedCards i organisationen.

  • Beboerøkonomi: Du er med til at håndtere de administrative opgaver omkring den interne bank, vi har for vores beboere.

  • Tilbudsportalen: Du vil blive oplært i og være med til at varetage dokumentationen i Tilbudsportalen.

  • Rekruttering og HR-support: Du er med til at udarbejder og publicerer vores jobopslag på diverse jobportaler, når vi søger nye kolleger.

  • Kursusstyring og planlægning: Du er med i at bevarer det forkromede overblik over virksomhedens årshjul. Du koordinerer interne og eksterne undervisningsdage, samt møder og er med i at booke eksterne underviser ind.

  • Andre administrative opgaver: Du er med til at udfylder boligkontrakter, lønsedler og andre administrative ad hoc-opgaver.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har solid erfaring med administrative opgaver og trives i en alsidig blæksprutterolle.

  • Er digitalt stærk: Du behøver ikke at kende vores systemer (som Planner4You, MyMedCards eller Tilbudsportalen) på forhånd, men du skal have solide it-kompetencer, der gør dig i stand til at understøtte implementeringen af nye systemer.

  • Har lyst, vilje og interesse for hurtigt at sætte dig ind i nye digitale emner og administrative arbejdsgange.

  • Arbejder struktureret, selvstændigt og formår at bevare overblikket – selv når der er mange bolde i luften.

  • Møder beboere og kolleger med tillid og et smil, også når du er med til at administrerer den interne bank.

  • Kommunikerer fejlfrit på dansk i både skrift og tale.

Hvad vi tilbyder:

  • En spændende og varieret stilling med stor indflydelse på planlægningen af dine egne opgaver.

  • En central rolle i vores digitale udvikling, hvor du præger processerne.

  • En arbejdsplads med en uformel omgangstone og engagerede kolleger.

  • Grundig oplæring i vores systemer, herunder Tilbudsportalen og vores interne bank.

 

Arbejdstid og rammer:

Som udgangspunkt forventer vi, at du arbejder hos os op til 37 timer på hverdage. Du vil i en vis udstrækning være selvtilrettelæggende inden for en fast ramme.

Straffeattest:

Stillingen er omfattet av loven om pligt til at indhente straffeattest. Ansættelsen kan først påbegyndes, når attesten er indhentet.

Ansøgning og kontakt:

Er denne stilling noget for dig, vil vi glæde os til at modtage din ansøgning. Vi afholder ansættelsessamtaler løbende. Hører du ikke fra os, er stillingen gået til anden side. Vi håndterer og sletter alle dine data i overensstemmelse med GDPR.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte:

  • Helle på telefon 21 44 09 53

  • Ann-Sofie på telefon 22 75 77 35

Tiltrædelse: Hurtigst muligt

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Barcelona Varmkundsförsäljning
jobs.description:
Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare till varmkundsförsäljning till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 150 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Vi hjälper många av Sveriges vassaste varumärken i deras försäljning. Under tio års tid har vi byggt upp vår verksamhet och breddat vårt tjänsteutbud för att alltid ligga i framkant. Vårt team består idag av över trehundra drivna och talangfulla medarbetare på våra kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona.

jobs.title: Pædagog, pædagogisk assistent eller pædagogmedhjælper pr. 01/12 - 2026
jobs.description:
Rosendalskolen søger engageret pædagog, pædagogisk assistent eller pædagogmedhjælper pr. 01/12 - 2026 (eller hurtigst muligt)

Brænder du for både det almene SFO-liv og specialpædagogiske indsatser? Så er det måske dig, vi mangler!

Stillingen er en fastansættelse på 30–32 timer om ugen.

Om stillingen og opgaverne

Som vores nye pædagog, pædagogiske assistent eller pædagogmedhjælper får du en varieret og spændende hverdag, hvor du ugentligt er fordelt på to pædagogiske arenaer:

  • SFO: Du bliver en del af et velfungerende team med pædagoger, pædagogmedhjælpere og pædagogstuderende. SFO’en er fysisk opdelt i to afdelinger (0.–1. klasse og 2.–3. klasse) med ca. 235 indmeldte børn. 
  • Afdeling C: Nogle af ugens arbejdsdage er placeret i vores specialafdeling, Afdeling C, hvor du bringer din pædagogiske faglighed i spil i rammer med særligt fokus på struktur, forudsigelighed og mindre børnegrupper.
Vi tilbyder:
  • En stilling på 30–32 timer om ugen.
  • En kreativ og engageret personalegruppe bestående af både pædagoger, pædagogiske assistenter, pædagogmedhjælpere og pædagogstuderende.
  • Et professionelt pædagogisk miljø med højt til loftet.
  • En arbejdsplads med stor grad af ansvar, medbestemmelse og engagerede kolleger.
  • Fantastiske udearealer, der giver vide rammer for pædagogiske aktiviteter.
Vi forventer, at du:
  • Er uddannet pædagog, pædagogisk assistent eller har anden relevant erfaring. 
  • Har blik for individuelle behov: Du har fokus på at skabe trygge rammer for børn med særlige eller individuelle behov (f.eks. ved hjælp af struktur, forudsigelighed og pauser i mindre grupper) – både i SFO'en og i Afdeling C.
  • Er anerkendende og skaber tryghed: Du arbejder ud fra en gensidig anerkendende tilgang til både børn, forældre og kolleger og har en naturlig evne til at skabe nærhed.
  • Du har øje for det, det enkelte barn mestrer, og formår at bygge videre herpå.
  • Kan omsætte idéer til handling: Du kan inspirere til læring i SFO-tiden og har mod på at sætte aktiviteter i gang.

Rosendalskolen ligger i Hobro kun 5 minutter fra motorvejen, og byen har gode togforbindelser både nord og syd på. Skolen har 2 spor og cirka 700 positive og interesserede elever. Personalemæssigt er vi omkring 100 medarbejdere på skolen – lærere, pædagoger, pædagogmedhjælpere, teknisk service, administration, flexjobbere og ledelse. Vi er organiseret i afdelings- og årgangsteams, og der er en udvidet grad af selvstyring i afdelingerne. Hver afdeling har egen afdelingsleder.

Skolen har i de senere år fokuseret på udviklingen af de faglige fællesskaber. Vi har udviklet vores pædagogiske værktøjskasse i anvendelsen af bl.a. vejledere og klassekonferencer for at understøtte den enkelte elevs læring og udvikling. Yderligere har vi fokus på udvikling af professionelle læringsfællesskaber, hvor en konkret undersøgelse af egen og andres praksis skal være basis for videreudviklingen af skolen.

Skolen er i dagligdagen kendetegnet ved rigtig gode faglige og trivselsmæssige resultater, dette bl.a. via et godt og inspirerende samarbejde mellem personalet, forældrene og eleverne.

Yderligere oplysninger:

For yderligere oplysninger eller aftale om besøg, er du velkommen til at kontakte SFO-leder Simon Bach Pedersen på tlf.nr.: 20323724


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår
Ansættelse sker på overenskomstmæssige vilkår, hvor lønnen aftales med den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.  

Der indhentes straffe- og børneattest, og ansættelsen er betinget af, at disse kan godkendes.  

For at være ansat i Mariagerfjord Kommune skal du have MitID.

Kan du se dig selv hos os?
Så send din ansøgning til Mariagerfjord Kommune via vores hjemmeside.

Stillingen ønskes besat pr. 01/12 2026

Der er ansøgningsfrist til stillingen 25/10 2026

Vi forventer at holde samtaler i uge 44

Om Mariagerfjord Kommune
Mariagerfjord Kommune er en af Danmarks smukkeste kommuner med en unik og varieret natur ved skov, strand og fjord. Vi ligger centralt mellem Aalborg og Aarhus og er på den måde et bindeled mellem Nordjylland og resten af landet. Vores mål er klart: Vi vil mere, og der er plads til flere. Derfor har vi fokus på at skabe de bedste rammer for vores cirka 42.000 borgere, for vores erhvervsliv og for udviklingen af kommunen. 

I Mariagerfjord Kommune ønsker vi, at alle vores 3.400 medarbejdere oplever sig som en vigtig del af fællesskabet. Vi har frihed til at bringe vores kompetencer og ideer i spil, så vi løser kerneopgaven bedst muligt og gør en forskel for vores borgere. Vi har fokus på psykologisk tryghed og viser respekt for hinandens forskelligheder. Alle tager vi et medansvar for fællesskabet og opgaven, og derfor lægger vi også stor vægt på et velfungerende samarbejde i MED-organisationen.   

Vi ser mangfoldighed som en styrke og opfordrer derfor alle interesserede ansøgere til at søge job hos os, uanset personlig baggrund.

jobs.title: Marine Storekeeper
jobs.description:
At Excelerate Energy, we are committed to being the global leader in FSRUs and downstream LNG infrastructure. Our aim is to leverage our unrivaled experience to help customers across the globe unlock access to abundant LNG supply. With the largest fleet in the industry, boasting 11 FSRUs, including a state-of-the-art newbuild expected to be delivered in 2026, we are revolutionizing how the world accesses clean, cost-effective, and reliable energy.

**JOB PURPOSE**

A Marine Store Keeper is an organized, experienced individual who is responsible for all stock management, storage location condition monitoring and improvement.

A storekeeper must be able to multitask and perform under pressure while remaining professional with customers. A Storekeeper is able to manage stock by keeping a record of purchases and ordering the required replacement for spare parts and important items that are required by the different departments on board the Vessel.

**ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES including HSE Requirements:**

1\. The Storekeeper needs ensure that the EE Policies, Procedures and Processes are implemented, enforced and, when applicable, developed, and improved.

2\. Maintain day to day relations with the internal clients (HODs) on Supply Chain related topics.

3\. Review and monitor performance against inventory procedures and strategies to improve performance and effectiveness on the warehouse and inventory location for EE with direct communication to our office staff (Houston HQ)

4\. Provide monthly KPIs including but not limited to:

- Inventory counts

- POs received on board vessels - Inbound Cargo Manifests (MRR)

- Reverse Logistics implementation (Outgoing cargo manifests (MTL) and Manifest for Exportation (MFE)

- New Equipment, Spares, or consumables requests preparation (NSCR) for office generation in the system.


5\. Perform Material Requisitions receptions in a timely manner.

6\. Assist the logistic and procurement dept. to follow up on the OS&D process (Overage, shortage, or Damage).

7\. Keep Chief Engineer fully updated on spare parts and consumable status.

8\. Control and order spare parts and consumables for all Departments (Replenishment Plan)

9\. Follow up, receiving, delivery of spare parts and stores, inspection & storing.

10\. Control, registration and updating data on regular basis in NSE Stock control program.

11\. Maintain current files for Open and Closed Requisitions, Purchase Order, Packing List and Invoices. Over, Short and Damaged OSD, Return to stock.

12\. Daily issues slip form monitoring and proper follow up.

13\. Adequate protection of all parts and tools in storerooms.

14\. Ensures that borrowed tools and instruments are properly returned in good condition and keep tracking report up to date.

15\. Control of and keep storerooms and adjacent compartments clean and tidy, well organized, and spare parts correctly labeled and safely stored.

16\. Maintains good housekeeping practices in all storage areas of the warehouse and outside storage areas

17\. Monitoring all Stores are taken to the Warehouse location in a timely manner after physical reception takes place on board and further distribution to the HOD (Heads of Department) is done of cargo reception.

18\. Maintains good housekeeping of equipment, receiving areas, and storage area following HSE protocols and procedures.

19\. Maintain Filing of Requisition forms, ensuring that they are properly filled up and acknowledged by the requesting parties.

20\. Enter data into a database or other computerized system to maintain up-to-date stock records

21\. Implement Cycle counts onto Warehouse shelving and racking structures (Including re organization and material placement inside the location)

22\. Relabeling of materials as required.

23\. Process Implementation for warehouse improvements.

24\. Weekly chemicals and lubes compressed gas bottles, medical supplies, medicines, and personal protective equipment inventory Count.

25\. Transfer orders generation for material transfers within EE Fleet Vessels.

26\. Handover notes preparation for storekeeper relief.

**Crew Matrix Requirements (STCW):**

- Maritime English – CEFR B1

- Cyber Security Awareness

- Bullying and Harassment

- STCW V/1.2.1 Basic training for LNG Tanker Cargo Ops

- STCW VI/1 Basic safety

- STCW VI/6.1 - Security Awareness

- STCW VI/6.2 - Designated security duties


**Technical Competence:**

- MS Office skills with Excel, Power Point, Outlook, and Word.

- Understanding of Warehousing and Inventory management procedures and processes.

- Good Knowledge in Supply chain information systems (ERP).

- Previous Warehousing and Inventory control experience strongly preferred, or ability to demonstrate comparable knowledge and skills. (Preferred 3 years).

- Strong team spirit and customer service orientation.

- Willing to work extended periods of time and perform physical activities


Previous experience on an FSRU vessels is required.

jobs.title: PhD position at the Department of Geography
jobs.description:
UiB - Knowledge that shapes society

UiB shall be among Europe's leading universities, internationally recognized for high quality in research and education. As a societal institution, we shall contribute to sustainable and democratic development and be an attractive and inclusive place to study and work.

Video: https://youtu.be/i4SDcLir6OcPhD position

There is a vacancy for a PhD position in System Dynamics at the Department of Geography. The position is within the project INTEGRATOR and for a fixed-term period of 3 years. Starting date is latest 1 April 2027.

System Dynamics Group at the Department of Geography

The System Dynamics group carries out research in several areas. The most important areas are: sustainability transitions, natural resources management, water-energy-food-ecosystems (WEFE) nexus, and model-based learning and communication. The group makes use of a variety of tools and techniques: stakeholder mapping, governance analysis, participatory modeling, non-linear feedback modeling, computer simulation, non-linear model analysis, interactive learning environments and decision-laboratory experiments.


About the project/work tasks:

Description of the INTEGRATOR project

The position is within the EU Horizon Europe project ‘Integrated Innovation Ecosystems for Transformative Nexus Governance towards Enhanced Water Resilience (INTEGRATOR)’. The overarching project objective is to strengthen Europe’s climate-resilient and fair water management by enabling anticipatory, evidence-based decision making at river basin scale under changing climatic and socio-economic conditions, directly supporting the implementation of the EU water strategy. Specific objectives of INTEGRATOR pertaining to this call include: (1) promoting system-wide transformation in water governance and management to strengthen resilience, preparedness, and fair allocation; (2) establishing site-specific, stakeholder-led strategies; (3) creating seasonal and long-term foresight by developing and coupling a suite of models, including data-driven, process-based, and system-dynamics approaches; (4) delivering a digital water intelligence system orchestrated by a prompt compiler translating human language into executable simulations.

INTEGRATOR is built on six case studies in Germany, Greece, Italy, Latvia, Spain and Türkiye with various socio-economic, sectoral development, land use, water quality and water quantity challenges. Among these case studies, two of them are particularly relevant to this call: (1) Ergene River Basin (Türkiye), a 17K km2 watershed and a major industrial and agricultural hub with 2M inhabitants, facing severe pressure on groundwater resources, water quality and allocation. (2) Jucar River Basin – Albufera system in Spain, a highly interconnected river-water-coastal continuum centered on the 210 km2 Albufera Natural Park with high ecological value, facing pressures from intensive irrigated agriculture, and urban and industrial development.

Responsibilities following the position:

The research fellow will use participatory system dynamics modelling and computer simulations to support INTEGRATOR in all work packages (abbreviated as WP), with a concentrated focus on two WPs: WP3 (Participatory Co-Design for Resilient and Equitable Water Solutions using a Decision Theatre Approach) is going to strengthen inclusive and transformational governance through structured participatory process in the INTEGRATOR’s Decision Theatres (DTs). More specifically, WP3 will deal with stakeholder mapping, problem co-definition, participatory scenario analysis and policy exploration embedded in INTEGRATOR’s Decision Theatres Approach (DTA). WP6 (Digital Water Intelligence System and the HydroFellow) is going to provide a Digital Water Intelligence System (DWIS) and a prompt compiler, integrating multisource information, including models and model generated data. More specifically, WP6 will work on integrated hydrological and system dynamics modeling, site-specific digital twin development and integration, and the prompt compiler HydroFellow development through interaction with the DTs. The research fellow will be working on the Ergene and Albufera case studies to fundamentally support the activities under WP3 and WP6 through systems thinking, dynamic systems modeling and computer simulations.


Qualifications and personal qualities:
  • The applicant must hold a master’s degree in System Dynamics or another discipline with a strong system, modeling and simulation focus. The master’s degree must have been completed by the application deadline.
  • The requirements are generally a grade B or better on the Master thesis and for the master’s degree in total.
  • Applicants must demonstrate a strong interest in socio-economic-hydrological scenario building; experience in participatory model-building is desirable.
  • Applicants must have strong quantitative and computational foundations.
  • Teaching assistance experience in the field of System Dynamics will be considered an advantage.
  • The applicant must be proficient in both written and oral English. Proficiency in Spanish and/or Turkish languages will be considered an advantage.
  • Applicants must be able to work independently and in a structured manner.
  • Applicants should have experience of working as a member of a multidisciplinary and multicultural research team and demonstrate good collaborative skills.
  • Experience in interdisciplinary working, linking social/economic and environmental sciences, is desirable.
  • Personal and relational qualities will be emphasized. Ambitions and potential will also count when evaluating the candidates.
  • The place of work for this position is Bergen, and the work requires that you are physically present at the Department of Geography on a daily basis.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview. 


About the PhD position:

The duration of the PhD position is 3 years. 

About the PhD training:

As a PhD research fellow, you will take part in the PhD programme at the Faculty of Social Sciences, UiB. The programme corresponds to a period of three years and leads to the PhD degree. To be eligible for admission you must normally have an educational background corresponding to a master’s degree with a scope of 120 ECTS credits, which builds on a bachelor’s degree with a scope of 180 ECTS credits (normally 2 + 3 years), or an integrated master’s degree with a scope of 300 ECTS credits (5 years). Master’s degrees must normally include an independent work of a minimum of 30 ECTS credits. It is expected that the topic of the master’s degree is connected to the academic field to which you are seeking admission.


We can offer:
  • Salary as PhD (code 1017) NOK 593 700,- per year. Automatic salary increases for up to 3 years with a 3% annual increase 
  • A good and professionally challenging working environment
  • Enrolment in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Good welfare benefits

Project proposal:

A research proposal of maximum 2500 words (excluding reference list) must accompany the application. The project description should present the topic, the research questions(s) and choice of theory and methods. It should also include a progress plan for the different parts of the project. The research proposal must also include a short description of how the applicant envisions a fit with the INTEGRATOR project. Admittance to the PhD programme will be based on the research proposal. 


Your application must include:
  • A cover letter including a brief account of your research interests and motivation for applying for the position
  • The names and contact information for two reference persons. One of them must be the main advisor for the master's thesis or equivalent thesis
  • Project proposal
  • CV
  • Transcripts and diplomas showing completion of the bachelor's and master's degrees.
  • Relevant certificates/references
  • A list of academic publications
  • Academic publications that you want to submit for assessment (including your master’s thesis or equivalent)
  • If you have a master's degree from an institution outside of the Nordic countries, or a 2-year discipline- based master's degree (or the equivalent) in a subject area other than the one associated with the application, you may later in the application process be asked to submit an overview of the syllabus for the degree you have completed

The application and appendices with certified translations into English or a Scandinavian language must be uploaded at Jobbnorge following the link on this page marked “Apply for this job”.

Closing date: November 1, 2026.

Applications submitted without a project proposal or applications sent as e-mails will not be considered. Only submitted documents will be subjected to an expert assessment.


General information:

Detailed information about the position can be obtained by contacting Professor Ali K. Saysel, ali.saysel@uib.no.

Practical questions regarding the application procedures, please contact the HR section at: personal.svfa-sm@uib.no. 

Appointed research fellows will be admitted to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Social Sciences. Questions about the programme may be directed to Adviser Elina Troscenko, elina.troscenko@uib.no

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
jobs.description:
Description

Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes.

You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind.


Your mission

1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence 

  • Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution.

  • Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy.

  • Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters.

  • Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo.

2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership 

  • Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer.

  • Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders).

  • Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice.

  • Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos.

3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement 

  • Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation.

  • Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations.

  • Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder.

What We Want to Achieve Together

In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds.

In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount.


Your profile

  • Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies.

  • Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences.

  • Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility.

  • Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data.

  • AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new.

  • A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough.

  • Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both.


Why us?

  • Real editorial ownership over our voice and our position, not a content calendar handed down from someone else.

  • A platform to build your own visible profile as a voice in Legal AI.

  • Modern office in Leipzig or Berlin, hybrid setup, with regular presence in Zürich and team events such as hiking, dinners and offsites.

  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) participation.

  • Competitive salary, based on experience and seniority.


Process

  1. 30 min with our People & Operations Manager: cultural fit, understanding the role and your expectations.

  2. Positioning conversation with our Head of Product: bring a point of view on Legal AI and be ready to defend it live.

  3. Case study: show us something you’ve written or built, and how you’d turn it into a sales-ready asset.

  4. Meet the team in the office.

  5. Decision: if it’s mutual, we welcome you to the team!

How to Apply

Send us your CV, two or three writing or work samples you’re proud of, and a short note answering: what’s your sharpest point of view on where Legal AI is heading, and what’s the evidence?

jobs.title: Legal AI Engineer (Zurich)
jobs.description:
Description

Legartis is on a mission: to unlock legal work at scale.

We set the standard for AI-powered contract work by offering a platform that changes how legal teams work, from drafting through negotiation to completion. We are now looking for the person who turns what customers actually need into what our AI actually does.

Joining Legartis is not taking a job, you take ownership. We are a team of product builders and lawyers, who do not chase hype; we build substance. If you are a lawyer who builds, someone who has stopped waiting for better tools and started making them, this is your moment and your place.

Send us your CV, a short note on why Legartis, and links to anything you have built or published.


Your mission

Most companies split this seat across three teams, and that split is exactly the problem. The person who hears the customer describe their workflow should be the person who writes the requirement, and the person who writes the requirement should be able to build the first version themselves. That is you.

1. You translate customer reality into engineering requirements — and into revenue. You sit in customer and expert calls alongside Sales, not as a note-taker but as the person who understands the legal work. In trials and hackathons you coach hands-on: the customer drives, you navigate, and they create the first "wow" moment themselves. When they say "that won't work for us" or "we'll build it ourselves", you answer with a concrete path (a workaround, a workflow, the honest maintenance cost of the alternative) and you leave every conversation with a next step: trial licenses, a hackathon, a scoped rollout. Then you pull out the workflow: what actually happens, in what order, where it breaks, what the customer would pay to never do again. And you write the spec, edge cases, and acceptance criteria that Engineering can build against.

2. You build the skills yourself. You write, test, and ship agent skills and playbooks that solve real customer workflows. You build the evaluation frameworks and test sets that prove they got better rather than just different. When the AI fails on a clause, you diagnose why, at the prompt and context level, and you either fix it or hand Engineering a diagnosis precise enough to act on.

3. You make it repeatable, and therefore sellable. Anything you build once for one customer, you turn into something Sales and Customer Success can run without you. Standard demo environments. A skill library they can reach for. Onboarding that lands in days rather than months. Where Customer Success needs legal depth you step in, fix it, and turn the fix into something the team can handle alone next time. Your success is measured by how rarely you need to be in the room, and by what happens to adoption and expansion when you are not.

4. You are the legal authority in the building. Legal and compliance questions land with you: contract reviews, customer security and data protection questions, the occasional in-house matter which makes roughly ten to fifteen percent of your time. You use our own product to do it, and you tell us honestly when it is not good enough.


Your profile

The person we picture. There is a name emerging for what we are describing, and it is not "lawyer who is good with computers". It is legal quant: a lawyer who builds their own tooling to practise law, rather than waiting for a vendor to ship it. The distinction that matters to us: plenty of lawyers now use AI. A legal quant builds with it. They look at a workflow and ask how to redesign it from first principles to get the best possible outcome, rather than making the existing process incrementally faster.

A note on how we are weighting this role. Three capabilities make someone exceptional here: commercial instinct, legal depth, and technical ability to build. The ideal candidate has all three. We know that person is rare, and we are not going to pretend otherwise by writing a wish list and hoping. So for this role we weight the technical evidence most heavily, because it is the hardest of the three to teach on the job.

If you believe you genuinely combine all three, we want to talk to you regardless of how neatly your CV matches the bullets below. Say so in your note and tell us what you have built and what you have sold.

1. Technical track record. You have built things and they exist and ideally you have published some of it. You are fluent with LLMs the way a practitioner is fluent, not a spectator: you know how context windows fail you or why a prompt stopped working. When something breaks you go into the system rather than around it. Scripting, Git, and APIs are a strong plus.

2. Legal foundation. A law degree with a commercial-contracts focus: German-qualified (Bachelor, Master, or Staatsexamen) or an equivalent qualification from another jurisdiction. No bar admission required, no second Staatsexamen required. What we need: you have worked hands-on with German commercial contracts, drafting, reviewing, and negotiating them, and you can hold a conversation with a General Counsel as a peer.

3. Commercial and entrepreneurial track record. You have carried commercial responsibility for something of your own: a freelance client base, a legal tech product, or a company you started. You know what it takes to win a client from a standing start and why "they did not understand the value" is never the customer's fault. If instead you have supported enterprise sales teams in demos, pilots, and expert calls, tell us what you changed about the outcome.

You prioritise by impact, you are comfortable deciding without permission, and you would rather ship something imperfect this week than something elegant next quarter.

4. Language. Excellent German and English. German is non-negotiable: our customers are DACH legal teams and the nuance lives in their language. You can run a room of legal buyers, ask the sharp question, and write a specification precise enough to build from. Other EU languages are a plus.


Why us?

  • Impact over hype. You define a new discipline at the intersection of law, product, and AI. Your work directly shapes how thousands of legal professionals will operate.
  • No silos. You sit between Product, Engineering, and the customer, with a direct line to all three. The better argument wins, not the higher title.
  • We invest in you. The enterprise motion (multi-stakeholder pilots, procurement cycles, security reviews) is teachable, and we teach it: side by side in real customer calls from week one.
  • Real ownership. Competitive salary and employee stock options (ESOP).
  • Build in public. We want you to keep publishing what you build, because it makes you better and it makes us visible.
  • Offices in Berlin, Leipzig, and Zurich with a flexible hybrid setup. Regular apéros, lunches, and hiking trips as we enjoy the journey together.


Process

  1. Expectations. A conversation with the People Manager about the role and who you are.
  2. Depth. A conversation with our General Counsel & Head of Legal AI on Legal Engineering at Legartis and where the legal market is going.
  3. Build session. A live case at the intersection of legal reasoning, prompting, and product work: a real customer scenario, a legal AI workflow, or a playbook that misbehaves.
  4. Meet the team in our Zurich office.
  5. A mutual decision, before we welcome you to the team.

jobs.title: Researcher or Doctoral Researcher in justice and sustainability transitions
jobs.description:
How can we make the ongoing energy transition more just, and who gets to define what a just transition means? As societies pursue more sustainable energy and industrial systems, questions of justice are becoming increasingly central to public debate and decision-making. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to research addressing these questions in the context of Finlands emerging battery industry. This position requires excellent Finnish language skills and a strong command of English.

LUT University is looking for a researcher or doctoral (junior) researcher to join the Academy Research Fellowship project Circuits of Justice: Exploring Normative and Spatial Dimensions of Justice Across Finlands Battery Supply Chain. The four-year project, led by Dr Alicja Dankowska in LUT Universitys Energy and Society research group, examines how justice claims emerge, circulate, and evolve throughout the Finlands battery supply chain. Taking a whole-systems perspective, the project explores how stakeholders understand, negotiate, and contest different dimensions of justice across places, sectors, and scales.

What your work will be like

As a member of the project team, you will work closely with the principal investigator and contribute to all major stages of the research process. Your work will involve studying policy, media, and public debates on the development of Finlands battery industry through discourse analysis. You will also conduct multi-sited fieldwork, including interviews, focus groups, document analysis, and participant observation.

You will help desing and facilitate stakeholder co-creation workshops that explore pathways towards a more just transition and take part in analysing and interpreting research data with the project team. You will also contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations, and other dissemination activities and participate in international research collaboration, including research visits to Norway and Spain.

What we expect

We are looking for an independent, proactive, and collaborative researcher who enjoys working with colleagues, stakeholders, and international research partners.

Applicants for the researcher position must have a relevant doctoral degree and advanced research experience. Applicants for the doctoral (junior) researcher position must hold a relevant masters degree.

You should have a background in a relevant social science discipline, such as sociology, political science, human geography, anthropology, sustainability studies, environmental policy, or a related field. You also need to have experience in discourse analysis – particularly policy or media analysis – as well as strong qualitative research skills and interest in fieldwork.

Knowledge of energy transitions, sustainability transitions, science and technology studies (STS), or just transitions and energy justice is highly desirable. Experience related to batteries, critical raw materials, mining, energy systems, or industrial transitions is considered an advantage.

What we offer

This position offers an opportunity to contribute to a novel and societally relevant research project in close collaboration with national and international research partners. You will be able to develop your qualitative and interdisciplinary research expertise while receiving support for scientific publishing and conference participation. The project also provides opportunities for international research mobility and a collegial, supportive research environment within LUT Universitys Energy and Society research group.

We will fill the position at either of the following levels:

Doctoral (junior) researcher

- The position is full-time. It begins with a one-year term (including a six-month trial period) and may be extended by three years, depending on the progress of your studies and the quality of your research.

- The salary is set according to the Finnish university pay systems scale for teaching and research staff (requirement level 2). The starting salary is approximately EUR 3,100 per month, depending on experience and qualifications.

- The selected candidate must apply for the right to pursue doctoral studies at the LUT Doctoral School within the first two months of employment.

Researcher

- The employment relationship is part-time (70% of full-time) with a fixed term running until 31 August 2030 (including a six-month trial period).

- The salary is set according to the Finnish university pay systems scale for teaching and research staff (requirement levels 5–6). The starting salary is approximately EUR 4,300–5,000 per month, depending on qualifications and experience and based on the part-time workload.

The work starts as soon as possible, and the start date is negotiable. The position is based at LUTs Lappeenranta campus in Finland. LUT offers a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with regular on-campus presence. The position follows a system of 1,612 annual working hours under the collective agreement for Finnish universities. The hours are flexible and support work–life balance.



If you are eager to advance understanding of justice in sustainability transitions while developing your academic research career in an international environment, we encourage you to apply.



Interested? Please submit your application through the link below by 3 November 2026 at 23:59 (Finnish local time, UTC+2). Fill out the online form and attach the following documents in English and in PDF format:

- A motivation letter, including research experience, skills, and motivation related to the research focus of the project (max. 1 page)

- Your curriculum vitae (max. 2 pages)

- A list of publications

- A copy of your degree certificate and a transcript of your academic records proving your eligibility for the position; if the original documents are not in English, Finnish, or Swedish, official certified translations into English or Finnish are required

- A link to your thesis or doctoral dissertation

Please specify which position you are applying for. Submit your application well before the deadline to allow time for uploading all attachments. Also, make sure you submit only one application. Only applications submitted through the online recruitment system will be considered. We will review applications on a rolling basis, and the position will be filled
