jobs.title: Postdoctoral Fellows in Educational Measurement
jobs.description:
Job description

Applications are invited for 1-2 full time positions for three- to four-years as Postdoctoral Fellows at the Centre for Research on Equality in Education (CREATE), Faculty of Educational Sciences, University of Oslo, Norway. The positions have a double affiliation with the Centre for Educational Measurement (CEMO).

CREATE is an interdisciplinary Centre of Excellence funded by the Research Council of Norway with the objective to generate novel knowledge about how to reduce inequalities in education. The interdisciplinary center integrates researchers with substantive expertise from education, psychology, sociology, economics, and genetics, and methodological expertise from educational measurement, psychometrics, econometrics, statistics, and biostatistics. The Postdoctoral Fellowships are affiliated with CREATE’s research strand 3 «Addressing key methodological challenges».  

CEMO provides a stimulating research environment by bringing internationally renowned substantive and methodological experts together. Research at CEMO combines basic research and applications of advanced measurement techniques to solve core educational problems. CEMO also contributes to the development of measurement competence through teaching and outreach.


More about the positions

The positions are tied to strand 3 of CREATE, which aims to develop novel methods and statistical software that are tailor-made to the research questions and data of CREATE. 

The successful candidate will conduct advanced methodological and psychometric research. Potential research areas include (a) instructional sensitivity and opportunity to learn in international large-scale assessments in education, (b) estimation and inference methods for weighted generalized structural equation models with mixed continuous and discrete data in longitudinal settings, and (c) advancing research synthesis and meta-analytic methods, for instance, to investigate digital inequalities in education using international large-scale assessment data.

The appointments are full-time positions and made for a period of three years, 10% of which is devoted to required duties, usually in the form of teaching activities. If there is a good match between the candidate’s competence and the teaching needs at CEMO, the positions may be extended to four years, 25% of which is devoted to required duties, usually in the form of teaching activities and supervision. For these positions, the teaching activities will be part of CEMO’s master’s programme in Assessment, Measurement and Evaluation.

The main purpose of the fellowship is to build a research profile and competence that qualifies the postdoctoral fellow to apply for a position as associate professor within their disciplines. The position may also provide other competence with relevance for the postdoctoral fellow's further career.

If the Postdoctoral Fellow does not already have educational qualifications that meet the requirements for an associate professor position, UiO shall facilitate the acquisition of such competence during the employment period.

A career plan shall be developed for the Postdoctoral Fellow, specifying the competencies the Postdoctoral Fellow should acquire. UiO is responsible for following up on the career plan and ensuring that the Postdoctoral Fellow has access to career guidance throughout the postdoctoral term.


Qualification requirements
  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in one of the social and behavioral sciences, statistics, or computer science applying and/or developing advanced quantitative methods. The doctoral dissertation must have been submitted for evaluation by the application deadline. Appointment is dependent on the public defense of the doctoral thesis being approved
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English 
  • Demonstrated fit to one of the three research areas (a) to (c) listed above
  • Proficiency in programming and data analysis in the statistical software environment R, Python, or other relevant programming languages, as evidenced in relevant courses or publication(s)

Applicants will be evaluated as a function of the fit between their qualifications and the research area they apply for. The following qualifications will count in the assessment of the applicants:

  • For research area (a), prior experience with IRT/mixed-effects logistic regression and international large-scale assessments in education
  • For research area (b), prior experience with latent variable models and Monte Carlo simulation studies
  • For research area (c), prior experience with meta-analysis/research synthesis and international large-scale assessment data

Personal skills
  • Creativity and ability to work independently 
  • Self-motivated, eager to learn and ready to tackle and deal with challenges
  • Able to collaborate with others 

Personal suitability and motivation for the position will be emphasized.


We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


We offer
  • Salary NOK 595 000 - 670 000 per annum depending on qualifications in position as Postdoctoral Research Fellow (position code 1352). From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund
  • A professionally stimulating work environment
  • An interdisciplinary and international work environment, recognized as a Centre of Excellence
  • Attractive welfare benefits 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes

How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (maximum two pages), including a statement of motivation and your fit with one of the research areas (a) to (c) listed above 
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Copy of PhD Diploma or documentation of thesis submission. Applicants who have not yet defended their PhD dissertation need to include an advisor's letter confirming specific expectations about when the degree will be received
  • Copy of the PhD thesis 
  • Copies of educational certificates (academic transcripts only)
  • A complete list of publications
  • List of reference persons: 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number)

The application with attachments must be delivered in our electronic recruiting system Jobbnorge. Foreign applicants are advised to attach an explanation of their University's grading system. Please note that all documents should be in English (or a Scandinavian language).

Incomplete applications will not be assessed. 

In assessing the applicants, special emphasis will be placed on the documented, academic qualifications, as well as the candidates motivation and personal suitability. Interviews with the best qualified candidates will be arranged.

It is expected that the successful candidate will be able to complete the project in the course of the period of employment.


Formal regulations

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and the guidelines and regulations for appointments to Postdoctoral Fellowships at the University of Oslo.

No one can be appointed for more than one Postdoctoral Fellow period at the University of Oslo.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 27 400 students and 6 900 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

CREATE (Centre of Research on Equality in Education) is an interdisciplinary Centre of Excellence funded by the Research Council of Norway and the Faculty of Educational Sciences. CREATE’s objective is to generate novel knowledge about how to reduce inequalities in education.

Verkkoasiantuntijana pääset mukaan Patrian datacom-tiimin arkeen avustaviin ja ylläpitäviin verkkotehtäviin. - Kiinnostusta ja perusymmärrystä: Ymmärrystä tietoverkkojen perusteista (kuten IP-osoitteet, kytkimet, palomuurit ja verkkolaitteiden perustoiminta).

- Aiemman kesätyö- tai harjoittelukokemuksen IT-, ATK- tai tietoliikennealan tehtävistä.
- Ulospäinsuuntautuneen ja kommunikatiivisen otteen tiimityöskentelyssä.

Tehtävään valitulle henkilölle tullaan tekemään perusmuotoinen turvallisuusselvitys sekä huumausainetestaus.

Academic Work hoitaa tätä hakua asiakkaansa puolesta, jonka toiveena on kaikkien tehtävää koskevien kysymysten osoittaminen Academic Workille.

Hakijoita haastatellaan jatkuvasti ja mikäli olemme edenneet jo rekrytointiprosessissa pidemmälle, saatamme sulkea haun ennen lopullisia valintoja. Nordiccom is a Danish company located in Copenhagen and we are still growing. All sales are made over the phone.

We are looking for a characteristic person with a flair for working with people over the phone and making sure the customers get a great experience every time. The position is on site from our office in Copenhagen and we only have contact with our customers over the phone.

It is not a requirement for you to have experience with insurances prior to applying for this job, but we would prefer it if you have experience with selling over the phone.

- Good communication skills and the ability to connect with all kinds of different people
- A competitive and result-oriented mindset
- Fluent in Norwegian (English language skills are also an advantage)

- A social working place in a comfortable & productive environment
- A multinational working environment with an informal tone and high job satisfaction
- Helpful and motivated colleagues

jobs.title: Genopslag - kirketjener ved Ordrup Kirke 30 t. /ugen
jobs.description:
Har du praktisk sans, godt humør og lyst til at være en vigtig del af livet i en aktiv kirke?

Ordrup Kirke søger en engageret og alsidig kirketjener, der trives med en hverdag, hvor ingen dage er helt ens. Vi søger en kollega, som kan arbejde selvstændigt, planlægge og prioritere sine opgaver, og samtidig indgå i et tæt samarbejde med kirkens anden kirketjener Marie Barfoed, og kirkens øvrige medarbejdere.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en deltidsstilling på 30 timer. For den rette kandidat er menighedsrådet dog indstillet på at drøfte en udvidelse af arbejdsopgaverne med henblik på en fuldtidsstilling.

Vi søger en kirketjener, som:
  • gerne har erfaring som kirketjener eller fra en lignende stilling
  • har gode samarbejdsevner og en positiv tilgang til arbejdet
  • er imødekommende og har let ved at tale med mennesker
  • har god situationsfornemmelse og sætter en ære i at levere et godt stykke arbejde
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dagens opgaver
  • har praktisk sans og hænderne skruet godt på

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:
  • klargøring af kirken og medvirken ved gudstjenester og kirkelige handlinger
  • rengøring og almindelig vedligeholdelse af kirken og sognegården
  • pasning af kirkens udendørsarealer
  • opstilling og flytning af borde og stole i forbindelse med arrangementer
  • indkøb og lagerstyring
  • opsyn med håndværkere, tekniske installationer og øvrig drift
  • andre praktiske opgaver, der bidrager til kirkens daglige liv

Stillingen indebærer fysisk arbejde, og det er derfor vigtigt, at du trives med praktiske opgaver.

Vi arbejder løbende på at udvikle kirkens drift og skabe gode rammer for kirketjenernes arbejde. Blandt andet ønsker vi at skabe mulighed for ekstra ressourcer til særlige opgaver som hovedrengøring og større vedligeholdelsesopgaver, ligesom vi ser på mere bæredygtige løsninger i plejen af kirkens udearealer.

Vi tilbyder
  • et alsidigt og meningsfuldt arbejde i en levende kirke
  • gode og engagerede kolleger
  • en arbejdsplads med fokus på samarbejde, ansvar og udvikling
  • mulighed for at præge stillingens fremtidige indhold

Ansættelse sker ved Ordrup Sogns Menighedsråd beliggende Henrik Hertz Vej 1, 2920 Charlottenlund.

Ansættelsen er omfattet af Fællesoverenskomsten mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer (OAO-S) og Organisationsaftalen for kirkefunktionærer med kerneopgaver som kirketjener eller graver indgået mellem Kirkeministeriet og Danmarks Kirketjenerforening og det tilhørende protokollat for kirketjenere. Aftalerne kan ses på Folkekirkens IntraNet.

Nuværende tjenestemandsansatte kirketjenere har ret til at bevare deres tjenestemandsstatus ved ansættelse med direkte overgang. Der skal i så fald ske en klassificering af stillingen.

Årslønnen aftales indenfor intervallet 324.667,- kr. – 408.841,- kr. (nutidskroner for fuldtidsstilling).

Der er rådighedsforpligtelse til stillingen. Rådighedstillægget udgør årligt 33.231,- kr. (nutidskroner for fuldtidsstilling).

OK tillæg på 1.401,- kr. (nutidskroner for fuldtidsstilling) pr. år.

Aftale om indplacering i lønintervallet indgås mellem menighedsrådet og Danmarks Kirketjenerforening.

Løn OK tillæg samt rådighedstillæg kvoteres i overensstemmelse med stillingens ansættelsesbrøk.

Hvis du ikke er uddannet kirketjener, er det er en betingelse, at den obligatoriske 5 ugers uddannelse for kirketjenere gennemføres indenfor 2 år efter ansættelsens start.

Ansøgning
Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte:

Personaleansvarlig Malene Hjort på tlf. 5135 9280 eller kirketjener Marie Barfoed på tlf. 4082 0798

Ansøgningen sendes via knappen 'Ansøg' senest den 20. oktober 2026.

Menighedsrådet kan oplyse, at der vil blive indhentet referencer.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is looking for a technically qualified and commercially focused Key Account Manager for its sales of high quality cast iron solutions.

THE POSITION

In order to consolidate and expand our sales activities, we need to strengthen our sales team by recruiting a qualified Key Account Manager.

You will be given responsibility for strategically important customers, all of which are market-leading OEMs or system providers, including those in the truck sector. Your role will be to expand and enhance the sales turnover among existing customers, while at the same time cultivating new customer relationships. A significant part of the role also involves making sustained efforts to secure up-to-date framework agreements and contracts in addition to communicating customer requirements and expectations.

The sales process consists of offering to produce the customers’ cast iron components. Once the items are being produced, the sales work will involve continuously negotiating and adjusting the sales prices of the individual components, as well as negotiating and maintaining other commercial conditions. These conditions include packaging, logistics solutions, framework agreements for quality and delivery, and aftermarket terms.

Your normal working day will vary from administrative tasks at the office in Holstebro, where you will work closely with Production, the Production Engineering Department (PED), Business Controlling and other company stakeholders. You will also be responsible for planning and conducting your external customer visits, primarily in Europe where you can expect up to around 50 days’ travelling per year. You will also help with and prepare data and presentations for sales meetings and trade fair attendance, as well as continuously reporting to Sales Management.

As part of a cross-organisational partnership, you will familiarise yourself with the customers’ projects and thus become the most important link of the contact between the customer and your colleagues across the entire organisation.

When out visiting customers with a view to sales, you will always have a ‘One Stop Shop’ cast iron solution to call upon. By this, we mean that BIRN is able to cast, machine, assemble and surface-treat the products so that they can be delivered directly to the customer’s production line or application without further processing. This is both efficient and sustainable.

Are you looking to combine your technical curiosity and skills with a strategic responsibility for sales and long-term customer relationships in an international industrial group? If so, you may be the person we are looking for as a Key Account Manager.

YOUR DUTIES

You will be given a central role in the sales organisation, with your work including the following:

·       Responsibility for and the continued development of a portfolio of four to six major strategic customers in Europe, primarily in Scandinavia. You will be responsible for a turnover of at least € 25 million

·       Building up long-term relationships with the customers’ stakeholders in the fields of purchasing, development, quality and logistics

·       Technical and commercial advice during the customers’ development and project phases

·       Planning and conducting customer visits, contract and price negotiations and major framework agreements

·       Ongoing budget monitoring, forecasts and sales reports at customer level

·       Searching for, analysing and developing new customer potentials and market segments

·       Close internal collaboration with production engineering, quality, controlling and finance

·       Participation in sales and strategy activities across the organisation

The position involves some travel, primarily in Europe.

QUALIFICATIONS

We expect you to have the following:

·       Extensive advanced technical training/experience, ideally supplemented with commercial skills, e.g. engineer, marine engineer or equivalent. A skilled trade background, supplemented by commercial training or experience, is another option

·       Experience of technical sales, project sales or Key Account Management; alternatively, you will have been recently trained and have the right level of drive. The start date will be adapted to suit the right candidate

·       The ability to thrive in an outward-facing role with extensive customer contact, and to plan your day-to-day work independently

·       The ability to work in a structured manner on CRM, budgets, documentation and monitoring. You will need to be skilled in using digital tools, for processing both text and numbers

·       The ability to communicate without difficulty in English and, preferably, also in Danish – and, ideally, in the other Scandinavian languages

·       The technical flair and ability to get to grips with the customers’ business and applications

·       A passenger car driving licence and a valid passport with no travel restrictions

At a personal level, you will be skilled in relationships, persistent and curious, with the motivation to create value through collaboration based on trust and a high level of professionalism.

WHAT WE OFFER

You will become part of Vald. BIRN A/S, a solid and internationally represented industrial enterprise with strong values and a high degree of professionalism. In addition, you will receive:

·       A central, independent role with a high level of influence on customers, sales and commercial development

·       A strong professional environment with close collaboration across the Group

·       Thorough on-boarding and training in products, markets and the organisation

·       Good opportunities for both professional and personal development

·       Attractive terms and conditions of employment, including a pension scheme and health insurance

·       A good canteen scheme and active staff association

·       An informal work environment that focuses on well-being, responsibility and sustainability

ABOUT THE BIRN GROUP

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is the Group Headquarters of one of Northern Europe’s largest foundry Groups. We supply highly processed cast iron components to the truck industry and others, as well as industrial hydraulics and machine components. Sustainability, the circular economy and responsibility are integral parts of our DNA. The Group employs around 750 staff, of which around 480 are in Holstebro.

APPLICATIONS

jobs.title: Controller / Project Controller
jobs.description:
We are strengthening our finance team and are looking for a Controller to take on a key operational role within an international group of companies. You will become part of a small, highly competent team where everyone contributes across tasks and processes.

This position combines controlling, invoicing, order backlog monitoring, and project financial management, while working closely with both operational and project teams. You will have independent responsibility for your own group companies while actively contributing to the day-to-day operations and development of the finance function.

Key Responsibilities

Project and Financial Controlling

  • Manage invoicing and follow up on customers and accounts receivable

  • Monitor projects, contracts, purchase orders, and order backlog

  • Controlling of accounts, prepare basis for CapEX, accrual/deferral, month-end, and more.

  • Prepare reports, analysies, and forecasts

  • Analyse project margins, profitability, and resource utilization

  • Support Project Managers and Delivery Managers with financial insights and project follow-up

  • Contribute to budgeting, forecasting, and planning processes

  • Act as the main point of contact for external accounting providers

  • Support audits and year-end closing activities

Systems and Processes

  • Serve as a super user and administrator for the company's project management and time registration systems

  • Drive continuous improvement of reporting, financial processes, and internal controls

  • Ensure high-quality financial documentation and effective routines

Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for someone who combines strong financial acumen with analytical skills and an interest in project management.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in controlling, financial management, or project finance

  • Strong understanding of accounting, project finance, reporting, forecasting, and financial analysis

  • Experience with ERP and project management systems

  • Advanced Excel skills

  • Excellent written and spoken Norwegian and English

Preferred Experience

  • PowerOffice Go

  • Project Flow by Moment

  • Software, technology, or project-based businesses within the maritime, offshore, or energy sectors

What We Offer

  • A key role in a growing international software group

  • The opportunity to contribute to the development of our finance function and business processes

  • Close collaboration with leaders and key stakeholders across the group companies

  • A high degree of responsibility, autonomy, and influence in your role

  • An informal and inclusive work environment with talented colleagues across the Star Group companies

  • Flexibility in your workday and the possibility of remote work

  • Wellness allowance and attractive employee benefits

  • Competitive pension and insurance schemes

  • Modern office facilities and a strong social work environment

Location: Trondheim or Bergen
Start Date: As soon as possible

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interested candidates are encouraged to apply at their earliest convenience.

About Star Information Systems

Star Information Systems, together with Premas, Infoship, Nozzle, and Sharecat Solutions, is an international group providing software solutions and services to the maritime and energy industries.

Through the companies within the group, we help customers around the world create control, efficiency, and sustainable growth through digital solutions and operational expertise.

jobs.title: Myyjä, Sale Lundi ja Sale Gammelbacka / Försäljare, Sale Lundi och Sale Gammelbacka
jobs.description:
Primary location:
PORVOO

MYYJÄ, SALE LUNDI JA SALE GAMMELBACKA, 30 H/VK, VAKITUINEN TYÖSUHDE

Etsimme myyjää Sale Lundiin ja Sale Gammelbackaan vakituiseen työsuhteeseen, 30 tuntia viikossa. Myyjänä työskentelet monipuolisesti kaupan eri tehtävissä: palvelet asiakkaita kassalla, hyllytät tuotteita, huolehdit tuotteiden esillepanosta ja päiväysten seurannasta sekä varmistat myymälöiden siisteyden, viihtyisyyden ja tuotteiden saatavuuden. Perehdytyksen jälkeen tunnet tarjoamamme tuotteet ja palvelut sekä asiakasomistajuuteen liittyvät asiat ja osaat kertoa niistä asiakkaillemme heidän tarpeensa huomioiden.

Me Sale Lundissa ja Sale Gammelbackassa sanomme olevamme ihan tavallisissa töissä. Tavallisuus ei kuitenkaan tarkoita, että työ olisi tylsää – päinvastoin! Tarjoamme vaihtelevan työn asiakaspalvelun parissa ja tiimin, jossa kaveria ei jätetä.

Toivomme sinulta:
- Kohtaat asiakkaat ja työkaverit sydän kohdallaan <3
- Reipasta ja asiakaslähtöistä asennetta sekä oma-aloitteista ja vastuuntuntoista työotetta.
- Halua oppia uutta ja kykyä ottaa järjestelmät haltuun.
- Valmiutta työskennellä kaikissa vuoroissa myymälöiden kaikkina aukioloaikoina, myös viikonloppuisin ja juhlapyhinä.
- Suomen kielen taitoa ja ruotsin kieli katsotaan eduksi

Mitä ihan tavallinen työ meillä tarkoittaa?
- Työpaikkaa, johon on kiva tulla ja josta on kiva lähteä kotiin.
- Tiimiä, jossa kaveria ei jätetä ja jossa esihenkilöt ovat mukana arjen tekemisessä.
- Mahdollisuutta kehittyä ja kouluttautua.
- Alennuksia S-ryhmän tuotteista ja palveluista – ruoasta, juomasta, meikeistä, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista ja paljon muusta.
- Kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi- ja liikuntaetuja.

Palkkaus
- Kaupan työehtosopimuksen mukaista palkkausta (10,89 €/h – 14,57 €/h), johon vaikuttavat kokemuksesi ja koulutuksesi.
- 5 % kielilisä, jos asiakaspalvelu onnistuu vähintään suomeksi ja ruotsiksi.
- Mahdollisuuden koko henkilökunnan yhteiseen jopa 1,70 €/ tehty työtunti tulospalkkioon yrityksen tuloksen ja toimialakohtaisten mittareiden perusteella.

Kiinnostuitko?
Etenemme rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana, joten jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään sunnuntaina 11.10.2026. Tarkempia tietoja tehtävästä antaa toimipaikkapäälliköt Sara Pulli ja Janica Venäläinen (sara.pulli@sok.fi / janica.l.venalainen@sok.fi ). Työsuhde alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

--------------------



FÖRSÄLJARE, SALE LUNDI OCH SALE GAMMELBACKA, 30 H/VECKA, FAST ANSTÄLLNING

Vi söker en försäljare till Sale Lundi och Sale Gammelbacka för en fast anställning på 30 timmar i veckan. Som försäljare arbetar du mångsidigt med butikens olika uppgifter: du betjänar kunder i kassan, plockar upp varor, sköter produktpresentationer och datumkontroller samt ser till att butikerna är rena och trivsamma och att varorna finns tillgängliga. Efter introduktionen känner du till våra produkter och tjänster samt frågor som gäller ägarkundskap och kan berätta om dem för kunderna utifrån deras behov.

Vi på Sale Lundi och Sale Gammelbacka brukar säga att vi har helt vanliga jobb. Det betyder ändå inte att arbetet är tråkigt – tvärtom! Vi erbjuder ett varierande arbete inom kundservice och ett team där vi ställer upp för varandra.

Vi önskar att du:
- Bemöter kunder och kollegor med hjärtat på rätta stället <3
- Har ett energiskt och kundorienterat förhållningssätt samt arbetar initiativrikt och ansvarsfullt.
- Vill lära dig nytt och har förmåga att ta till dig olika system.
- Är beredd att arbeta alla skift under butikernas samtliga öppettider, även veckoslut och helgdagar.
- Har kunskaper i finska; kunskaper i svenska ses som meriter.

Vad innebär ett helt vanligt jobb hos oss?
- En arbetsplats där det är trevligt att komma till jobbet och trevligt att gå hem efter arbetsdagen.
- Ett team där ingen lämnas ensam och där cheferna deltar i det dagliga arbetet.
- Möjligheter att utvecklas och utbilda sig.
- Rabatter på S-gruppens produkter och tjänster – mat, dryck, kosmetik, elektronik, restauranger, hotell och mycket annat.
- Kultur-, välmående- och motionsförmåner.

Lön
- Lön enligt kollektivavtalet för handelsbranschen (10,89 €/h–14,57 €/h), beroende på din erfarenhet och utbildning.
- Ett språktillägg på 5 % om du kan betjäna kunder på åtminstone finska och svenska.
- Möjlighet till en gemensam resultatbonus för hela personalen på upp till 1,70 € per arbetad timme, utifrån företagets resultat och branschspecifika mätare.

Intresserad?
Vi går vidare med rekryteringen redan under ansökningstiden, så lämna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, dock senast söndagen den 11.10.2026. Närmare information om uppgiften ger enhetscheferna Sara Pulli och Janica Venäläinen (sara.pulli@sok.fi / janica.l.venalainen@sok.fi ). Anställningen börjar enligt överenskommelse.

jobs.title: Forklift Driver (trukkikuski) to Föglö, Åland Islands for the Fish Industry, 7mo fixed term ,
jobs.description:
--- *Suomeksi alla* ---

We are now looking for a forklift driver for a fixed term position with good possibility to continue further in the island of Föglö, Åland.

The job involves operating a forklift in various stages of production and storage, such as moving products, loading and unloading cargo, and ensuring the smooth flow of materials in the production area. The forklift in use is a counterbalanced electric forklift (brand: Linde). The work requires good precision, initiative, and the ability to operate safely in a busy environment. The working conditions are cool, around +2 – +6°C, so readiness to work in cold conditions is important. You will also drive the forklift on a slightly sloped yard. If necessary, you can also participate in other production-supporting tasks. At Kalaneuvos, you will become part of a skilled and truly collaborative "work family".

Who is this job suitable for?
We are looking for a communicative person who is capable of working independently and is not afraid to take initiative. Previous experience in operating a forklift is a requirement for this job. You will receive comprehensive training on the specific forklift model and the work environment. The job is suitable for someone who enjoys being close to nature, as the workplace is located on Föglö Island, in a scenic archipelago. You should be able to communicate in English to ensure smooth communication within the team.

- Working hours: 20-37,5h/weekk
- Salary: approx. 12,50-14,00 EUR/h in the beginning, depending on experience
- Collective agreement: Food Industry collective agreement
- Employment: through Bolt
- Start date: flexible according to agreement
- The role has possibility to advance into bigger role

Information about the workplace and practical arrangements:
Föglö does not have city services: the island has K-extra, a library, and a gym, while other city services can be found in Mariehamn, 35 minutes by ferry + 30 minutes by car. You can also manage without a car on the island, as the workplace is close to accommodation and there is a bus to Mariehamn. If desired, we can arrange accommodation for you: you will typically stay with another employee in a two- or three-room apartment, and the rent is around 300-450 EUR, which may or may not include electricity/water, depending on the apartment (you will receive exact information with the job offer).

About Kalaneuvos:
Kalaneuvos is the largest player in the Finnish fish industry and a pioneer in fish processing, fish wholesale, fish import and export, and fish farming. Kalaneuvos has been producing high-quality fish products for over 40 years, focusing not only on product quality but also on modern production methods and employee well-being. The Kalaneuvos brand offers a wide range of delicious fish products. For more information: www.kalaneuvos.fi

Please apply for the job soon: the position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

--- SUOMEKSI ---

Haemme nyt trukkikuskia määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen luonnonhelmaan Ahvenanmaan Föglön saareen.

Työtehtäviin kuuluu trukin käyttö tuotannon ja varaston eri työvaiheissa, kuten tuotteiden siirtäminen, kuormien lastaus ja purku, sekä materiaalivirran sujuvuuden varmistaminen tuotantoalueella. Käytössä oleva trukki on vastapainoinen sähkötrukki (merkki: Linde). Työ vaatii hyvää tarkkuutta, oma-aloitteisuutta sekä kykyä toimia turvallisesti kiireisessä ympäristössä. Työskentelytilat ovat viileät, noin +2 – +6°C, joten valmius työskennellä kylmässä on tärkeää. Ajat trukkia myös hieman kaltevalla pihalla. Tarpeen mukaan voit osallistua myös muihin tuotantoa tukeviin työtehtäviin. Kalaneuvoksella pääset osaksi ammattitaitoista ja todellakin yhteen hiileen puhaltavaa "työperhettä".

Kenelle työ sopii?
Etsimme kommunikaatiotaitoista ja itsenäiseen työskentelyyn kykenevää henkilöä, joka ei pelkää tarttua toimeen. Aiempi kokemus trukin käytöstä on vaatimuksena tälle työlle. Saat toki kattavan perehdytyksen kyseiseen trukkimalliin sekä työympäristöön. Työ sopii luonnon läheiselle henkilölle, sillä työpaikka sijaitsee Föglön saarella, saaristomaisemissa. Puhuthan englantia, jotta kommunikaatio työporukassa sujuu ongelmitta.

- Työtunnit: 20-37,5h/vko
- Palkkaus: n. 12,50-14,00eur/h, kokemuksen mukaan
- Työehtosopimus: Elintarvikealan TES
- Työsuhde: Boltin kautta
- Aloitus joustavasti sopimuksen mukaan
- Roolissa on hyvä mahdollisuus edetä

Tietoa työskentelypaikkakunnasta ja käytännön järjestelyissä:
Föglössä ei ole kaupungin palveluita: saarella on K-extra, kirjasto ja kuntosali, ja muutoin kaupungin palvelut löytyvät esim. Maarianhaminasta, 35min lauttamatkan ja 30min ajomatkan päästä. Saarella pärjää myös ilman autoa, sillä työpaikka on lähellä majoitusta ja Maarianhaminaan pääsee bussilla. Halutessasi järjestämme sinulle majoituksen: majoitut tyypillisesti toisen työntekijän kanssa rivitalokaksiossa tai -kolmiossa, ja vuokra on n. 300-450eur, ja sisältää, tai ei sisällä sähköä / vettä, riippuen asunnosta (saat tarkan tiedon työtarjouksen yhteydessä).

Tietoa Kalaneuvoksesta:
Kalaneuvos on Suomen kalateollisuuden suurin toimija ja alan edelläkävijä kalanjalostuksessa, kalatukkukaupassa, kalan tuonnissa ja viennissä sekä kalankasvatuksessa. Kalaneuvos on valmistanut korkealaatuisia kalatuotteita jo yli 40 vuoden ajan panostaen tuotteiden laadun lisäksi nykyaikaisiin tuotantomenetelmiin sekä henkilöstön hyvinvointiin. Kalaneuvos-brändin alta löytyy laaja valikoima herkullisia kalatuotteita. Lisätietoja: www.kalaneuvos.fi

Haethan työpaikkaa pian: paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

jobs.title: Toimitusketjupäällikkö, Tammer Diesel
jobs.description:
_Tammer Diesel on Tampereella vuonna 1954 perustettu perheyritys. Se palvelee kolmella paikkakunnalla keskittyen erityisosaamiseensa moottoreihin ja niiden liikuttamien ajoneuvojen huoltotarpeisiin. Tammer Diesel tarjoaa koko Suomen laajuiset moottoripalvelut yksittäisten moottorin osien kunnostuksesta, moottorien peruskorjaukseen ja vaihtomoottoreihin. Sen lisäksi kaikilta paikkakunnilta löytyy kovan luokan auto-osaamista paikallisesti kausihuolloista vaativiin korjauksiin asti. Tammer Diesel työllistää noin 70 henkilöä ja liikevaihto on noin 12 milj. €. Lue lisää_ **_www.tammerdiesel.fi_**

Etsimme nyt **TOIMITUSKETJUPÄÄLLIKKÖÄ** uuteen tehtävään Tampereelle.

Toimitusketjupäällikkönä saat kokonaisvastuun hankintojen, logistiikan ja vaihto-omaisuuden hallinnasta sekä niihin liittyvien prosessien jatkuvasta kehittämisestä. Kuulut johtoryhmään, raportoit toimitusjohtajalle ja sinulla on aito mahdollisuus vaikuttaa siihen, miten tehokkaasti ja kannattavasti yritys toimii. Etsimme prosessiajattelijaa ja käytännön kehittäjää, joka ottaa haltuun materiaalivirrat, rakentaa toimivat prosessit sekä hyödyntää sujuvasti ERP-järjestelmää.

**Tehtävässä vastaat:**

\- hankintojen kokonaisuudesta (hallittu toimittajakokonaisuus, sopimukset, ehdot, materiaalien oikea aikainen saatavuus)

\- logistiikan kokonaisuuden rakentamisesta kustannustehokkaaksi, ennakoitavaksi ja läpinäkyväksi

\- vaihto-omaisuuden hallinnasta ja varastojen optimoinnista

\- AutoFutur ERP-järjestelmän kehittämisestä, joka on yksi tärkeimmistä työkaluistasi prosessien kehittämiseen (materiaalien hallinta, parametriohjaus, tiedon laatu).

Tehtävässä ei ole suoria alaisia, mutta sinulla on vahva epäsuora johtamis- ja ohjausvastuu. Etsimämme henkilö omaakin hyvät neuvottelu- ja vaikuttamistaidot sekä kyvyn saada ihmiset mukaan muutokseen. Omaat hyvän pelisilmän ja kyvyn lukea eri tilanteita ja ihmisiä. Tuot johtoryhmään näkemyksen toimitusketjun, kustannusten, varaston ja operatiivisen tehokkuuden kehittämisestä.

**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

· kokemusta hankinnasta, tuotannosta, logistiikasta tai toimitusketjusta

· teknistä koulutusta tai vahvaa teknistä työkokemusta

· ymmärrystä varastonhallinnasta

· vahvaa kokemusta ERP-järjestelmistä ja niiden kehittämisestä

· kiinnostusta dataan, järjestelmiin ja parametriohjaukseen

· kokemusta ja näyttöä prosessien kehittämisestä

· ymmärrystä konetekniikasta, erityisesti polttomoottoritekniikka osaaminen katsotaan eduksi

· hyviä vuorovaikutus-, neuvottelu- ja vaikuttamistaitoja.

· suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

**Miksi tämä tehtävä on kiinnostava?**

Tammer Dieselillä saat vastuullisen työtehtävän johtoryhmän jäsenenä, jossa pääset rakentamaan jotain, mikä vaikuttaa lähes kaikkeen: kannattavuuteen, kassavirtaan, toimitusvarmuuteen ja asiakastyytyväisyyteen. Saat keskeisen roolin strategisessa työssä ja toimit tiiviisti myös hallituksen kanssa. Työsuhde-etuihin kuuluu kattava vakuutus, liikunta– ja lounasetu sekä huollot ja varaosat henkilökuntahintaan. Päätoimipiste on Tampereella, jossa viihdytään pääosin paikan päällä ja ajoittain työhön kuuluu käyntejä Joensuussa ja Jämsässä sekä toimittajavierailuja. Kyseessä ei kuitenkaan ole jatkuvaa matkustamista vaativa tehtävä.

Jos materiaalivirtojen johtaminen, toiminnan kehittäminen ja tulokseen vaikuttaminen kuulostavat sinun seuraavalta tehtävältäsi, niin jätäthän hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian mutta viimeistään 19.10.2026. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Helmihunter Kati Kulin, puh. +358 40 7160 379.

jobs.title: Kunnossapitoinsinööri. Loimua Oy
jobs.description:
Kunnossapitoinsinöörinä vastaat siitä, että lämpölaitoksemme toimivat turvallisesti, tehokkaasti ja häiriöttä. Työssäsi johdat muutaman hengen tiimiä, kehität kunnossapitoa sekä osallistut kehitys- ja investointihankkeisiin. Saat käyttöösi Loimuan kunnossapidon toiminnanohjausjärjestelmän ja muut työtä tukevat järjestelmätyökalut. Työhönottopaikkasi sijaitsee Oulaisissa, ja tehtävääsi kuuluu liikkuminen alueen muiden toimipisteiden välillä. Työssä on mahdollisuus osallistua varallaoloon.

**Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää** soveltuvaa teknistä koulutusta, oma-aloitteista ja suunnitelmallista työotetta, järjestelmien sujuvaa käyttöä, hyviä yhteistyötaitoja sekä valmiutta esihenkilötyöhön.

**Katsomme eduksesi** kokemuksen lämpö- tai voimalaitoksista, teollisuuden kunnossapidosta (sähkö, automaatio tai mekaaninen) ja kaukolämpöverkoista.

**Miksi Loimua?**

Energia-ala muuttuu vauhdilla, ja me olemme siinä aktiivisesti mukana. Loimualla pääset tekemään työtä, jolla on konkreettinen vaikutus asiakkaidemme arkeen sekä energian tulevaisuuteen.

Meillä saat vastuuta, vapautta ja mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa omaan työhösi. Tukenasi on osaava työyhteisö, jossa onnistumiset syntyvät yhteistyöstä, luottamuksesta ja osaamisen jakamisesta.

Haluamme pitää huolta henkilöstöstämme tarjoamalla kattavat henkilöstöedut, työn ja vapaa-ajan yhteensovittamista tukevat joustavat työaikaratkaisut sekä kannustavat palkitsemisen käytännöt.

Työtämme ohjaavat arvomme: **Yhdessä. Paremmin. Vastuullisesti.**

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro meille, mikä tekee juuri sinusta seuraavan loimualaisen.

**Hakuaika 20.10.2026 saakka**

**Ilmoitathan hakemuksessa palkkatoiveesi**

jobs.title: Automekaanikko
jobs.description:
Kokenut automekaanikko – JV Autoasi

JV Autoasi etsii kokenutta automekaanikkoa henkilöautojen huolto-, korjaus- ja vianhakutöihin.

Etsimme mekaanikkoa, joka pystyy työskentelemään itsenäisesti, huolellisesti ja vastuullisesti. Työssä tarvitaan hyvää mekaanista osaamista sekä kykyä käyttää diagnostiikkalaitteita ja suorittaa vianhakua itsenäisesti.

**Työtehtäviin kuuluu mm.:**

- henkilöautojen huolto- ja korjaustyöt

- jarru- ja alustatyöt

- jakopää- ja muut mekaaniset korjaukset

- diagnostiikka ja vianhaku

- koeajot ja korjauksen jälkeiset tarkastukset

- tehtyjen töiden ja havaintojen dokumentointi


**Odotamme sinulta:**

- aikaisempaa kokemusta automekaanikon työstä

- kykyä tehdä töitä itsenäisesti

- diagnostiikkalaitteiden hallintaa

- kykyä selvittää vikoja järjestelmällisesti

- vastuullista suhtautumista työn laatuun ja turvallisuuteen

- B-ajokorttia


**Katsomme eduksi:**

- autoelektroniikan ja sähköjärjestelmien tuntemuksen

- sähkökaavioiden lukutaidon

- kokemuksen sähkövikojen paikantamisesta

- kokemuksen vaativammasta diagnostiikasta


**Palkka:** noin **18–23 €/h**, riippuen kokemuksesta ja käytännön osaamisesta. Lopullinen palkkataso määritellään osaamisen perusteella. Erityisesti itsenäinen diagnostiikka, sähköosaaminen ja vahva tekninen ongelmanratkaisukyky vaikuttavat palkkatasoon.

Työsuhteen laajuudesta voidaan sopia erikseen. Mahdollinen kokoaikainen tai osa-aikainen työ.

JV Autoasissa mekaanikko keskittyy tekniseen työhön. Asiakasyhteydenpidosta, lisätöiden hyväksyttämisestä ja hinnoittelusta vastaa työnjohto.

Lähetä lyhyt hakemus ja CV osoitteeseen: **myynti@jvautoasi.com**

Kerro hakemuksessa lyhyesti:

- työkokemuksestasi

- mitä töitä pystyt tekemään itsenäisesti

- kokemuksestasi diagnostiikasta

- palkkatoiveesi

- milloin voisit aloittaa

jobs.title: Director, Business Development
jobs.description:
Do you want to work for the global leader in the language services and technology industry? Are you interested in helping international brands/organizations find and implement solutions that allow them to communicate, operate and sell their products and services efficiently and effectively? And are you the type of person who enjoys an integrity focused, fast-paced, entrepreneurial, innovative, vibrant environment? Then we'd like to hear from you!

TransPerfect was founded with a mission to help the world's businesses navigate the global marketplace. Today, we have grown to be an industry leader organization by helping clients globalize their business no matter what service they might need. TransPerfect provides a full array of language and business support services, including translation, subtitling and dubbing, multicultural marketing, website globalization, legal support, and any kind of technology solution.

That’s enough about us – what about you? We look for and appreciate anyone who is willing to roll up their sleeves and get stuck in! We offer a fast growth path for career and personal development and provide full training around our services, technology solutions and workflows. Therefore the key skills we are looking for are solid communication and relationship building abilities, keeping a cool head under pressure and really owning your role, taking responsibility for your clients and their business success.

TransPerfect is looking for established sales professionals to further develop our engagement model. The Director of Business Development will be responsible for identifying and engaging with client prospects as well as managing client relationships during the full life cycle of client campaigns. Minimum 3 years experience in a similar role required.

Key position responsibilities:

  • Source and close new clients through referrals, cold calling, networking, and other means (tradeshows, regional organizations, etc.)

  • Build a productive pipeline and manage each phase of the sales process

  • Cultivate and maintain long term relationships with clients by delivering elite client service and engaging them by using knowledge of each industry and organization

  • Formulate sales plan to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets

  • Generate daily outreach efforts (direct mail, digital marketing, cold calls) to prospective clients

  • Develop an effective understanding of the capabilities, benefits, and competitive advantages of TransPerfect's services

  • Present TransPerfect's solutions via one-on-one, group, online and in-person meetings

  • Set and manage client expectations while consulting with each client for best practices

  • Manage and control pricing and contractual issues

  • Travel (including multiple annual conferences, client meetings) - domestic and/or international


Essential skills required:

  • Commit to a high level of integrity and service

  • Deliver quality work

  • Service focused with a desire to exceed clients’ expectations

  • Owning your performance and taking responsibility

  • Multitask and work with a sense of urgency in a fast-paced environment

  • Commit to always treating everyone (from clients to co-workers to vendors to business partners) with the ultimate level of respect

  • Work well in a team with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with clients and co-workers

  • Celebrate diversity and embrace new ideas and differing perspectives

  • Be financially responsible and make sound financial decisions

  • Take active measures to achieve results and solve problems

Essential experience required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

  • Minimum 3 years successful sales experience

  • Superior written and spoken communication skills in German and English

  • Familiarity and ability to communicate value and competitive advantages

TransPerfect values equal opportunities. Applicants are therefore considered regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnic origin, skin colour, religion, belief, descent, genes, disabilities, sexual orientation, marital status or other characteristics worthy of protection. Applicants with disabilities are welcome and encouraged. jobs.title: Account Executive, Enterprise
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 25,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America and Europe, and now expanding across Asia Pacific. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the past few years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become the default tool of choice for many of the world’s best product teams. We are now layering a product-led sales motion on top of our existing self-serve business to further accelerate our ambitions and bring the magic of Linear to even more and larger companies. You’ll play an instrumental role in defining our enterprise sales motion, contribute to the future of our product, and help high-impact companies build better software.

Location & work mode

While Linear is a remote-first company across the US and Europe, this role in APAC is office based 2–3 days per week, as this role will be closely connected to in-person collaboration with our growing sales presence in the region.

What you'll do

 - Become a product expert and help customers use Linear effectively; assist prospects through the trial and evaluation phase

 - Generate a strong pipeline and exceed quarterly targets

 - Stay up to date with our product offering, industry trends, competitive landscape, and market trends to continuously adapt sales strategies and approaches for maximum impact

 - Build relationships with key stakeholders within accounts; understand client needs deeply, align Linear’s solutions to business objectives + shape decision criteria. Effectively communicate and align our value proposition to decision-makers

 - Be the voice of the customer; advocate for customers by surfacing product or adoption blockers to our product team

 - Help build the foundation and define our enterprise sales process

Requirements

 - 3+ years selling to the enterprise, and 7+ years in a quota-carrying sales role

 - Experience selling a technical product to both engineering and product leadership; bonus if you have experience selling collaboration or project management software

 - SaaS and startup experience; comfortable working and adapting in a fast-paced and flexible environment

 - Ability to understand complex client needs, craft tailored discovery, and drive sales through consultative approaches.

 - Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and product demonstration skills

 - Highly autonomous with a bias for action. Owner’s mindset to quickly come up to speed on product, market, ICP, and unique differentiators.

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

jobs.title: Gestionnaire des stocks (m/f)
jobs.description:
Au sein du service achat et en collaboration avec le service montage et le service dépannage, sous la supervision du Responsable achats, vous gérez et optimisez la gestion des stocks (entrées et sorties des marchandises) pour minimiser le niveau de stocks sans risquer la rupture. Vous aurez en charge de gérer les magasiniers.

Vos tâches et missions :

Vous gérez les différents stocks à partir d'un programme informatisé :
• Organisation des stocks : classement et rangement du matériel commandé de façon ordonnée et logique
• Visualisation et optimisation du flux de marchandises
• Approvisionnement des stocks
• Contrôle de l'accès aux stocks
• Propreté des stocks et du parc de recyclage
• Mise en place des inventaires mensuels et annuels

Vous supervisez et contrôlez les entrées et sorties de stock :
• Réceptions et livraisons de matériel, équipements, fournitures, etc.
• Contrôle de la qualité de la marchandise reçue
• Remontée et signalement des problèmes
• Transmission de l'arrivée de la commande au bon service

Vous préparez le matériel à livrer / pour les chantiers :
• Vérification du matériel pour chaque chantier
• Préparation des éléments annexes et de l'approvisionnement en consommables

Votre profil :
• Expérience minimale de 5 ans comme gestionnaire des stocks / magasinier
• Excellentes connaissances de la gestion des espaces et du stock
• Bonnes connaissances des logiciels de gestion et d'inventaire
• Connaissance du domaine de la fermeture extérieure / serrurerie (atout)
• Sens de l'organisation, de la planification et des priorités
• Être réactif et doté d'un sens inné de l'adaptation
• Faire preuve de persévérance
• Être résistant au stress
• Suivi des formations continues sur les produits et techniques en constante évolution dans le secteur de la menuiserie extérieure / serrurerie
• Suivi des formations sur les processus et procédures internes de la société

jobs.title: IT Systems & Cloud Infrastructure Administrator (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description des tâches:

Starting Date:  Start Immediately
Job Type:  UNLIMITED

IT Systems & Cloud Infrastructure Administrator

With our groundbreaking satellite 5G constellation, OQ Technology is a global leader in the domain of IoT communication connectivity and associated services. We are a venture capital-backed company with a successful track record of satellite launches and the first company in the world to disrupt the telecommunications industry by merging cellular 5G with satellites.
Our technology has massive implications for the Oil & Gas, Maritime, Industry 4.0, and Transport sectors, particularly in the management and tracking of assets in remote and rural areas and in extending 5G coverage through non-terrestrial networks.
As our wireless technologies continue to evolve and earn multiple awards, with funding for the next phase secured and strong commercial traction demonstrated, we are now looking to onboard an experienced IT Systems & Cloud Infrastructure Administrator to strengthen and manage our cloud-first IT infrastructure.
In this role, you will be responsible for managing and supporting our modern IT environment across Microsoft 365/Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and virtualization platforms, ensuring the security, availability, scalability, and reliability of our systems. You will play a key role in maintaining a secure, resilient, and well-documented infrastructure, driving infrastructure modernization initiatives, supporting users across the organization, and enabling the continued growth and success of OQ Technology.

Job Responsibilities

• Administer and support all types of endpoints (Windows, Mac, Linux, and mobile) across the organization.
• Manage and support Microsoft Azure cloud services, including Microsoft 365, Entra ID, conditional access, backups, and monitoring.
• Manage identity, access, and device management (Entra ID, Intune, MDM).
• Support secure collaboration tools (Microsoft 365, file sharing, conferencing), SharePoint Online administration, and licensing management (including CSP/NCE transitions).
• Maintain and optimize virtualization platforms (Proxmox or other hypervisors) and containerized environments where applicable.
• Manage and support AWS infrastructure, including provisioning, monitoring, and maintaining EC2 instances and related resources.
• Handle user and access management on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
• Support and maintain secure remote access (OpenVPN, bastion hosts, jump servers) and general network infrastructure (switches, firewalls, VLANs, routing).
• Support system availability, performance, patching, and lifecycle management across cloud platforms.
• Manage backup and disaster recovery operations using Veeam, ensuring reliable backup jobs, retention policies, and recovery testing.
• Maintain and support self-hosted or cloud-based GitHub/GitLab instances, including user access, repository administration, and general upkeep.
• Apply security-by-design principles across all IT systems; support compliance with relevant standards (e.g. ISO 27001) and internal security policies.
• Assist with vulnerability management, patching, audits, and risk assessments.
• Participate in infrastructure planning, upgrades, and modernization initiatives.
• Troubleshoot complex system and virtualization issues across cloud environments.
• Provide Level 2/3 escalation support for the helpdesk team and end users.
• Document system configurations, procedures, architectures, and operational standards.
• Manage IT-related purchases (hardware, software licenses, cloud credits) in collaboration with procurement, and track asset lifecycle to optimize spend.
• Develop working knowledge of Linux systems and assist with Linux-based workloads as needed.

Skills, Experience & Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience as a Systems Administrator or in a comparable IT infrastructure/operations role in a corporate environment.
• Strong hands-on experience with Azure/Microsoft 365 administration (Entra ID, SharePoint Admin Center, conditional access, licensing).
• Solid understanding of virtualization concepts (Proxmox, Hyper-V, or similar).
• Experience managing AWS resources (EC2 instances and related services); familiarity with GCP user/access management is a plus.
• Solid networking knowledge, including OpenVPN administration, switches, firewalls, VLANs, and routing (TCP/IP).
• Experience with backup, disaster recovery, and system monitoring solutions (Veeam experience is a strong plus).
• Comfortable working with enterprise ticketing systems (e.g. Jira, ServiceNow, Zendesk) for incident and request management.
• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with a preference for clear, GUI-driven administration tools where practical.
• Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Excellent documentation skills — comfortable producing clear operational guides and handover documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting or administering Linux systems, or strong willingness to learn.
• Familiarity with scripting and automation (PowerShell, Bash, or comparable) as a complement to GUI-based administration.
• Exposure to containerization (Docker) and infrastructure automation tools (Ansible, Terraform).
• Familiarity with maintaining GitHub/GitLab instances (user management, repository administration).
• Experience working within an international organization, comfortable navigating diverse cultures and multiple time zones.
• Relevant certifications (Microsoft, Azure) are a plus.

Additional Information:

As part of the recruitment process, candidates may be required to provide a criminal record certificate issued within the last three (3) months.

What We Offer

• A hands-on role with ownership across the full cloud IT stack and security.
• Direct exposure to infrastructure modernization and licensing/procurement decisions.
• Flexibility to work remotely one day per week
• Opportunity to work on flagship EU space mission projects.
• A dynamic, high-growth environment with career development opportunities.
• Regular company events and team activities.

Telecom R&D Engineer - NTN

With our groundbreaking satellite 5G constellation, OQ Technology is a global leader in IoT connectivity and next-generation satellite communication services. As a venture-backed company with a proven track record of satellite launches, we are the first in the world to integrate cellular 5G with satellites, enabling seamless connectivity for devices in remote and underserved regions. Our technology supports transformative applications across industries such as Oil & Gas, Maritime, Industry 4.0, and Transport, extending reliable connectivity through Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN). To support the continued development of our advanced telecommunications platform, we are looking for a Telecom R&D Engineer - NTN to join our team. In this role, you will contribute to the development and optimization of 3GPP-based protocol stacks and NTN adaptations for NB-IoT, LTE, and 5G NR technologies, helping bring cutting-edge satellite connectivity solutions from research to real-world deployment.

Key responsibilities

• Contribute to the research, development, and adaptation of L1/L2/L3 protocol stack components for Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) supporting NB-IoT, LTE, and 5G NR technologies.
• Participate in the full R&D lifecycle, including system design, implementation, integration, testing, and performance optimization.
• Analyze, troubleshoot, and enhance protocol stack behavior across multiple layers, including PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, and NAS.
• Investigate and implement NTN-specific adaptations required for satellite communications, including aspects related to propagation delay, Doppler effects, and timing synchronization.
• Design and execute testing and validation procedures, including unit testing, system integration testing, and performance benchmarking.
• Contribute to software integration and deployment workflows, including continuous integration and version control practices.
• Stay up to date with 3GPP standardization developments (e.g., NTN features in Releases 17/18/19) and contribute to translating standards into practical implementations.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including RF, FPGA, satellite systems, and platform engineering to integrate telecom stacks with hardware and system components.
• Support system-level analysis and debugging, including log analysis, KPI evaluation, and protocol trace inspection.

Basic qualifications

• An academic degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in telecom R&D, preferably working with 3GPP-based wireless systems.
• Solid understanding of 3GPP protocol architecture and procedures in NB-IoT, LTE, or 5G NR.
• Strong programming skills in C/C++, with additional scripting experience in Python for automation and analysis.
• Experience working in Linux/Unix environments with standard development and debugging tools.
• Familiarity with software development workflows, including version control (e.g., Git) and CI/CD practices. • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose complex system-level issues.
• Good communication and collaboration skills in a multidisciplinary engineering environment.
• Proficiency in spoken and written English.
• IMPORTANT: Candidate must already reside in Europe or hold a valid European residence permit.

Preferred skills and experience

• Hands-on experience with 3GPP wireless systems, particularly NB-IoT, LTE, or 5G NR implementations.
• Experience working with NTN architectures and protocol adaptations defined in 3GPP specifications.
• Practical experience analyzing and modifying protocol stack components across L1/L2/L3 layers (PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, NAS).
• Familiarity with core network signalling protocols, such as S1AP, NGAP, and GTP-C/U.
• Experience working with software-defined radio platforms (e.g., USRP) or open telecom stacks such as srsRAN and OpenAirInterface, or Open5GS and free5GC.
• Knowledge of O-RAN architecture and functional split concepts.
• Familiarity with Small Cell Forum (SCF) interfaces, including FAPI/nFAPI.
• Background in embedded or real-time software development, particularly on ARM-based or heterogeneous platforms.
• Experience with protocol debugging, KPI analysis, and system performance optimization in wireless communication systems.

Additional Information:  As part of the recruitment process, candidates may be required to provide a criminal record certificate issued within the last three (3) months.

jobs.title: Same Day Supply Chain Analyst, EU FC Supply Chain Operations (m/f)

Same Day Supply Chain Analyst, EU FC Supply Chain Operations
Job ID: 10560445 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

The Same Day S&OP team is the backbone of faster, smarter delivery solutions that are reshaping the customer experience across Europe. We plan and execute network strategies for rapidly scaling, innovative fulfillment programs, collaborating cross-functionally with Fulfillment Centers, Delivery Stations, Speed, and Finance teams to optimize speed, cost, and efficiency.

We are looking for an analytical and driven Supply Chain Analyst to join our team. In this role, you will own the end-to-end planning and execution for the Same Day network across Micro Fulfillment Centers (MFCs). You will dive deep into data to identify opportunities, solve complex supply chain problems, and drive improvements that directly impact delivery speed and customer satisfaction.

This is a role that blends short-term operational execution with long-term strategic planning. You will work with incomplete data, make high-judgment decisions, and collaborate across multiple teams to shape the future of Same Day delivery in Europe.

Key job responsibilities

1- Own the intra-week planning and execution of the Same Day network, including demand forecasting and inbound planning across MFCs.
2- Analyze large datasets to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities; provide deep dives and models to guide network execution and strategy.
3- Develop and maintain analytical tools, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to support data-driven decision-making.
4- Identify, prioritize, and implement process improvements to eliminate defects and enhance the end-to-end customer experience

Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team which handles more than 1.5 million orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we're always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range – delivered quickly and affordably.

The CF team are the first people in the chain that helps customers get products at the speed we're known for. We're based in Fulfilment Centres, which are at the heart of Amazon's fast-paced Operations network. Our centres are sometimes referred to as the ‘First Mile' because it's where most Amazon packages start their journey. We help to manage dynamic inventory and facilitate speedy deliveries round the clock.

jobs.title: Head of Strategy, Amazon Freight EU (m/f)
jobs.description:
Head of Strategy, Amazon Freight EU
Job ID: 10560220 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Leaders are owners. They think long term for our customers and don't sacrifice long-term value for short-term results. Amazon Freight Europe is looking for just such an owner to lead the strategy for our externalized freight business to design and deliver a world class freight experience for our business customers.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

The Head of Strategy will report directly into the leader of the Amazon Freight Europe business to lead and build out the newly created Strategy team across Europe (including UK). They will be based in Luxembourg, London or Munich to tackle the most hotly debated topics within our startup organization. They will partner closely with Product, Program, Operations and Commercial leaders to identify the challenges and opportunities in our organization, and come up with creative, customer-driven solutions to solve them. The Head of Strategy will work across both the European business and worldwide tech domains to shape our long-term business plan, diving deep with leaders across multiple areas to define customer problems and deliver the solutions.

ABOUT YOU

You're a self-described ‘builder' and ‘fixer' with a passion for figuring out what the future looks like. You have a relentless focus on creating and improving customer value. You're a hands-on multitasker who can quickly change focus and balance the needs of the moment with longer-term goals. You have a high tolerance for ambiguity and complexity. You have resilience and a positive, solutions-oriented attitude – even the toughest challenges are possible with the right amount of creativity, good judgment and hard work. You have strong problem solving, communication and organizational skills and the ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority, along with a good understanding of product development/management and digital media.

You're a leader with a blend of strategy, product management and/or operations experience and have the business acumen to understand and shape Amazon Freight's business-wide roadmap. You achieve your results through other people, often without authority, making complex decisions simple through data and inspire people at all levels in the organization. You proactively identify gaps and risks, and partner with senior leaders in and out of the organization to define creative solutions to solve them. You embody the rare combination of thinker and doer.

YOU WILL.

-Partner with Product, Program, Operations and Commercial teams to oversee strategic business initiatives from development through to successful execution, ensuring that individual function targets are in harmony and resolving those that aren't.
Support colleagues in their decision-making, program management, and initiative implementation, calling out opportunities to double-down and the unseen risks.
-Review, design, and execute improvements to organizational structure; find knowledge and skills gaps and help address them.
-Improve current processes and review organization-wide procedures for efficiency and productivity.
-Control the output of shared-services functions to ensure that outsourced tasks deliver to the high expectations of our Amazon Freight customers.

Key job responsibilities

•Ensure department goals are well integrated with each other and control organization-wide success, identifying areas to invest, double down or repair.
•Influence wider Amazon teams to secure collaborative, efficient solutions for our customers, re-using existing capabilities wherever possible.
•Build long term strategic plans, working alongside our product team, who specifies new products and features, our tech team that builds them, our operations that deliver them, our commercial team that sells them as well as the Amazon Freight teams outside EU.
•Stay close to the operational realities of our business, recognizing that what we will build has its foundation in the work of our Associates and partners on sites and in vehicles.
•This includes organizational design to help build our future team structures whilst securing support to our team for new hires, including documentation, onboarding, and learning and development team.
•Develop and build relationships with all employees for increased efficiency and responsiveness of existing operations, and help define new operational strategies by working with EU AF Director and other executives on special projects.

A day in the life

- Build relationships with our customers (shippers).
- Coach and mentor business developers within the team.
- Define business development KPIs targets and manage performance against these KPIs.
- Dive deep into shippers' requirements and pain points to find solutions.

About the team

At Amazon Freight, we blend advanced technology with Amazon's network of 6,500+ owned trailers and 13,000+ trusted carrier partners across UK & EU to move freight-simply and reliably. We apply the same customer obsession that we are known for in the consumer business to the Business to Business segment, aiming to partner with our customers to meet the demands of today while helping to navigate the road ahead. The team is diverse and intercultural with passionate members with a team-focused attitude. Across Amazon, we have committed to reach net-zero carbon by 2040, ten years ahead of the Paris Agreement and we take this commitment seriously in Amazon Freight too. We're not there yet but if this sounds interesting, maybe you can help us get there.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in team management
- Bachelor's degree or above
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Seven or more years of senior experience in a business management or operations management role.
- Experience in organizing and directing multiple teams and departments in a multi-matrixed environment.
- Experience in planning and leading strategic initiatives.
- Strong alignment with our leadership principles, particularly Customer Obsession, Think Big and Strive to be Earth's Best Employer.

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree or above in management, business administration, economics, engineering, marketing
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, and data interpretation of results
- Experience coordinating between project teams and customers to meet unique customer requirements
- Experience in a high-performance start-up or incubation effort within a larger company

Would you like to build technology products that help shape Amazon's transition toward a more circular economy? Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) regulations are rapidly changing how producers and retailers manage products and packaging after sale, including recycling obligations, fees, reporting, seller compliance, and reverse logistics. Amazon is building the technology and operating mechanisms required to manage these obligations at global scale while creating the foundation for broader circularity services.

As a Principal Product Manager – Technical, you will define and lead the product strategy for some of Amazon's most complex sustainability and regulatory challenges. You will help determine where Amazon should build common global platforms versus localized solutions, establish mechanisms that improve accuracy and reduce manual effort, and shape new services that can support both compliance and circular-economy objectives.

Description

At Amazon, safety is our top priority. We are looking for a WHS Risk Engineer to own machinery safety across multiple sites. In this role you will lead machinery safety inspections and risk assessments, apply the EU Machinery Directive and harmonised standards, and influence engineering and operations leaders to build safe-by-design into our equipment and processes. - Lead machinery safety inspections and risk assessments across multiple sites.
- Apply and interpret the EU Machinery Directive (2006/42/EC) and associated harmonised standards.
- Identify machinery and MHE risks and drive the implementation of effective control measures.

Are you passionate about using data to drive business decisions at massive scale? EU Vendor Intelligence is looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer to help power Amazon's growth and profitability across European markets.

In this role, you will tackle difficult, loosely defined business problems across key retail programs including Selection and Vendor Management. You'll work in an environment that values high-quality, well-documented solutions - and gives you the autonomy to deliver them.

• Own the design, build, and maintenance of mid-to-large BI solutions - data models, ETL pipelines, dashboards, and analyses — supporting EU Stores retail programs such as Selection and Vendor Management
• Write advanced SQL and Python to solve difficult, loosely defined analytical problems and automate recurring BI processes

jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager, Regulatory Intelligence, Safety, and Compliance (RISC) - Sustainability
Job ID: 10558293 | Amazon EU Sarl - A84

Description

Amazon is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the EU Digital Product Passport (DPP) product end-to-end. The DPP is a foundational regulatory obligation under the EU Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (ESPR) - and a significant strategic opportunity for Amazon. As product owner, you will define the vision and roadmap and translate a fast-moving regulatory landscape into concrete product requirements.
This is a builder role for someone who thrives in ambiguity. The problem space is not fully defined: regulations are still being finalized, harmonised technical standards are emerging, and Amazon's approach must be invented from first principles. You will set the goals, make the one-way and two-way door calls, and drive clarity across teams that have competing priorities. You will hold an honest tension between what the regulation requires and what creates durable value for customers and the business.

Success looks like: a defensible product strategy grounded in the regulation; a data pipeline and attribute framework that scale across product categories; on-time delivery of mandatory obligations; and DPP data positioned as a reusable asset that unlocks value across Amazon beyond pure compliance.

Key job responsibilities

* Own the DPP product vision, strategy, and roadmap.
* Translate regulation into product requirements.
* Shape the DPP data pipeline alongside engineering.
* Manage stakeholders and communicate with precision.
* Own DPP metrics and reporting.
* Extend DPP value beyond compliance.
* Operate AI-first. Encode product judgment, tenets, and trade-off frameworks into durable, machine-readable artifacts, and use AI to compress research, synthesis, and drafting cycles — owning the outcome and applying judgment to what ships.

About the team

The EU Digital Product Passport team sits within Amazon RISC International and owns Amazon's response to one of the most consequential product-compliance shifts in the EU. A Digital Product Passport is a structured, verifiable record of a product's attributes — origin, composition, sustainability, and circularity data - accessible via a data carrier such as a QR code. Under ESPR and its delegated acts, DPPs become mandatory on a rolling schedule by product category, starting with batteries and extending to textiles, toys, and beyond.
Beyond the regulatory mandate, the team is charting how DPP data can become a strategic asset across Amazon - for example, powering Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) eco-modulation, enriching the catalog, and serving as a single source of truth that auto-populates downstream compliance requirements. The person in this role helps define that ambition and turn it into a shippable roadmap.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
- Experience in technical product management, program management or engineering
- Experience owning feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience with end to end product delivery

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
- Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
