jobs.title: Head of Legal Finland
jobs.description:
**The opportunity**

Hitachi Energy is looking for a high-calibre legal counsel to work as Head of Legal for the legal entity in Finland and strengthen Hitachi Energy's global legal team by providing legal advice to all business units in Finland with an oversight role for Baltics. You will bring your legal know-how to diverse tasks, and ensure all contractual activities are executed in accordance with the relevant regulations and instructions as well as local statutory provisions. Reporting to Head of Legal Europe, the successful candidate will implement global strategy and advise local management and business units on a wide range of legal and integrity issues.

The preferred working location for this role is Helsinki or Vaasa, with the possibility to work in hybrid model. This role may require some domestic and overseas travelling occasionally. The position is open as the present Head of Legal Finland takes the next step in his career.

**How you'll make an impact**

- Provide expert legal advice over a broad range of issues affecting different business units, especially for contracts and tenders. In addition, legal advice to projects under execution within the business units.

- Proactively develop effective legal strategies, mitigation actions and practical solutions in support of business activities.

- Negotiate acceptable contract terms with customers, liaising with all internal stakeholders in the process, including risk review processes.

- Promote dispute avoidance and manage disputes and litigations with all internal and external stakeholders.

- Ensures excellent corporate governance and management of the operational company at country level.

- Support strong implementation of the Code of Ethic and Business Conduct and assist with investigation and resolution of integrity-related issues.

- Be an active member of the local Country Management Team and member of the local Board of Directors.

- Act as a local contact point for data privacy matters in close co-operation with the global Privacy Team.

- Design and deliver training on contractual and legal aspects.

- Be an active member of the global Legal and Integrity community and support the global team when needed.

- Manage and lead one direct report (Legal Counsel).

- Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.


**Your background**

- University Law Degree (Master of Law).

- Finnish and English language skills.

- Strong interest in technology and process improvement.

- Strong experience 7-10 years relating to, for example, major construction/ engineering projects and track record of handling complex international corporate and commercial transactions as well as claims and litigations. Experience in YSE 1998, FIDIC, NL/NLM and Orgalim general terms and conditions is a benefit.

- Committed, business-minded and solution-oriented. Well-developed communication, self-confidence, strong decision-making capability, and interpersonal skills including team spirit as well as the ability to influence at all levels.

jobs.title: Green Office - Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
About the position 

The UiO Green Office is looking for a student employee to help strengthen sustainability engagement across student life, education, and research at the University of Oslo.

This position is part of two of our working groups; Education & Research and Dissemination & Dialogue work. They work to connect students, student organizations and researchers to strengthen sustainability engagement at UiO.


Qualifications

Previous experience or education related to organizational work or education is an advantage. You must be enrolled as a UiO student throughout 2026 and 2027

Key responsibilities and tasks include:

  • Collaborating with the Student Parliament, student organizations and other sustainability initiatives.
  • Promoting sustainability-related education and research at UiO
  • Contributing to larger events such as the SDG conference, theme weeks and national and international Green Office networks
  • Supporting projects that connect students, faculties, and researchers

Personal skills

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has an interest in sustainability education and research and student engagement
  • Can work independently and take responsibility for projects
  • Enjoys working collaboratively in a team

  • Has strong organizational skills

    It is an advantage if you have experience with:

  • Student organizations, politics (i.e. program committee), volunteer work, or project coordination.
  • Event planning, communication, or outreach activities

We offer 
  • A 20-30% position (depending on your capacity) 
  • Salary NOK 425 000 - per year for a full-time position (pro-rated for 20–30%).
  • Practical experience with sustainability projects and collaboration across the university
  • Practical experience in sustainability and project development
  • An engaging, creative, and supportive work environment
  • Opportunities to shape sustainability initiatives at UiO
  • Valuable experience in teamwork, leadership, and stakeholder collaboration

Inclusive worklife and diversity at UiO

Inclusion and diversity are a strength. The University of Oslo has a personnel policy objective of achieving a balanced gender composition. Furthermore, we want employees with diverse professional expertise, life experience and perspectives.

If there are qualified applicants with disabilities, employment gaps or immigrant background, we will invite at least one applicant from each of these categories to an interview.

We hope that you will apply for the position. 


How to apply

Please submit:

  • A CV
  • A short motivation letter (approximately one page)
  • A reference person (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number) is positive, but not a requirement. 

In your motivation letter, we would like you to reflect briefly on:

  • Why would you like to work at the Green Office?
  • How would you engage students and student organizations in sustainability work at UiO?
  • What experience, skills, or interests would you bring to this role?
  • Describe an initiative, project, or collaboration that you are proud of contributing to.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

About the Green Office

The Green Office is UiO's student-driven hub for sustainability initiatives (Green Office - University of Oslo).. We develop projects, events, and collaborations that help make the university more sustainable while creating opportunities for students to get involved. Our team is organized into four working groups that reflect the themes of UiO's Climate and Environmental Strategy (Comprehensive Climate and Environmental Strategy - University of Oslo).

jobs.title: Kiinteistönhoitajaksi Kiinteistö Oy Kajaanin Pietarille
jobs.description:
Kiinteistö Oy Kajaanin Pietari etsii aktiivisen työotteen ja palveluasenteen omaavaa, ammattitaitoista kiinteistönhoitajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Valittava henkilö tulee hoitamaan nimettyjen asuntokohteiden kiinteistönhoitajan tehtäviä. Tehtävän keskeinen sisältö alla:

A. Palkkaus: Kiinteistöhoitajan mediaanipalkka on noin 2.500 euroa/kk (keskiarvo on palkkatilaston mukaan noin 2.785 euroa/kk). Palkka tarkentuu valittavan henkilön koulutuksen ja kokemuksen perusteella. Jos henkilö osallistuu päivystystehtäviin, maksetaan päivystämisestä erilliskorvaus TESin mukaisesti (varallaolo ja ylityöt).

B. Noudatettava työehtosopimus: Kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimus, jossa palkka määräytyy tehtävän vaativuusluokan (PR-ryhmät 1–10) mukaan. Kajaanin Pietarilla työntekijöillä on ns. pitkät lomat, eli lomaa kuluu 5 arkipäivää/viikko (muutoin yksityissektorilla 5+1 päivää/viikko).

C. Tehtävään vaadittava koulutus: Puhtaus- ja kiinteistöpalvelualan perustutkinto, jonka laajuus on 180 osaamispistettä ja kesto yleensä 2–3 vuotta. Tai vastaava koulutus.

D. Osaamisvaateet: LVI-järjestelmien (lämmitys, vesi, ilmanvaihto) kunnossapito ja seuranta; huolto- ja korjaustyöt = rakennustekniset korjaukset, koneiden käyttö ja pienehköt kunnossapitotyöt; ulkoalueiden hoito: piha-alueiden puhtaanapito, käsilumityöt; asiakaspalvelu = asukkaiden ja kiinteistön käyttäjien opastus (edellyttää hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja); IT-taidot (toimisto-ohjelmien ja huoltokirjan (Tampuuri) käyttö.

E. Ajokortti ja valmius oman auton käyttöön: Tehtävä sisältää työajoja Kajaanin kaupungin alueelle sijaitsevien asuntokohteiden välillä päivisin. Työajoista maksetaan kilometrikorvaus verottajan hyväksymien ohjeiden mukaisesti.

Tästä paikasta julkaistaan RekryAreena-lähetys 5.10.26 klo 15 alkaen. Pääset katsomaan lähetyksen täältä:

https://rekryareena.fi/kiinteistonhoitaja-kajaanin-pietarille/

Yhtiö tarjoaa työntekijöilleen laajat työterveyspalvelut, virkistyssetelin (E-passi) 200 euroa (vuonna 2026), kouluttautumismahdollisuuksia soveltuvin osin sekä asianmukaiset työvaatteet. Kiinteistönhoitajalla on selkeät kohdevastuut. Teet työtä mukavien työkavereiden kanssa ja sinulle on esimiehenä nimetty kiinteistöhoidon työnjohtaja. Kiinteistö Oy Kajaanin Pietari on savuton työpaikka ja 1.10.2026 alkaen noudatamme tupakkalain 2026 määräyksiä kaikissa asuntokohteissamme.

Tervetuloa mukaan tekemään tärkeätä työtä kohtuuhintaisen asumisen parissa Kajaanissa! Ryhdymme käymään läpi saapuneita hakemuksia heti! Kerro meille hakemuksessasi, miksi juuri sinä olet hakemamme henkilö ja mitä osaamista tarjoat meille.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer I – Subsidy Projects (Fixed-Term 24 months) (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description des tâches:

Senior Software Engineer I – Subsidy Projects (Fixed-Term 24 months)

Luxembourg - Esch-sur-Alzette
Full-time
Fixed-term
71,500 - 79,500 € per year

Who we are

Luxembourg National Data Service (LNDS) is a brand of PNED G.I.E. an organisation created by the Luxembourg Government, to implement Luxembourg's strategies in research, innovation, and digitalisation. LNDS enables value creation from secondary use of data, for public and private partners and supports the sharing and re-use of public sector data, in a trustable manner. The LNDS service portfolio includes know-how, capabilities, tools, infrastructure, and data services. Through efficient & responsible use of data and improving the secondary use of data, LNDS will support the acceleration of economic, ecological, and societal transitions.

Purpose of the job / project

Play a key role in the improvement and innovation of IT solutions within a dynamic agile team delivering high-quality services across key data domains. Contribute to major European and national initiatives, including HDAB2-LU, supporting the establishment of the Luxembourg Health Data Access Body and enabling secure, compliant, and efficient access to health data.
Support the delivery of strategic national and European initiatives focused on secure data sharing, health and research data ecosystems, and trustworthy AI adoption. Contribute to the design and implementation of scalable, compliant, and impactful digital solutions in a complex multi-stakeholder environment.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will independently design, implement, deliver and maintain applications and platform services, integrating new solutions with LNDS's existing data-centric infrastructures. You will take ownership of defined technical areas, translating requirements into reliable, secure and maintainable solutions within agreed architectural and organisational standards. You will actively identify and deliver opportunities for continuous improvement and innovation, focusing on:

• Automating the software development lifecycle.
• Improving internal data flows, tooling and platform capabilities.
• Developing and supporting technical environments for data processing, analytics and AI-related experimentation.

You will be part of the Technology team, working closely with data specialists, AI experts and governance teams across different projects. You will contribute to high-impact European initiatives in AI, data governance and digital public infrastructure, exercising sound judgment about when to act independently, seek specialist input or escalate risks.

What you will do

• Develop, deliver and maintain quality software
• Contribute to application design and integration with existing data-centric infrastructures
• Contribute to continuous improvement and innovation, automating parts of the software development process, internal data flows, and internal tooling
• Collaborate within the agile software development team, delivering and maintaining quality software as required by the Platform
• Actively participate in the entire software lifecycle process, including requirements gathering, user story creation, development, continuous integration (CI) and continuous delivery (CD) pipeline setup, testing, and maintenance
• Develop and implement good software development practices, including consistent coding style, quality, and testing
• Incorporate and promote security and privacy by design practices into your work
• Assist in technical analysis and design of software solutions
• Design and provide excellent issue tracking and customer support with the team
• Write and maintain comprehensive documentation
• Offer technical expertise to external parties and represent LNDS in meetings, conferences, and gatherings with stakeholders
• Support more junior colleagues
• Stay up to date with evolving software technologies

Who you are

• MSc in a scientific, technological, or engineering discipline related to computer science, information technology, or computing
• 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in programming, deployment, and maintenance of applications
• Experience taking a feature, service or application from requirements through implementation, deployment and ongoing support
• Experience in data-related or research-oriented environments is considered an asset

Technical competencies

• Proficiency in Python or Node.js, with the ability to independently develop, test and maintain production software. Other languages are considered a plus
• Solid knowledge of backend development, including API design, services, integrations and error handling
• Frontend experience with React and Next.js is considered an asset
• Practical experience building, running and troubleshooting containerised applications using Docker or Podman
• Working knowledge of authentication and identity technologies, with experience integrating applications using relevant protocols or solutions such as OIDC, SAML, LDAP/AD or Keycloak
• Solid knowledge of SQL databases, including data modelling and query development; working knowledge of NoSQL technologies
• Working knowledge of cloud environments and application deployment, configuration and monitoring
• Practical experience with automated testing and CI/CD pipelines
• Confidence working independently in Linux and Git-based development environments
• Ability to assess technical trade-offs involving maintainability, reliability, performance, security and delivery effort

Professional competencies

• Demonstrated ownership and accountability for the quality, delivery and ongoing operation of assigned solutions
• Ability to work independently with limited day-to-day supervision, while recognising when alignment, specialist input or escalation is needed
• Analytical, solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to break down moderately complex problems and resolve incomplete or ambiguous requirements
• Practical commitment to security and privacy by design
• Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholder
• Ability to collaborate effectively in interdisciplinary and multicultural environments
• Proactive approach to continuous improvement, knowledge sharing and constructive feedback
• Ability to manage priorities and adapt to evolving requirements in projects with long-term impact
• Commitment to continued learning and the practical application of relevant technologies
• Cultural intelligence and diversity consciousness
• Fluent in English

About us

What we offer

• Dynamic and innovative work environment
• Collaboration with diverse stakeholders
• Inclusive and diverse culture
• European recognition and impactful projects
• Shape the future of the data revolution

What sets us apart
The Luxembourg National Data Service is a modern and dynamic undertaking. We embrace a Lean and Agile mindset, combining the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup with the responsibility of a public body on a national mission. We will be a partner of society and industry, collaborating with a hugely diverse group of stakeholders in public research, public authorities, European institutions, academic and private institutions, and small, medium and large companies. Therefore, we have an international and multilingual character. Even in this rather ambitious context, we preserve a warm and personal atmosphere.
Inclusion and diversity are some of our key values. We ensure that everyone has employment and career opportunities in accordance with their skills and aspirations, respecting and being mindful of their individual characteristics.

jobs.title: Head of Channel Partnerships (m/f)
jobs.description:
Head of Channel Partnerships

Luxembourg

Sonata One is a rapidly scaling, regulated fund services and technology (fintech) business.  We're The Private Funds Clearinghouse, connecting more than 53,000 investors with 6,500 funds and 180 fund managers around the globe. Our vision is to change the paradigm of private markets investing through harmonising the end-to-end investment process within one platform. Investors benefit from a seamless, one & done experience across the fund lifecycle (from fund selection and subscription through to settlement and reporting) underpinned by a globally compliant KYC passport and 24/5 support. Fund managers can raise capital faster at a lower cost from a wider pool of pre-approved investors.  Founded in 2015, Sonata One has a presence in eight locations worldwide including the US, UK and Luxembourg, Guernsey, South Africa and Mauritius.    

We operate as #OneGlobalThread in line with our values: We challenge the norm, we change the way we think and work, by connecting systems and people, while committing to our vision and each other. We are now looking to recruit an experienced Head of Channel Partnerships to join our global team.

Position Overview:  

Reporting to the Managing Director – Global Growth, the Head of Channel Partnerships will lead Sonata One's global channel partnership strategy function, driving commercial growth through the development of strategic relationships across the private markets ecosystem.
This is an exciting opportunity to join Sonata One at a pivotal stage in our growth journey as we invest significantly in building a world-class commercial organisation. You will play a key role in shaping our partnerships strategy, and helping expand Sonata One's presence across the global private markets industry.
The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying, developing and managing strategic partnerships that generate new commercial opportunities, strengthen long-term client relationships and expand Sonata One's market presence. Working closely with the New Business team, Marketing, Product, Technology and Operations, you will help deliver Sonata One's ambitious commercial growth strategy while ensuring our partner ecosystem continues to create value for clients around the world.

Responsibilities:  

Revenue Generation

• Develop and execute the global channel partnership strategy to support Sonata One's commercial growth objectives.  
• Identify opportunities to generate new revenue through strategic partnerships, cross-selling and partner-led opportunities.  
• Work closely with the New Business team to maximise commercial opportunities generated through partner relationships.  
• Support joint go-to-market initiatives and marketing campaigns that increase brand awareness and generate qualified opportunities.  

Strategic Partnership Development

• Identify, evaluate and establish new strategic partnerships across the private markets ecosystem.  
• Develop long-term partnership strategies aligned to Sonata One's commercial objectives.  
• Expand Sonata One's partner network across key global markets.  
• Assess prospective partners based on market reach, client base, strategic fit and long-term commercial value.  

Relationship Management

• Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across partner organisations.  
• Act as the primary executive contact for strategic partners.  
• Develop engagement plans that maximise partner success and long-term collaboration.  
• Proactively resolve issues and identify opportunities to strengthen relationships.  

Performance & Growth

• Establish KPIs to measure partnership success.  
• Monitor pipeline performance, commercial outcomes and partner engagement.  
• Use market insights and performance data to continuously improve partnership strategies.  
• Deliver accurate commercial forecasting and reporting to senior leadership.  

Cross-functional Collaboration

• Partner with Marketing to improve awareness, engagement and partner enablement.  
• Work closely with Product and Technology teams to ensure partner feedback informs future product development.  
• Collaborate with Legal to support commercial agreements and partnership governance where required.  
 

Compensation:
• Industry leading base salary - EUR 130,000 - 200,000 depending on experience.

Qualifications:  
 
• Proven experience in a senior partnerships, business development or commercial leadership role.  
• Demonstrable success developing strategic partnerships within fintech, financial services, fund services or private markets.  
• Strong understanding of the private markets ecosystem, including fund managers, institutional investors and service providers.  
• Existing network across the private markets industry would be highly advantageous.  
• Experience leading and developing high-performing commercial or relationship management teams.  
• Strong commercial negotiation and stakeholder management skills.  
• Strategic thinker with the ability to develop and execute partnership strategies.  
• Analytical mindset with experience using commercial data to drive decision making.  
• Excellent communication, presentation and influencing skills.  
• Experience working with CRM platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce would be advantageous.  
• Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Business, Finance, Marketing or a related discipline.  

Being part of Sonata One provides a collaborative and inclusive work culture that values innovation and diversity. We believe in the power of our unique mission and we all work together towards that one single goal. We also believe in being real. We're not a big corporate. Everyone has an important role to fulfil, and your contribution will be an integral part of our success story.   
  
Benefits:   

• Life Insurance – Peace of mind for you and your loved ones 
• Income Protection – Financial support when you need it most 
• Hybrid Working – Supporting work/Life Balance 
• Annual Leave – With extra days that grow the longer you're with us 
• Pension Scheme – Employee matched helping you plan confidently for the future 
• Employee Assistance Program – Confidential, 24/7 support for life's ups and downs 
• Enhanced Maternity, Paternity & Adoption Leave – Because family matters 
• Career Training & Development – Ongoing learning opportunities to help you grow 
• Paid Volunteering Day – Take time to give back to causes you care about 
• Cycle to work Scheme – Employees can benefit from significant tax savings on bicycles and cycling equipment
• Work From Anywhere – Choose your backdrop

jobs.description:
Description des tâches:

Infrastructure Engineer II (Fixed-Term 24 months)
Luxembourg - Esch-sur-Alzette
Full-time
Fixed-term
56,247 - 62,496 € per year

Who we are

Luxembourg National Data Service (LNDS) is a brand of PNED G.I.E. an organisation created by the Luxembourg Government, to implement Luxembourg's strategies in research, innovation, and digitalisation. LNDS enables value creation from secondary use of data, for public and private partners and supports the sharing and re-use of public sector data, in a trustable manner. The LNDS service portfolio includes know-how, capabilities, tools, infrastructure, and data services. Through efficient & responsible use of data and improving the secondary use of data, LNDS will support the acceleration of economic, ecological, and societal transitions.

Purpose of the job / project

HDAB-LU: This 4-year project, which started in January 2024, aims to develop and deploy the Health Data Access Body of Luxembourg, which is the national authority responsible for granting access to health data for secondary use as set out in The European Data Governance Act (DGA) and the European Health Data Space (EHDS). Its general objective is to enable Luxembourg to establish and deploy services for its HDAB, at minimum:
• processing and management of data access applications,
• supporting secure processing of health data by data users,
• making sure that they are well integrated in the EHDS,
• establishing and aligning with EU standards,
• and providing cross-border connections for large-scale deployment of HealthData@EU based on the work conducted by the joint action TEHDaS.

As an IT Infra Engineer II, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the company's infrastructure. You will work closely with the technology team to deliver high-quality services to the HDAB's end users, including data applicants and data users seeking access to health data for secondary use. In addition, you will monitor and report on performance quality metrics and support internal and external stakeholders, including national partners and EHDS/HealthData@EU counterparts, in resolving issues.

What you will do

• Help in the architecture, deployment, and improvement of cloud environments, as well as other IT infrastructures needed for the company to operate.
• Collaborate across teams to transform business needs focused on public sector data secondary use into secure and relevant deployments.
• Implement and ensure that the disaster recovery strategy is followed.
• Evaluate and deploy new technologies and tools to keep the infrastructure relevant.
• Assist to manage the Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions in place.
• Deploy, configure, and maintain servers, storage systems, and networking using different configuration management tools.
• Implement effective monitoring and logging solutions to proactively identify and address issues.
• Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, including system configurations, architectural diagrams, and compliance reports.

Who you are

• Masters in a scientific, technological, or engineering discipline related to computer science, information technology, or computing.
• 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in designing, deploying, and maintaining complex infrastructure environments.
• Must have knowledge of automation for the cloud (e.g., Terraform) and configuration of resources (e.g., Ansible, puppet).
• Must have solid understanding of network protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS), security best practices, and firewall configurations.
• Must have strong knowledge of RHEL based operating systems.
• Must have knowledge of virtualization solutions such as VMware, Hyper-V, and OpenStack.
• Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python or Bash for automation.
• Knowledge of Object-based storage solutions such as Amazon S3, Azure Blob Storage, ...
• Working knowledge in cloud computing platforms such as GCP, Azure or AWS.
• You have cultural intelligence and diversity consciousness.
• Excellent communication skills in English.
• Working knowledge of one of Luxembourg's official languages (French, German or Luxembourgish) is a plus.
• Analytical thinker, adaptive, and comfortable in interdisciplinary teams.
• Culturally aware, solution-oriented, autonomous, and quality-driven.

About us

What we offer

• Dynamic and innovative work environment
• Collaboration with diverse stakeholders
• Inclusive and diverse culture
• European recognition and impactful projects
• Shape the future of the data revolution

What sets us apart
The Luxembourg National Data Service is a modern and dynamic undertaking. We embrace a Lean and Agile mindset, combining the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup with the responsibility of a public body on a national mission. We will be a partner of society and industry, collaborating with a hugely diverse group of stakeholders in public research, public authorities, European institutions, academic and private institutions, and small, medium and large companies. Therefore, we have an international and multilingual character. Even in this rather ambitious context, we preserve a warm and personal atmosphere.
Inclusion and diversity are some of our key values. We ensure that everyone has employment and career opportunities in accordance with their skills and aspirations, respecting and being mindful of their individual characteristics.  
Join LNDS and revolutionise the data economy!
Be part of our dynamic team driving innovation and making a tangible impact. Collaborate on cutting-edge projects, gaining European recognition in the prestigious European Data Spaces initiative. Shape a transformative future in the data revolution.

jobs.description:
Description des tâches:

ELSI Specialist - 1+MG Projects (Fixed-Term 24 months)
Luxembourg - Esch-sur-Alzette
Full-time
Fixed-term
70,200 - 78,000 € per year

Who we are

Luxembourg National Data Service (LNDS) is a brand of PNED G.I.E. an organisation created by the Luxembourg Government, to implement Luxembourg's strategies in research, innovation, and digitalisation. LNDS enables value creation from secondary use of data, for public and private partners and supports the sharing and re-use of public sector data, in a trustable manner. The LNDS service portfolio includes know-how, capabilities, tools, infrastructure, and data services. Through efficient & responsible use of data and improving the secondary use of data, LNDS will support the acceleration of economic, ecological, and societal transitions.

Purpose of the job / project

We participate in European project to support the secondary use of genomic data in the context of the European 1+ Million Genome (1+MG) initiative for an innovative and responsible ethical, legal and social implications (ELSI) framework. Our aim is to advise European policy makers in the implementation of a data infrastructure for secondary use of genomic data based on legal research, stakeholder interaction and translation of our findings into ethical, data protection and other legal norms into workable IT and policy solutions in the interest of society.

LNDS plays a key role in several projects linked to the 1+ Million Genomes (1+MG) Initiative.
As an ELSI Specialist, you will contribute to the privacy, ethical, legal, and regulatory dimensions of these strategic European initiatives.
In this role, you will support LNDS's participation in 1+MG-related projects, ensuring compliance with relevant legal and regulatory frameworks while promoting the responsible use and sharing of genomic and health data.
You will work closely with LNDS colleagues and collaborate with leading European stakeholders through working groups, expert networks, and project consortia.

What you will do

• Analysis and interpretation of legal and/or ethical requirements based on legal and ethical norms, review of existing guidelines and, where applicable, case law for the challenges in secondary use of genomic data in the context of the 1+ Million Genome (1+MG) initiative.
• Pursuing ELSI by design and default, you will provide analyses of planned operations and workflows of secondary use as well as provide support on data protection impact assessments (DPIA).
• Development of policies and technical requirements frameworks to enable solutions for ELSI compliance for secondary use of genomic data in the context of European projects and the 1+ MG initiative.
• Development of or contribution to practical tools, templates, guidance, training and other instruments for ELSI compliance.
• Engagement in European working groups in the context of the 1+MG initiative, including preparation of content, formal documents, writing of minutes and interaction with the working group members.
• Engagement with relevant stakeholders, such as citizens, representative groups (consumer groups, patient associations etc.), data holders, data users, relevant ministries on the national and European level, data protection authorities as well as European bodies - such as the European Commission or the EDPB -, and contribution to consensus building

Who you are

• A master's or PhD degree with several years of work experience, in biomedicine, bioinformatics, or a similar field with experience with ethical and data protection challenges for research and/or data governance.
• Alternatively, a master's degree or PhD degree in law, bioethics, or a similar field with several years of experience in biomedicine or data governance.
• Related years of experience: 5 to 10 years.
• Working experience, for example, as a scientist, data steward or bioethicist and engaged in that role in finding responsible and legally compliant solutions in a biomedical research, healthcare or data governance context.
• A background in data protection by design and default workflows and/or the ethics and legislation of secondary use of data.
• Proficient in English.
• Proficient in French and/or German is a strong plus.
• You are enthusiastic about the legal aspects of data research or the conceptual and/or technical implementation of data protection principles for workflows.
• Good analytical skills for interpreting legal scenarios and requirements.
• Good communication skills (ability to listen, understand and convey your ideas) and the ability to articulate clearly the ELSI needs to various audience (scientist, clients, internal colleagues, …) both in written form and oral training as well as experience in writing academic papers.
• Creative, solution oriented with strong analytical skills and a mindset for quality.
• You have critical thinking; you are adaptable and flexible.
• You have cultural intelligence and diversity consciousness.
• You are conscious about time management (becoming more effective and efficient in how you work).

About us

What we offer

• Dynamic and innovative work environment
• Collaboration with diverse stakeholders
• Inclusive and diverse culture
• European recognition and impactful projects
• Shape the future of the data revolution

What sets us apart
The Luxembourg National Data Service is a modern and dynamic undertaking. We embrace a Lean and Agile mindset, combining the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup with the responsibility of a public body on a national mission. We will be a partner of society and industry, collaborating with a hugely diverse group of stakeholders in public research, public authorities, European institutions, academic and private institutions, and small, medium and large companies. Therefore, we have an international and multilingual character. Even in this rather ambitious context, we preserve a warm and personal atmosphere.
Inclusion and diversity are some of our key values. We ensure that everyone has employment and career opportunities in accordance with their skills and aspirations, respecting and being mindful of their individual characteristics.  
Join LNDS and revolutionise the data economy!
Be part of our dynamic team driving innovation and making a tangible impact. Collaborate on cutting-edge projects, gaining European recognition in the prestigious European Data Spaces initiative. Shape a transformative future in the data revolution.

Apply now!

Further on, no contractual relationship will result out of such a submission between LNDS and a third party. LNDS is not obligated nor willing to pay any fee to third parties submitting candidates in this manner. Your data is handled according to the compliance guidelines of LNDS.

jobs.title: SENIOR LINUX ENGINEER (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
Fixed term contract | Belval
Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

You will support the operation and continuous improvement of LIST's Linux infrastructure (including user endpoints and IT services), ensuring reliable, secure and efficient environments for research and organisational activities.
Working within the IT Infrastructure team, you will:
·        Administer and maintain Linux servers and endpoints, including configuration, monitoring, patching, troubleshooting and lifecycle management.
·        Monitor infrastructure health, availability, capacity, performance and security, and respond to incidents and service requests.
·        Support endpoint-security operations, including hardening, antivirus, encryption, access control, compliance and vulnerability remediation.
·        Contribute to incident, problem, change and release management in line with established IT service-management practices.
·        Automate operational activities using tools such as Ansible or plain scripting, and contribute to standardisation through deployment playbooks and configuration-management tools such as ManageEngine Endpoint Central.
·        Support backup, recovery, disaster-recovery and business-continuity procedures.
·        Collaborate with Information Security, Applications, Development, IT Operations, researchers and other stakeholders to ensure stable, secure and compatible services.
·        Maintain accurate technical documentation, including infrastructure configurations, operational procedures, troubleshooting guidance and knowledge articles.
·        Contribute to IT asset, software and configuration-management activities, where applicable.
·        Follow emerging technologies and propose improvements to infrastructure reliability, security, efficiency and user experience.

Additional infrastructure responsibilities.
Under the guidance of IT Infrastructure colleagues, you will also support the administration, monitoring and maintenance of:
·        User accounts, access rights, authentication and permissions, in accordance with internal policies.
·        Virtualised and containerised environments using technologies such as VMware, Proxmox, Docker, Podman and Kubernetes.
·        Compute, storage, backup and high-performance-computing environments supporting research and organisational workloads.
·        Environments within public cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure and Scaleway.


Project delivery and activity management

In addition to day-to-day engineering and operational support, you will contribute to IT and infrastructure projects delivered through internal initiatives and in collaboration with external partners or clients.
You will manage your activities in accordance with LIST's project-management methodology by planning and prioritising tasks, estimating effort, tracking progress, managing dependencies and risks, coordinating stakeholders and delivering agreed outcomes. Depending on the assignment, you may also coordinate or manage IT or LIST-level projects involving multidisciplinary teams.

·        Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, firewalls and secure remote access.
·        Experience documenting infrastructure configurations, operational procedures, troubleshooting guidance and support processes.
·        Experience with virtualisation, containerisation, compute, storage, backup, HPC, cloud or AI/ML infrastructure is considered an asset, particularly in research, scientific, engineering or data-intensive environments.
·        Ability to work in accordance with internal IT policies, security requirements and operational standards.
·        Experience using project-management and collaboration tools such as Asana, Jira, Microsoft Planner or equivalent.

Soft skills

·        Strong analytical, diagnostic, and troubleshooting abilities
·        Collaborative and service-oriented approach, with the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
·        Project-oriented and delivery-focused mindset, including the ability to plan, prioritise, coordinate and report on activities.
·        Strong documentation, communication, planning and organisational skills.
·        Proactive approach and willingness to continuously improve infrastructure reliability, security, efficiency and user experience.
·        Ability to prioritise tasks and respond effectively to incidents and operational requirements.
·        Ability to explain technical issues clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
·        Ability to work independently while recognising when to seek guidance or involve specialist colleagues.

Language skills

jobs.title: EHS Manager (h/f)
jobs.employer: DELEBOIS & O'DONNELL S.à.r.l. - DO Recruitment Advisors
jobs.description:
EHS MANAGER H/F

About the company

DO Recruitment Advisors is an award-winning boutique recruitment firm based in Luxembourg, connecting talented professionals with leading financial services and corporate clients. We take a personalised approach to understand you and your ambitions, offering tailored guidance, exclusive opportunities, and long-term career support in environments where you can grow and thrive.
We are committed to protecting your privacy and keeping your personal data confidential. Before submitting your application, please take a moment to review our Privacy Policy.

About the role

We are delighted to recruit, on behalf of its client, a company operating in the industrial sector, an EHS Manager to join its team in Luxembourg.
This is an opportunity to shape and lead the site's EHS function, drive continuous improvement initiatives, and play a key role in strengthening the company's safety culture, facility standards, and security practices.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement the site's EHS strategy in line with corporate policies, Luxembourg regulations and ISO 14001/45001 standards.
• Lead and develop the EHS team while promoting a strong safety culture.
• Ensure regulatory compliance and coordinate inspections, reporting and EHS audits.
• Partner with site management on risk assessments, incident prevention, safety performance and EHS KPIs.
• Oversee emergency response planning, contractor safety and environmental compliance (permits, waste, emissions and hazardous materials).
• Drive continuous improvement and promote EHS best practices across the organisation.

Profile sought

• Degree in Environmental Science, Occupational Safety, Engineering or a related field.
• Fluent in French and English.
• Proven experience leading EHS activities within an industrial or manufacturing environment.
• Strong knowledge of Luxembourg EHS regulations, ISO 14001/45001 standards, Process Safety Management and Process Hazard Analysis.
• Excellent leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Certified Safety Professional (Designated Worker - Group C).

Application process:

As an equal opportunity employer, we embrace diversity and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Please note, however, that candidates must possess a valid Luxembourg work permit. As we represent our clients, we are required to submit only those who meet this requirement. Unfortunately, if you do not have a valid work permit, we will not be able to consider your application.

If you are selected for the position, you will be asked to provide supporting documentation, such as copies of your diplomas, proof of prior employment, and a standard criminal record check, as part of the final steps in our recruitment process.
We appreciate your interest in our company and look forward to the possibility of working together.

jobs.title: Legal Counsel (m/f) - Société Commerciale
jobs.description:
Legal Counsel F/M - Société Commerciale

Reference: LU879515
Luxembourg
EUR 70K - 80K per year
Permanent

Dans le cadre du développement d'une société commerciale basée au Luxembourg, nous recherchons un(e) Legal Counsel / Juriste d'Affaires pour prendre en charge les principaux sujets juridiques de l'entreprise.

Directement rattaché(e) à la Direction Générale, vous serez le référent juridique interne et travaillerez en proximité avec le CODIR ainsi qu'avec les équipes opérationnelles.
Le poste combine une forte dimension hands-on contrats, négociations, litiges avec un rôle de conseil auprès de la Direction et de structuration progressive de la fonction juridique.

Vos principales responsabilités

• Rédiger, revoir et négocier les contrats commerciaux, contrats fournisseurs et prestataires, CGV, NDA et autres accords nécessaires à l'activité.
• Accompagner les équipes opérationnelles dans leurs problématiques juridiques quotidiennes et leur apporter des réponses concrètes et pragmatiques.
• Identifier les risques juridiques liés aux projets, partenariats et opérations commerciales et conseiller la Direction sur les solutions à privilégier.
• Gérer les situations de précontentieux et les litiges commerciaux, avec une approche privilégiant autant que possible la résolution amiable.
• Échanger directement avec des clients, partenaires ou fournisseurs dans le cadre de dossiers sensibles ou de désaccords contractuels.
• Coordonner les conseils externes lorsque leur intervention est nécessaire : avocats, assureurs, experts ou autres partenaires.
• Mettre en place et améliorer les outils, modèles contractuels et procédures juridiques internes.
• Veiller au respect des principales obligations légales et réglementaires applicables à l'activité, notamment sur les sujets RGPD et conformité.
• Sensibiliser les équipes aux principaux risques juridiques et contribuer à développer de bonnes pratiques au sein de l'organisation.

Profil recherché

• Formation supérieure en droit, idéalement Master en droit des affaires, droit commercial ou droit des contrats.
• Environ 5 à 7 ans d'expérience sur des problématiques de droit commercial, droit des affaires et contrats.
• Expérience solide en rédaction et négociation contractuelle.
• Une première exposition à la gestion de litiges ou précontentieux, avec idéalement des échanges directs avec des clients ou partenaires.
• Parcours possible aussi bien en entreprise qu'en cabinet d'avocats.
• Une connaissance du Luxembourg est appréciée mais n'est pas indispensable.
• Une expérience dans la construction, l'e-commerce ou un environnement commercial B2B/B2C constitue un atout.
• Français et anglais professionnels.
• Personnalité : autonome, entrepreneuriale et orientée solutions. A l'aise pour challenger et conseiller des interlocuteurs seniors, défendre une position lorsque nécessaire et créer une relation de confiance avec la Direction et les équipes opérationnelles.

Si cette annonce vous correspond, je vous invite à postuler. Votre candidature sera traitée en toute confidentialité.

Mitsubishi UFJ Investor Services and Banking (Luxembourg) S.A. (MIBL) is a Bank incorporated in Luxembourg and is fully owned by Mitsubishi UFJ Trust and Banking Corporation, member of the Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, one of the largest financial groups worldwide.

MIBL provides a wide range of financial services to institutional investors including depositary, custody, fund administration, and other banking-related services.

MIBL now has an opening in its Compliance Department for a:

Chief Compliance Officer - (CDI)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                              (Ref: MIBLHR_092026)

Responsibilities:

• Ensure the implementation of a Compliance function, in accordance with the guidelines set forth in the CSSF Circular 72/552 (and any other subsequent relevant Law or CSSF Circular) and by the Standard Compliance policy, procedure and manuals for Overseas Offices.
• The Compliance Officer function is an independent function with the objectives to:
• Identify and evaluate the Compliance risks (as defined below) within the Bank
• Organize, coordinate and structure compliance-related centralized controls; control and monitor all measures taken to mitigate the compliance risks:
• Report accordingly to the Executive committee and the Board of Directors
• Act as contact person for regulatory matters with the CSSF
• As MLRO (in case a separate MLRO function is not existing in the Bank) act as contact person with the public prosecutor
• Act as an adviser in Compliance matters within the bank.
• Moreover, the Compliance Officer will insure the following tasks:
• Organizing the department and, together with the Management if necessary, defining the duties of each staff taken individually;
• Support any Projects in the Bank and support to complete any application files to the regulators.
• Assist and Support the Management in appropriate way;
• Assist and Support the staff in their daily tasks;
• Appraisal of department staff;
• Authorizing and supervising any holidays and days off of the staff;
• Motivating and educating staff;
• Coordinating and organizing all inter-departmental issues relating to the department including the planning of all operational issues and permanent quality development;
• The compliance risk is defined as the risk the Bank may suffer as a result of its failure to comply with applicable laws, regulation, codes of conduct and standards of good practice and includes:
• Legal and regulatory risk;

Job Description & Summary

Your mission: Today's business environment is more complex than ever. More regulated, more automated, more connected, more virtual. Considering these changes, more opportunities come along but also more risks.  
Internal Audit plays a key role in supporting the organizations by identifying risks, assessing control frameworks and providing practical recommendations to strengthen processes, ensure compliance and support informed decision-making.

Be a part of our team where you will:  

• Work as part of a team of problem solvers in a highly dynamic environment with international teams, proactively assisting in the management of several projects, while reporting to the Managers and above;
• Establish and maintain effective working relationships with the clients' representatives;
• Train, coach and supervise teams of associates and trainees;
• Regularly collaborate with professionals from both business and technology to advise clients on operational risks related to business processes, applications as well as risk management framework and risk assessments;
As part of your role, you will mainly:
• Contribute to leading Internal Audit assignments along with a Manager / Senior Manager;
• Contribute to leading teams with the aim to assess whether sufficient internal controls are embedded into our clients' key processes;
• Perform Internal Audit engagements in regulated environments and assess compliance with applicable regulations;
• Assist our clients in the performance of their internal audit plan;
• Support our clients in the deployment and development of their internal audit function;

Let's talk about you. If …  

• You hold a Master's degree or equivalent in Audit, Business or Economics;
• You benefit from at least 3 years of relevant experience in Internal Audit. Additional experience in a Compliance, Risk Management or Internal Control Function will be considered as an asset;
• You are knowledgeable in EU Financial Sector regulations and supervisory expectations;
• You demonstrate a strong understanding of governance, risk management and internal control frameworks;
• You have excellent written and spoken communication skills in English and French. Any additional language will be considered as an asset;
• You have an analytical mindset and good interpersonal and people skills;
• You are a self-starter with a proactive and dynamic style and feel at ease in various cultural contexts;
• You have strong time management and organizational skills;
• You have a good command of Microsoft Office tools, in particular Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

…You are the candidate we are looking for!

The firm provides advice to a wide variety of clients from local and middle market entrepreneurs to large multinational companies operating from Luxembourg and the Greater Region. jobs.description:
Job Title:  Corporate counsel

Job Description:  

It's never been a more exciting time to join Vistra.   

At Vistra our purpose is progress. We believe that our clients have the power to change the world and to do great things for global progress, and we exist to remove the friction that comes from the complexity of global business – to help our clients achieve progress without friction.  

But progress only happens when people come together and take action. And we're absolutely committed to building a culture where our people can do just that. 

We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as Corporate Counsel. Reporting to a Senior Manager, this full-time, permanent position is based in Luxembourg and offers local coverage, allowing you to make a significant impact on our Funds business and its growth.

Key Responsibilities

• Client servicing through means of an in-depth knowledge of client files, client communication and internal procedures:
• Draft/review of legal documentation in terms of incorporation of companies, day-to-day operations, liquidation
• Monitor the various steps of the transactions, ensure adherence at all times with Luxembourg law as well as internal Vistra processes
• Debt collection of outstanding Vistra invoices
• Coordinate with central operations team to resolve issues concerning taxes, administration and banking of client companies
• Detect possible corporate and tax issues
• Handle client requests regarding transactions/statutory and outflow
• Work in close collaboration with team members, law firms, auditors, tax advisors and other relevant parties
• Organise the preparation shareholder and board meetings together with the Accountants and Corporate Secretarial Assistants
• Maintain communication with clients, including the planning of the Corporate Calendar
• Monitor completeness of client files
• Develop and maintain a thorough knowledge of Luxembourg market/regulations (legal, tax, accounting, reporting, market developments)
• Take up directorship mandates in client's companies, if requested
• Take up client payroll, if requested
• Collect KYC documentation (as required)
• Record the working hours/client in the time billing system according to the objectives set
  
Attributes/Technical Skills

• Strong communication skills
• Ability to solve problems, work independently and as a member of a team
  
Relevant Experience

• Strong knowledge of Luxembourg regulation
• Minimum of 3 years of experience with a professional services firm
• Strong communication skills
• Ability to solve problems, work independently and as a member of a team

Education and Professional Qualification

Law, Economics and/or Tax degree

If you are excited about working with us, we encourage you to apply or have a confidential chat with one of our Talent Acquisition team members. Our goal is to make this a great place to work where all our people can thrive. We hope you join us on this exciting journey!

jobs.title: Research Scientist in Mathematical and Physics based modeling of Generative AI (m/f)
jobs.description:
Research Scientist in Mathematical and Physics based modeling of Generative AI

(Valid from 08/09/2026 to 23/02/2027)

Language: English (UK)
Location: Luxembourg
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: SEDAN
Job Number: UOL08342
Contract Type: Permanent
Schedule Type: Full Time
Work Hours 40.0 Hours per Week
Expected Start Date: 01/08/2026

Expertise: Researcher / Postdoctorant
Job (internal): Research scientist
Functions: Researcher
Role Type: Open Position
Job Level: level 1
  
About the SnT

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.

The Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust (SnT) at the University of Luxembourg is a leading international research and innovation centre in secure, reliable and trustworthy ICT systems and services.
We play an instrumental role in Europe by fueling innovation through research partnerships with industry, boosting R&D investments leading to economic growth, and attracting highly qualified talent. We look for researchers from diverse academic backgrounds to contribute to our projects in areas such as: Network Security, Information Assurance, Model-driven Security, Cloud Computing, Cryptography, Satellite Systems, Vehicular Networks, and ICT Services & Applications.

The successful candidate will become a member of the Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust within the Interdisciplinary Research in SEDAN Team under the supervision of Prof. Dr. Radu State at the University of Luxembourg.

Your role:

• Support further developing and expanding the SEDAN team, its research, and role in shaping interdisciplinary research, in modeling of Generative AI
• Shape and supervise research direction at the intersection of AI and Mathematics, including Physics based paradigms
• Lead and contribute to the development and management of national and international projects in SEDAN, including proposal preparation, reporting, and coordination with external partners
• Foster collaborations across disciplines - in particular between Fintech and AI with private and public stakeholders in Luxembourg and abroad
• Contribute to teaching activities at the Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD levels in topics such as AI and machine learning
• Provide daily and content supervision of PhD candidates and support doctoral and postdoctoral training; e.g., research seminars, reading groups, workshops, and conferences
• Represent SnT and SEDAN in academic and public venues, strengthening the visibility of AI research in Luxembourg and abroad

Your profile:

• PhD in Physics, Mathematics or Computer Science
• At least five years of postdoctoral or equivalent experience in applied and fundamental research and technology transfer to the industry
• Research related to theoretical foundations of Generative AI
• Recent research experience with LLM, RAG systems, and/or agentic systems
• Proven experience with Ethical AI and EU AI act
• A strong recent publication record in top-tier AI conferences
• Proven experience in funding acquisition, project management, and coordination of national projects as well as industry collaboration
• Proven experience in teaching and supervising MSc, PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and management of small groups

Language requirements: The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and either French or German. The University encourages its staff to learn the other language and provides access to language courses to this end.

We offer:

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply:

• CV; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience
• Cover letter detailing your motivation for applying to the advertised research topic and/or project, including how your background, interests, and career goals align with its objective
• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications and projects
• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught if applicable
• Research statement and research plan for the next five years, including proposed research projects in the framework of the theme and mission of the profile

All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception.

General information:

• Contract Type: Permanent
• Work Hours: Full Time 40.0 Hours per Week
• Location: Kirchberg Campus
• Internal Title: Research scientist
• Job Reference: UOL08342

Gender equality:

The University of Luxembourg embraces inclusion, diversity and gender equality as essential for academic excellence. We are fully committed to removing discriminatory barriers in recruitment and career progression and to advance gender balance among academic staff. Should candidates present equivalent CVs, preference will be given to female candidates in all departments where gender parity is not yet achieved.

jobs.title: Content Editor
jobs.description:
Why work at Higgsfield AI?

Higgsfield AI is the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $700M in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands.

We write a lot, and it's read by millions of people around the world. Our content team is already strong, and now we want to make it stronger. You'll be the native voice of the brand: everything our users read will go through you.

What you will work on

  • Reviewing and editing the team's copy across the blog, Help Center, changelog, Creator Hub, case studies, PR and news, newsletters, product updates, and UI text;

  • Fact-checking every piece before it ships: checking model and feature names against the product;

  • Keeping facts consistent across every surface, so the same number reads the same in the blog, Help Center, landing pages, and press releases;

  • Shaping content for AI answers: a direct answer up front, question-based headings, useful FAQs, and internal links;

  • Keeping the writing alive and human, with no traces of AI or template-speak;

  • Working on tone, rhythm and clarity, not just fixing grammar;

  • Writing your own pieces too, including editorial work like our Inside Higgsfield series;

  • Holding one consistent brand voice across everything we publish.

Your must haves

  • English as your native language;

  • A strong background in editing and writing, with a portfolio to show for it;

  • An instinct for style, tone and rhythm. You feel when a sentence works and when it doesn't;

  • The ability to explain your edits and how they make the text stronger. "It sounds better" is a start, not an answer;

  • An owner mindset: you see what could be better, and you make it happen;

  • Comfort with startup pace. We move fast, ship weekly, and the writing has to keep up.

Nice to have

  • Experience editing for a tech, SaaS or AI product;

  • Experience building or maintaining a style guide or brand voice;

  • Familiarity with the GenAI landscape and the tools creators actually use;

The deal

  • Competitive salary in USD;

  • Fully remote position;

  • Access to Higgsfield products and the AI tools we use internally;

  • Full-time position with high ownership and growth potential.

jobs.title: Pitkäaikainen sijaisperhe huostaanotetuille lapsille
jobs.description:
Olisitko valmis auttamaan apua tarvitsevia lapsia tarjoamalla heille pitkäaikaisen kodin, tasapainoisen elinympäristön ja tukemalla heidän kasvuaan ja kehitystään? Sijaisperheenä pääset tekemään todella tärkeää työtä ja vaikuttamaan lapsen elämään kokonaisvaltaisesti. Tällä hetkellä tarvitaan erityisesti sijaisperheitä, joilla on kokemusta vaativista lapsista.

Sijaisperhe on perhe, joka antaa kodin lapselle, joka ei voi asua omassa kodissaan. Sijaisperhe huolehtii lapsen arjesta, kasvatuksesta ja hyvinvoinnista. Sijaisperheelle maksetaan palkkiota ja kulukorvausta jokaiselta kuukaudelta, kun sijoitettu lapsi asuu perheessä. Kuukausitulot riippuvat sijoitettujen lasten määrästä (alla olevan taulukon mukaisesti). Tulot kerryttävät eläkettä.

-Yksi lapsi: palkkio 2009 euroa, kulukorvaus 1035 euroa, yhteensä 3044 euroa
-Kaksi lasta: palkkio 4018 euroa, kulukorvaus 2071 euroa, yhteensä 6089 euroa
-Kolme lasta: palkkio 6027 euroa, kulukorvaus 3107 euroa, yhteensä 9134 euroa
-Neljä lasta: palkkio 8036 euroa, kulukorvaus 4143 euroa, yhteensä 12179 euroa

Ennen kuin voitte toimia sijaisperheenä, tulee teidän osallistua sijaisperhevalmennukseen. Haemme nyt sopivia perheitä tähän yksilöllisesti, eli perhekohtaisesti, toteutettavaan valmennukseemme. Valmennus räätälöidään teille sopivaksi ja sen voi aloittaa sopimuksen mukaan, vaikka heti. Valmennus on prosessi, jonka kesto on keskimäärin 5-7kk.

Perhehoitajana eli sijaisvanhempana toimiminen edellyttää:
-Ikä noin 25-55 vuotta. Tätä ikähaitaria voi hieman venyttää, mutta ajatuksena on, että henkilön tulee olla kypsä päättämään pitkästä (mahdollisesti yli kymmenen vuoden) sitoutumisesta ja henkilön ei tulisi saavuttaa eläkeikää, ennen kuin lapsi on täysi-ikäinen.
-Vakaa talous ja elämäntilanne. Traumatisoituneiden ja erityistarpeisten lasten hoitaminen on vaativaa ja jos oma elämäntilanne ei ole tasapainossa, saattaa se vaikuttaa voimavaroihin ja kyvykkyyteen toimia sijaisperheenä.
-Ei mielenterveys-, päihde- eikä rikostaustaa. Nämä lienevät itsestään selviä esteitä.
-Sopiva asumismuoto. Sijoitetuille lapsille tarvitaan omat huoneet. Alle kouluikäiset sijoitetut lapset eivät välttämättä heti tarvitse omaa huonetta, mutta viimeistään kouluikäisellä lapsella tulee olla oma huone.

Arvostamme seuraavia asioita, mutta tiedämme, ettei koko listan mukaista superperhettä välttämättä löydy. Ota siis rohkeasti yhteyttä, vaikkei jokainen kohta täyttyisi.
-Ei omia alle kouluikäisiä lapsia
-Kahden vanhemman perhe
-Mahdollisuutta auttaa kahta tai useampaa lasta (esim. sisarukset)
-Kokemusta erityisyydestä, esim. nepsyoireista, traumatyöskentelystä, oppimishäiriöistä
-Kokemusta kiintymyssuhteen rakentamisesta
-Kokemusta kasvatustyöstä
-Kokemusta lastensuojelusta

Työtä tukevia ammattikoulutuksia ovat esim. sosiaali- ja terveysalan- sekä kasvatustieteen koulutukset. Näiden lisäksi erilaiset terapeuttiset, ohjaukselliset ja psykiatriset lisäkoulutukset tarjoavat vahvaa tukea työssä menestymiseen. Virallista koulutusvaatimusta ei perhehoitajan työssä kuitenkaan ole.

Aikaisempi työkokemus voisi esimerkiksi olla joku näistä:
-Lastenkodin ohjaaja, perhetyöntekijä, sosiaaliohjaaja
-Opettaja, erityisopettaja, varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja
-Sairaanhoitaja, terveydenhoitaja
-Psykologi / psykoterapeutti / toimintaterapeutti
-Nuoriso-ohjaaja, yhteisöpedagogi

Tai muu vastaava työkokemus.

Perhehoitajan tehtävässä pärjää parhaiten, jos osaa nähdä lapsen mahdollisesti haastavan käytöksen taakse ja ymmärtää aiempien elämänkokemusten merkityksen lapsen kasvulle ja kehitykselle. Työssä tarvitaan joustavuutta ja valmiutta ymmärtää ja kohdata lapsen biologinen perhe ja suku, eli läheisverkostot. Tämä voi joskus olla haastavaa, koska lapsen sijoitus herättää vanhemmissa usein paljon tunteita. Työhön kuuluu myös yhteistyötä sosiaalitoimen sekä muiden viranomaisverkostojen kanssa. Sijoitettu lapsi tarvitsee turvallisen kodin, paljon aikuisen huomiota, säännöllisyyttä ja rutiineja sekä tietysti kiintymystä, läheisyyttä ja rakkautta. Lapsesta tulee vähitellen sijaisperheen tärkeä ja tasaveroinen perheenjäsen.

Sijaisperheen arki mukailee tavallista lapsiperhearkea, sisältäen arkea ja juhlaa, itkua ja naurua. Perheen toisen vanhemman tulee jäädä kotiin hoitamaan sijoitettua lasta/lapsia ainakin vuodeksi, jotta kiintymyssuhde ja asettuminen perheeseen mahdollistuu. Työn tukena on meiltä ammattitaitoinen tukityöntekijä, jonka kanssa käydään säännöllisesti läpi kuulumiset sekä paneudutaan lapsen asioihin myös syvällisemmin, lapsen yksilöllinen tilanne huomioiden. Kuljemme sijaisperheen rinnalla ja meille on tärkeää saavuttaa avoin ja luotettava yhteistyösuhde. Tukityömme on säännöllistä ja toteutuu puheluin ja kotikäynnein. Tukityön lisäksi tarjoamme perhehoitajillemme työnohjauksen ja lisäkoulutusmahdollisuuksia.

Suomen Perhekodit Oy on nuori suomalainen yritys. Valmennamme ja tuemme sijaisperheitä arjen tilanteissa, koko lapsen perheessä asumisen ajan. Huolehdimme byrokratiasta niin että sinä voit huolehtia lapsesta ilman turhaa stressiä. Olemme helposti lähestyttävä, ihmisläheinen ja aidosti lapsen asioista huolehtiva joukko. Verkkosivuiltamme löydät kattavat tiedot sijaisperheenä toimimisesta.

Ota yhteyttä, niin mietitään yhdessä, olisiko teidän perheenne sopiva sijaisperheeksi!

jobs.title: AI Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
Haemme asiakkaamme julkiseen kilpailutukseen AI Full Stack kehittäjää.

Full Stack Developerin keskeisiin tehtäviin kuuluu tekoälyratkaisujen kehittäminen kokonaisvaltaisesti sekä käyttöliittymä- että palvelinpuolella, generatiivisen tekoälyn ja kielimallien integrointi sovelluksiin sekä osallistuminen tuotekehitykseen.

Työssä korostuvat moderni frontend-kehitys, rajapintojen ja taustapalveluiden toteutus sekä tekoälyagenttien ja -työkalujen rakentaminen. Full Stack Developer työskentelee tiiviisti datatieteilijöiden, suunnittelijoiden ja muiden asiantuntijoiden kanssa, huomioiden tekniset rajoitteet ja vastuullisuuden vaatimukset toteutuksessa.

AI Full Stack Developer vastaa tekoälysovellusten kehittämisestä koko teknologiapinon laajuudelta käyttöliittymästä taustajärjestelmiin.
