About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the worldâs largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As an Enterprise Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will drive business growth by identifying opportunities with target clients. Youâll play a pivotal role in identifying potential customers, generating new business opportunities, and providing support to both customers and our team. You will set the stage for successful sales interactions through cold outreach efforts and nurturing relationships to secure qualified meetings for our sales team. If youâre a self-motivated individual with a passion for sales, we encourage you to join our team!

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Sales: Understand current and future demand. Enable, educate, and directly support the sales force to best position this practice with Toptal clients and win new business. Lead client conversations, presenting Toptalâs perspective on innovation and experience topics, and ask exploratory questions to better understand client needs.
  • Begin the Relationship: Through lead-generation activities and cold-calling, you will prospect, educate, qualify, and develop sales-ready leads and opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts. You will enthusiastically explain Toptalâs vision, pinpoint opportunities, and generate interest.
  • Client and Industry Knowledge: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. As the first point of contact for future Enterprise clients, you will be building rapport through strategic outreach and a well-rounded client and industry knowledge. Researching clients and staying informed on industry trends will be key to your success.
  • Collaborate with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team and Sales Executives to pursue opportunities, recommend appropriate follow-up actions, and schedule qualified meetings. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.
  • Growth and Development: Our team has an aversion to complacency. We are always looking to improve both individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical success factors in this role and at Toptal. As you become more comfortable in the role, you will help evolve our demand generation strategy and tactics.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptalâs model, our value proposition, and our story.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to understand how you can utilize our incredible global team to build client relationships and drive success.
  • Learn the breadth of Toptalâs impact on the worldâs largest companies.
  • Grasp the importance of the SDR function to the success of Toptal.
  • Understand our sales method and our selling process to set you up for success.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Complete our personalized sales training program with mock calls, cold calls, and role-play scenarios.
  • Learn how to use Salesforce.com (our CRM) and other SaaS outreach tools (ZoomInfo, SalesLoft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).
  • Integrate into your pod, partner with Enterprise Sales Executives and Client Partners, and begin targeting strategic accounts.
  • Learn the process for outreach, including calling, emailing, and LinkedIn messaging. Implement an outreach process and hit 1-month objectives.
  • Learn how to analyze industry drivers, business problems, and target buyers.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Become fully ramped on the SDR team, attaining your metrics, which include calls, emails, and other sales activities.
  • Exercising discretion and independent judgment, uncover new opportunities within existing accounts and target accounts that result in revenue-generating engagements for Toptal.

jobs.title: Client Advisor
jobs.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the worldâs largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

Our Client Advisors turn inbound interest from small- and medium-sized businesses into Toptal clients. You will be the first conversation a prospective client has with Toptal. You will respond to immediate-assistance requests within five minutes, quickly understand the business problem behind the request, connect necessary Toptal specialists, and help guide the client forward through the sales process.

You will need to do a great deal in a short conversation: establish trust, diagnose the need, recognize relevant opportunities, explain Toptalâs value proposition, address concerns, and convert the business to sale. This is a high energy, consultative sales role at inbound velocity where excellence will mean running a high volume of first conversations, asking better questions than the client expected, and constantly building momentum along the right Toptal offering path.

You will need to bring clarity and articulate value across Toptalâs full portfolio: specialized talent, global hiring and payroll through HireGlobal, and our AI-driven, platform-powered, outcome-focused services offerings.

Your ownership continues after the first call. You will represent the client through technical stages, keep them engaged between conversations, and resolve issues that slow a decision. You will manage those active opportunities alongside new incoming inquiries, knowing when to bring in specialists for deeper expertise.

Our ideal candidate is ambitious, competitive, driven by client service, and pairs that drive with genuine curiosity about how businesses work. If you want to build real consultative selling skills in a fast-paced environment and be compensated for it, this is the team you want to be part of.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Discovery and Diagnosis: You will run high energy, open-ended discovery on every inbound conversation. You will quickly establish rapport, understand what prompted the client to reach out, and uncover the business objective behind the stated request. You will use this to build the necessary sales momentum to keep clients engaged, earning the right to recommend before you recommend.
  • Qualify, Manage, and Win the Opportunity: You will quickly identify what is driving the need, whether there is a real opportunity, identify the metrics that matter most to the client, and who is involved in the decision. You will explain why the relevant Toptal offering fits, address the clientâs concerns, and ask for commitment. You will manage deal cycles from discovery through close and maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in our CRM.
  • Own progress after the call: You will give any necessary specialists a clear account of the clientâs needs and prepare them for subsequent conversations, stay close as technical questions are resolved, and keep the client engaged through the next decision. Maintain clear next steps, timing, and blockers for each active opportunity while responding to new inbound requests.
  • Portfolio Selling: Clients rarely arrive with their full set of needs articulated. You will be responsible for understanding the clientâs broader growth plans, including global hiring, EOR and payroll needs, marketing and sales growth, financial, and technology challenges, and for positioning Toptal as a strategic partner rather than a single-transaction vendor.
  • Client Experience: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. You will execute a client-centric approach across every interaction during pre-defined working hours, running rapid research on clients before outreach, asking focused questions to fill the gaps, and staying current on industry trends and the competitive landscape so that you bring a point of view to the conversation.
  • Collaboration: You will work with your team and with cross-functional partners, including matching, delivery, HireGlobal, and Toptalâs service offerings experts, to respond promptly to high-volume inbound inquiries and to bring the right expertise into a deal at the right moment. Communicating clearly over Zoom and Slack is critical.
  • Growth and Development: Our SMB team improves individually and as a team. You will review your own calls, seek and act on feedback, and contribute what you learn back to the team.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptalâs model, our team members, and our story.
  • Begin our 1-1 sales training covering our value proposition, discovery framework, sales process, and delivery method.
  • Become acquainted with the cross-functional teams you will work with to close new business.
  • Listen to recorded client calls and identify what the advisor did well and what they missed.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Complete our personalized sales training program, including mock calls and role-play scenarios.
  • Run an inbound conversation independently: identify the clientâs need, explain the relevant offering and value proposition, handle common concerns, and ask for commitment.
  • Prepare clear briefs to bring necessary specialist teams into opportunities.
  • Begin closing new business, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be fully ramped and integrated into the team.
  • Complete additional vertical-specific training.
  • Manage incoming leads alongside active opportunities, keep clients engaged through technical stages, and deliver against conversion and conversation-quality targets.
  • Maintain a healthy, accurately forecast pipeline moving through your funnel.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Have a solid history of claiming and closing new business by consistently meeting or exceeding both sales and quality expectations and targets.
  • Identify where opportunities are losing momentum and improve your follow-through using evidence from your own work.
  • Suggest process improvement areas to increase team efficiency and effectiveness, which may include providing consultation or advice to management on policies and procedures.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Mentor new team members, helping them learn our model and pass along standard methodologies.
  • Demonstrate sustained sales and quality performance across initial conversion and continued partnership opportunities on inbound existing clients.
  • Be a reference point for the team on discovery quality and on positioning the full Toptal portfolio.
  • Become a productive, collaborative, and consistent contributor to the team.

Required Qualifications

  • 2â3 years of B2B sales experience (Account Executive, Inside Sales, Sales Development, Account Representative, or a related role).
  • Demonstrated experience converting inbound opportunities into paying customers at scale, owning the sale from first call to close.
  • Experience coordinating parallel sales opportunities, and maintaining sales momentum while other teams complete necessary work.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Full availability during your working hours to take client calls.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company, managing a high volume of clients alongside competing deadlines.
  • Exceptional time management is key to success in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Software, tech, or professional-services sales experience.
  • Exposure to a named sales methodology â MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar.
  • Experience selling more than one product or service line into the same account.
  • Familiarity with global hiring, EOR, or payroll concepts.
  • Fluency with modern sales tooling, including AI-assisted research, call review, and CRM workflows.

Core Competencies

  • Consultative discovery. You ask open-ended questions, listen for what is not being said, and diagnose before you prescribe. You are comfortable sitting in a question rather than rushing to a pitch.
  • Qualification discipline. You know the difference between interest and intent. You can articulate why a deal will close, who will sign, and what happens if the client does nothing.
  • Business acumen. You can hold a credible conversation with a founder or business owner about growth, hiring, cost, and risk â and connect what you sell to what they are trying to achieve.
  • Point of view. You bring insight to the conversation. You are willing to respectfully reframe a clientâs thinking when their stated request isnât the best path to their goal.
  • Client-centricity. You uncover and resolve client issues through value-based selling, and you are direct about fit when Toptal isnât the right answer.
  • Will to win. You are naturally competitive and looking to exceed quota, not just meet it. We provide a base salary plus uncapped commission, and we want our Client Advisors to make the most of it.
  • Learn-it-all mindset. You constantly seek feedback from peers and leaders, review your own calls, and share what you learn with the team.
  • Ownership. You operate as a self-directed individual contributor who takes full accountability for your pipeline and your results, while collaborating effectively with the cross-functional partners who help you win.

jobs.title: Baker - Bakery Production - Maribo, Lolland, Denmark
jobs.description:
Den Gamle Bagergaard in Maribo is looking for a baker. You do not need a formal qualification if you have practical experience working in a bakery.

We are a family-run business with three bakers and a pastry chef in production. Two packing staff and a driver help get our bread ready and delivered to our shops.

Your work

You will take part in the daily production at the bakery. We are looking for someone who knows their way around a bakery, takes responsibility for their work and enjoys working with colleagues. You must be able to communicate in Danish or understandable English.

You must already have the legal right to work in Denmark, for example through EU/EEA or Swiss citizenship or a valid Danish residence and work permit. We cannot offer visa or work permit sponsorship.

What we offer

Gross monthly salary: Based on qualifications and experience. For a qualified baker, the salary starts at approximately DKK 26,000.

Permanent, full-time employment

Pension scheme

5 weeks of vacation

Flexible benefits account

Additional pay for applicable night and Sunday work

The employer can support you in finding accommodation in the area

The planned working hours start at 01:30 on Mondays and 05:00 from Tuesday to Thursday. You will also work every other weekend. During the night shifts on Mondays and every other weekend, you will bake bread, Danish pastries and other baked goods. We will agree on the schedule together, and working night shifts only is also an option.

The expected start date is 1 November 2026.

Recruitment process

The first interview can be held online if needed. Selected candidates may be invited to visit the bakery before a final employment agreement is made.

We review applications as they arrive, so please apply as soon as possible.

How to apply

Send your application and CV to rekruttering@lolland.dk with "Baker - Maribo" in the subject line.

If you have questions, contact Martin Hansen, Business Consultant and EURES Adviser at Lolland Municipality, on +45 21 47 73 43 or maha@lolland.dk.

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and intermediaries to refrain from contacting us regarding this position. Applications will only be considered if submitted directly by candidates.

About Lolland and relocation support

Lolland is in southern Denmark and offers easy access to nature, beaches and open countryside, along with affordable housing and short commuting distances. The region is developing rapidly, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link between Denmark and Germany.

If you are moving from abroad, Lolland Municipality's Newcomers Service can help with practical questions about relocation, registration, housing, a partner's job search and settling in Denmark. Read more at https://newcomers.lolland.dk/. You can also find information about working in Denmark at https://www.workindenmark.dk/

jobs.title: Teknisk medarbejder med flair for elektronik søges til Try & Hire-forløb i Lunderskov
jobs.description:
På vegne af en af vores kunder i Lunderskov søger FIRMAVIKAR en dygtig og engageret teknisk medarbejder med flair for elektronik.

Der er tale om et Try & Hire-forløb, hvor du starter som vikar gennem FIRMAVIKAR med henblik på efterfølgende fastansættelse direkte hos virksomheden, hvis samarbejdet fungerer godt for begge parter.

Om jobbet

Du bliver en del af virksomhedens elafdeling og får en alsidig hverdag med praktiske og tekniske opgaver inden for blandt andet elektronik, fejlfinding, reparation, montage og test.

Du bliver grundigt oplært i virksomhedens produkter, systemer og teknologier, så du får de bedste forudsætninger for at komme godt ind i jobbet.

  • Produktion og montage af tekniske og elektroniske løsninger

  • Vedligeholdelse og serviceeftersyn

  • Samarbejde med kolleger om tekniske løsninger og forbedringer

Vi søger dig, der

Du har gerne en uddannelse som elektronikfagtekniker, elektronikmekaniker, automatiktekniker eller en anden relevant teknisk baggrund.

Det vigtigste er dog, at du har teknisk forståelse, flair for elektronik og lyst til at arbejde praktisk med tekniske løsninger.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med elektronisk fejlfinding og reparation

  • Kan læse og forstå tekniske diagrammer og manualer

  • Arbejder struktureret, selvstændigt og kvalitetsbevidst

  • Tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Er nysgerrig og har lyst til at lære nyt

  • Trives med både selvstændige opgaver og samarbejde med kolleger

  • Søger en stilling med mulighed for fastansættelse

Vi tilbyder

  • Et Try & Hire-forløb med henblik på fastansættelse

  • En fuldtidsstilling med langsigtede muligheder

  • Grundig oplæring i virksomhedens produkter og teknologier

  • Varierede og teknisk spændende arbejdsopgaver

  • Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling

  • Frihed under ansvar

  • Gode kolleger og et stærkt fagligt fællesskab

Arbejdssted

Lunderskov

Opstart

Snarest muligt.

jobs.title: Chef / Cook – Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar, Kalundborg
jobs.description:
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar is looking for skilled and motivated Chefs / Cooks to join our established restaurant in Kalundborg, Denmark.

Our restaurant in Kalundborg is a well-run, busy operation with a proven concept, experienced ownership and a clear direction. Located right in the middle of Kalundborg's main pedestrian street, we are a lively, pulsing part of the town and a gathering place for its residents. Our purpose is to create a vibrant place for the people of Kalundborg, built on quality ingredients and good food. We are now strengthening our kitchen team and are looking for chefs who want to become part of a structured, professional kitchen and contribute to consistent, high-quality service every day.

Our concept is based on modern Danish cuisine with a Nordic twist, combined with well executed brasserie classics and a varied à la carte menu. We focus on quality ingredients, solid craftsmanship and seasonal cooking, with dishes that combine flavour, comfort and consistency. Our menu includes both classic meat dishes, such as pepper steak, pasta dishes and other popular brasserie favourites.

Alongside our à la carte service, we have a private dining and events room, which you will also be part of. It brings welcome variety to the daily kitchen work, with menus that differ from the standard à la carte and the chance to cook for parties, celebrations and special occasions.

You will be joining a business with an already proven concept, an organised kitchen and a strong operational foundation. The setup is stable and well prepared, giving you a secure framework in which to do great work and develop your craft. Here you also get the freedom to bring your own ideas to life. We are not a place where everything is dictated from above — our chefs and kitchen staff are given the room to develop dishes, contribute to the menu and put their own mark on the food.

We are a serious but friendly workplace with respectful leadership, an organised kitchen environment and a no-drama culture. We believe strong kitchens are built on structure, teamwork and professionalism.

We are looking for chefs / cooks who:
• Have experience working in a professional kitchen
• Can handle prep, mise en place and service in a structured way
• Have experience with à la carte service
• Care about quality, teamwork and consistency
• Thrive in a busy restaurant environment
• Can work independently and take responsibility during service

We offer:
• Full-time employment
• A fixed work schedule
• Weekend work is part of the position
• Salary of approximately DKK 30,000–35,000 gross per month, depending on qualifications and experience
• Five weeks of paid holiday
• Company apartment / accommodation available
• Help with relocation and settling in Denmark
• Possibility of support with moving costs and/or paid accommodation in the first month, by agreement
• Good working conditions in a structured and professional environment
• Staff meals
• Work clothing provided
• Staff discounts
• A stable, established restaurant with a proven concept and an organised kitchen
• The freedom to develop your own ideas and contribute to the menu
• A workplace where English can be used in daily communication

Location
The position is based in Kalundborg, Denmark, in the heart of the city's main pedestrian street. Kalundborg offers a local Danish atmosphere, a charming town centre and a good quality of life.

Language
English is required. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Start date
As soon as possible / by agreement.

How to apply
Please send
• Your CV
• A short introduction about yourself
• Your earliest possible start date

For applications and questions, please contact:
Esbern Snare ApS
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar
Phone: +45 25 14 44 00
Email: job@esbern-snare.dk

We look forward to hearing from motivated chefs who want to become part of a strong, established kitchen team in Denmark.

Please note that you must already have the right to work in Denmark, either as an EU/EEA or Swiss citizen or by holding a valid Danish work permit that allows you to take this position.

jobs.title: Baker – Bakery Production – Maribo, Lolland, Denmark
jobs.description:
Dansk version længere nede

Den Gamle Bagergaard in Maribo is looking for a baker. You do not need a formal qualification if you have practical experience working in a bakery.

We are a family-run business with three bakers and a pastry chef in production. Two packing staff and a driver help get our bread ready and delivered to our shops.

Your work

You will take part in the daily production at the bakery. We are looking for someone who knows their way around a bakery, takes responsibility for their work and enjoys working with colleagues. You must be able to communicate in Danish or understandable English.

You must already have the legal right to work in Denmark, for example through EU/EEA or Swiss citizenship or a valid Danish residence and work permit. We cannot offer visa or work permit sponsorship.

What we offer

  • Gross monthly salary: Based on qualifications and experience. For a qualified baker, the salary starts at approximately DKK 26,000.

  • Permanent, full-time employment

  • Pension scheme

  • 5 weeks of vacation

  • Flexible benefits account

  • Additional pay for applicable night and Sunday work

  • The employer can support you in finding accommodation in the area

The planned working hours start at 01:30 on Mondays and 05:00 from Tuesday to Thursday. You will also work every other weekend. During the night shifts on Mondays and every other weekend, you will bake bread, Danish pastries and other baked goods. We will agree on the schedule together, and working night shifts only is also an option.

The expected start date is 1 November 2026.

Recruitment process

The first interview can be held online if needed. Selected candidates may be invited to visit the bakery before a final employment agreement is made.

We review applications as they arrive, so please apply as soon as possible.

How to apply

Send your application and CV to rekruttering@lolland.dk with “Baker – Maribo” in the subject line.

If you have questions, contact Martin Hansen, Business Consultant and EURES Adviser at Lolland Municipality, on +45 21 47 73 43 or maha@lolland.dk.

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and intermediaries to refrain from contacting us regarding this position. Applications will only be considered if submitted directly by candidates.

About Lolland and relocation support

Lolland is in southern Denmark and offers easy access to nature, beaches and open countryside, along with affordable housing and short commuting distances. The region is developing rapidly, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link between Denmark and Germany.

If you are moving from abroad, Lolland Municipality’s Newcomers Service can help with practical questions about relocation, registration, housing, a partner’s job search and settling in Denmark. Read more at newcomers.lolland.dk. You can also find information about working in Denmark at workindenmark.dk.

___________________________________________________

Den Gamle Bagergaard i Maribo søger en bager. Du behøver ikke at have svendebrev, hvis du har praktisk erfaring fra et bageri.

Vi er en familievirksomhed med tre bagere og en konditor i produktionen. Derudover har vi to pakkere og en chauffør, som kører brød ud til vores udsalg.

Jobbet

Du bliver en del af den daglige produktion i bageriet. Vi søger dig, der kender arbejdet i et bageri, tager ansvar for dine opgaver og trives med at arbejde sammen med andre. Du skal kunne kommunikere på dansk eller forståeligt engelsk.

Det tilbyder vi

  • Løn: Aftales efter kvalifikationer og erfaring i henhold til overenskomsten.

  • Fast fuldtidsstilling

  • Pension, feriepenge og fritvalgskonto

  • Relevante tillæg for nat- og søndagsarbejde

  • Hjælp til at finde en bolig i området, hvis du skal flytte hertil

Arbejdstiden er som udgangspunkt fra kl. 01.30 om mandagen og kl. 05.00 tirsdag til torsdag samt hver anden weekend. Når du møder ind om natten, bager du blandt andet brød og wienerbrød. Vi aftaler den nærmere plan sammen, og det er også muligt kun at arbejde om natten.

Forventet start er 1. november 2026.

Ansættelsesforløb

Den første samtale kan holdes online, hvis der er behov for det. Vi gennemgår ansøgninger løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Søg jobbet

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til rekruttering@lolland.dk, og skriv “Bager – Maribo” i emnefeltet.

Har du spørgsmål, kan du kontakte virksomhedskonsulent Martin Hansen på 21 47 73 43 eller maha@lolland.dk.

jobs.title: Skilled Chef with strong knowledge of Ukrainian cuisine
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Skilled Production Chef with strong knowledge of Ukrainian cuisine

At Best Western Plus Park Globetrotter Copenhagen Airport, we are looking for an experienced chef with strong knowledge of authentic Ukrainian cuisine to join our kitchen team.

We are looking for someone who takes pride in good craftsmanship, authentic flavours and consistent quality — and who enjoys being part of a team where cooperation, responsibility and a practical approach are important.

In this role, you will have a key part in preparing and developing our Ukrainian food production and ensuring that our dishes are made with the same quality and authenticity every time.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has professional kitchen experience, preferably as a trained chef

  • Has strong knowledge of traditional Ukrainian dishes and cooking methods

  • Is comfortable working with larger-scale food production

  • Works independently, structured and with attention to detail

  • Has a strong focus on quality, food safety and hygiene

  • Can communicate in English or Danish

  • Enjoys being part of a hands-on and supportive kitchen team

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Preparing, cooking and portioning Ukrainian dishes

  • Maintaining and standardising recipes

  • Ensuring consistent taste and quality

  • Supporting an efficient and well-organised daily production

  • Contributing to high food safety and hygiene standards

What we offer

  • A key role in an international hotel environment

  • The opportunity to work with and further develop authentic Ukrainian cuisine

  • Responsibility and influence in the daily kitchen operation

  • A supportive and informal working environment

  • A team where collaboration and quality are highly valued

  • Good opportunities to develop together with the hotel and the operation

Location: Best Western Plus Park Globetrotter Copenhagen Airport

jobs.title: Database and network professionals
jobs.description: Per conto di una realtà tecnologica di grandi dimensioni, operante in un contesto internazionale, siamo alla ricerca di un/una Senior Cyber Security Engineer da inserire all'interno di un team Cyber Security strutturato. La risorsa entrerà a far parte di una funzione tecnica che opera trasversalmente a supporto delle diverse aree IT, Software e Business del Gruppo, contribuendo alla progettazione, evoluzione e miglioramento dei servizi e dei controlli di Cyber Security. Cerchiamo un professionista con una buona seniority tecnica e una visione trasversale della sicurezza, capace di andare oltre la gestione operativa degli incidenti e contribuire all'evoluzione dell'ecosistema Cyber aziendale. Principali responsabilità La persona sarà coinvolta in attività quali: supporto a nuovi progetti IT e Software secondo principi di Security by Design, attraverso security review e definizione dei requisiti di sicurezza; definizione ed evoluzione dei controlli di Cloud Security, principalmente in ambienti Microsoft Azure e AWS; presidio delle tematiche di Identity Security, con particolare riferimento a Microsoft Entra ID e Active Directory; valutazione e scouting di nuove tecnologie e servizi messi a disposizione dai principali cloud e security provider; evoluzione dei servizi di Cyber Security Monitoring, collaborando con il SOC esterno e contribuendo al tuning delle piattaforme SIEM e dei relativi controlli di detection; attività di Vulnerability Management su componenti infrastrutturali e applicative; evoluzione dei presidi di sicurezza relativi a Firewall, WAF, endpoint, infrastrutture e ambienti Cloud; supporto ad attività di Incident Response e miglioramento continuo dei relativi processi e controlli; partecipazione alla definizione di iniziative di Purple Teaming, finalizzate all'identificazione delle aree di miglioramento della postura difensiva; confronto con Software Architect, Service Manager, team IT e Business per integrare i requisiti Cyber all'interno di nuovi servizi e applicazioni; supporto, quando necessario, nel confronto con clienti enterprise sui presidi di sicurezza adottati nei servizi erogati. Profilo ricercato Cerchiamo un professionista con esperienza in ambito Cyber Security Engineering, Cloud Security, Infrastructure Security o Security Architecture, maturata in contesti aziendali strutturati o all'interno di società di consulenza tecnologica. Non è necessario aver maturato esperienza approfondita in tutte le aree indicate. Sarà particolarmente interessante una solida competenza in una o più delle seguenti: Cloud Security in ambienti Azure e/o AWS; Identity & Access Security, Entra ID / Active Directory; Security Engineering e definizione di security controls; Cyber Security Monitoring e tecnologie SIEM/XDR; Vulnerability Management; Infrastructure & Network Security; Application Security / Security by Design. Saranno considerate un plus esperienze in ambito Microsoft Security, Microsoft 365 Security, Incident Response, Purple Teaming e attività di security assessment. È richiesta una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Offerta RAL indicativa: €50.000 - €60.000 + MBO, valutabile in funzione dell'esperienza; inserimento diretto a tempo indeterminato; modalità di lavoro ibrida con 2 giorni alla settimana in presenza a Bologna; #LI-AM2

jobs.title: Agent Business Partner (h/f/x)
jobs.description:
Agent Business Partner (H/F/X)

Sur un marché de plus en plus concurrentiel, le Groupe Foyer reste fidèle à ses valeurs : Confiance, Excellence, Innovation, Intégrité, Indépendance.

Dans le cadre du développement de ses activités, Foyer Assurances recherche un(e) Agent Business Partner (h/f/n).

L'Agent Business Partner est le référent de ses agences, leur sparing partner

- Il est le contact principal de ses agences pour les sujets stratégiques
- Côté compagnie, il est le « bras prolongé » du Responsable des Agences
- Il définit des ambitions communes avec ses agences, en réalisant notamment un BP 3-5 ans
- Il se met d'accord avec ses agences sur la manière de les atteindre (→ plan d‘action)
- Il soutient ses agences an cas de difficultés ou lors de situations complexes (succession, scission, renforcement, recrutement, formations, etc.)

Vos missions :

L'Agent Business Partner est une personne de terrain, dont la mission est d'être au quotidien chez ses agences. Il n'a pas vocation d'accompagner ses agences chez des clients/prospects. Ses principales compétences et les tâches y associées seront :

• Vision stratégique
o Comprendre le business d'agence d'assurance en général, la situation particulière de ses agences en particulier et identifier les leviers de développement
o Diagnostic
o Lire/comprendre rapidement une situation complexe
• Influence
o Convaincre sans autorité hiérarchique
• Leadership
o Faire progresser le(s) associé(s) de ses agences
• Orientation résultats
o Prioriser les actions à fort impact
• Intelligence relationnelle
o Créer une relation de confiance tout en étant exigeant

Votre profil :

- Vous disposez d'un Master
- Vous disposez d'une expérience de 10 ans et plus dans une fonction managériale d'entrepreneurs
- Vous maitrisez les connaissances de base en assurances
- Vous êtes bilingue en luxembourgeois et français. L'allemand et l'anglais sont considérés comme un atout

Nous offrons :

Vous bénéficierez, entre autres, des avantages suivants :

• Un environnement de travail multiculturel, apprenant et innovant,
•  Un système d'horaire flexible & de télétravail
•  Un restaurant d'entreprise à tarif préférentiel,
•  Une salle de sport avec coach,
•  Une conciergerie.

jobs.title: Business Developer Non Retail (h/f/x)
jobs.description:
Business Developer Non Retail (H/F/X)

Chez Foyer, nous plaçons la proximité client et le développement commercial au cœur de notre stratégie. Afin de renforcer notre présence sur le marché des professionnels et des entreprises, nous recherchons un(e) Business Developer Non Retail.

Véritable partenaire du réseau d'agences, vous contribuez activement au développement de la clientèle non retail en accompagnant les agences dans la prospection, la détection d'opportunités et la conquête de nouveaux clients.

Votre mission

En tant que Business Developer Non Retail, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les agences afin d'accélérer le développement du portefeuille de clients professionnels et entreprises.
Grâce à votre expertise commerciale et à votre connaissance du marché, vous identifiez de nouvelles opportunités d'affaires, accompagnez les équipes dans leur démarche commerciale et contribuez à l'atteinte des objectifs de croissance de Foyer.

Vos responsabilités

• Prospection commerciale en support des agences
o Identifier de nouveaux prospects.
o Aider les agences à effectuer des appels, emails, rendez-vous et actions de networking.
o Aider les agnecs à développer un portefeuille clients non retail.
• Analyse des besoins d'un client non retail
o Comprendre les enjeux et problématiques du client.
o Réaliser un diagnostic de ses besoins via un bilan pro.
o Identifier les opportunités de vente.
• Présentation et négociation des offres
o Concevoir des propositions commerciales adaptées.
o Présenter avec les agences les solutions à l'entreprise.
o Négocier les prix et conditions contractuelles.
• Vente et conclusion des contrats
o Transformer les opportunités en contrats d'assurances.
o Assurer le suivi des négociations jusqu'à la signature du contrat.
o Atteindre les objectifs de production.
• Relation avec les agences
o Construire, puis maintenir une relation de confiance avec les agences.
o Assurer un suivi régulier.
o Identifier de nouvelles opportunités de développement (cross-selling, upselling).

Votre profil

• Formation supérieure en commerce, assurance, gestion ou domaine équivalent.
• Expérience réussie dans le développement commercial, idéalement dans les secteurs de l'assurance, de la banque ou des services.
• Forte orientation résultats et goût prononcé pour le développement commercial.
• Excellentes capacités relationnelles et de négociation.
• Esprit d'équipe et aptitude à travailler dans un environnement collaboratif.
• Autonomie, proactivité et sens de l'initiative.
• Bonne compréhension des enjeux liés à la clientèle professionnelle et entreprises.
• Maitrise du français et de l'anglais ; tout autre langue est un atout.

jobs.title: Head of International Markets (m/f)
jobs.description:
Head of International Markets

Permanent contract

At HSBC, we're a trusted international organisation with a global customer base of around 39 million customers worldwide through a network that covers 62 countries and territories. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank and we need talent like you to help us meet our ambition. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top or in an exciting new direction - we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

The HSBC Group in Luxembourg is a significant employer and operates several businesses including asset management, securities services, private banking and corporate banking.

By joining us, you'll help evolve and grow our private banking business.

What you will do:

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer Luxembourg, you will define and execute the Bank's international business development and market corridor strategy in Asia, the Middle East, the UK and the US. Working closely with the Business Head and Relationship Managers, you will drive disciplined delivery of Net New Money (NNM) and revenue, while safeguarding segment and book purity and ensuring a consistently strong client experience. You will promote HSBC Private Bank Luxembourg as the Booking Centre of choice for HSBC PB's international clients, seeking diversification in Continental Europe. As a senior member within the Luxembourg Front Office management team, you will also be accountable for governance and risk management processes and provide supervisory oversight of business activities.

In this role, you will (but not limited to):

• Own retention and growth of a Luxembourg-based private banking portfolio sourced from key international markets (Asia, Middle East, UK and US).
• Drive deepening across investments, lending and deposits (where applicable), reducing attrition and ensuring appropriate booking governance and book purity for corridor-sourced relationships.
• Run disciplined sales management, including opportunity qualification, pricing/returns focus, and activity standards.
• Establish corridor-to-PBLU portfolio routines (pipeline, attrition watchlist, top-client plans, rebooking/booking exception management).
• Define, refresh and execute the International Markets strategy in close partnership with the Business Heads, including priority client segments, target industries, and value propositions.
• Build and execute PBLU awareness and adoption plan through structured engagement programmes (education series, immersion and exchange visits, regular follow-ups) to deepen understanding of PBLU's platform, offering and capabilities across other HSBC Private Bank booking centres and relevant HSBC lines of business.
• Deliver market financial targets (revenue, margin, profitability, cost-to-serve where applicable), monitor performance drivers (mix, pricing, attrition, productivity), and ensure transparent forecasting by high-quality management information.

You should apply if you have:

• Extensive experience in Private Banking Relationship Management and senior client-facing roles.
• Positive track record in business development and risk management.
• Strong, up-to-date understanding of the market landscape, peer product offering and industry innovation.
• Experience working with clients and teams across Asia, MENA, the UK and the US.
• Demonstrated ability to shape market strategy and multi-year business plans, including footprint/capability design and target setting.
• Strong commercial execution skills, including pipeline management, conversion discipline, pricing/returns focus.
• Strong stakeholder management skills across products, operations, risk, compliance and multiple geographies.
• Fluent English (written and spoken).

Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply, if you believe this role is right for you.

What you'll get in return:

The pay range for this role is EUR 155,700 - 233,600.

HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. Variable pay is designed to reward colleagues for their individual performance and contribution, as well as the performance of their relevant Business / Infrastructure, and the overall Group.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits usually covering health support, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

HSBC has been certified “Top Employer 2026” in Europe. This recognition from the Top Employers Institute rewards our HR practices and recognises HSBC as an HR Leader in France, Germany, Italy, Ireland, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Poland and Spain.

If you're looking for a career where you will be respected as an individual and valued for the contributions you make, please visit our career page, and discover how diversity drives our success.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we're dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Please note that every selected candidate will have to provide us with a valid criminal record check in due time.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. For any GDPR request, please send it to: lux.data.privacy@hsbc.com

For further information on building your career at HSBC, please visit: www.hsbc.com/careers  

Discover how ‘We Value Difference'.

jobs.title: Banquier Privé - Développeur (H/F)
jobs.description:
Description & Requirements


BGL BNP Paribas est une des plus grandes banques du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg et fait partie du Groupe BNP Paribas.

Elle propose à ses clients particuliers, professionnels, entreprises et de banque privée une gamme particulièrement large de produits financiers et de solutions de bancassurance.

En 2024, BGL BNP Paribas a été désignée « Best Bank in Luxembourg » par Euromoney et a obtenu en 2025, pour la 10è année consécutive, la certification « Top Employer Luxembourg », saluant l'excellence des conditions de travail offertes à ses collaborateurs.


Dans le cadre de nos activités au sein de notre Banque Privée Luxembourg, nous recherchons, pour une embauche en CDI, un/une :

Banquier Privé - Développeur (H/F)


CONCRÈTEMENT, VOTRE MISSION ET VOTRE QUOTIDIEN ?


Sous la responsabilité du Directeur de l'équipe, vous serez en charge de :

Objectif principal : développer le portefeuille de la banque privée en prospectant et en acquérant de nouveaux clients fortunés (HNW/UHNW).


Missions clés:

Prospection : identifier, qualifier et approcher des prospects via le réseau personnel, les recommandations, les réseaux d'apporteurs d'affaires, les événements et les études de marché.
Construction de relations : instaurer une relation de confiance, comprendre les besoins patrimoniaux et proposer les solutions BNP Paribas Banque Privée adaptées.
Développement commercial : définir et suivre une stratégie de pipeline, atteindre les objectifs de nouveaux mandats et mesurer les indicateurs de conversion (croissance, rentabilité).
Cross‑selling : identifier les opportunités permettant de travailler avec les spécialistes (ie stratégie, investissements, crédit, planification successorale, etc.) ainsi qu'avec les autres métiers de la banque (ie. corporate banking, leasing, assurance, etc) pour offrir des solutions complètes.
Conformité & Risk: veiller au respect notamment des exigences réglementaires (MiFID II), de la supervision ECB, des procédures en matière de AML/KYC en assurant une excellente maîtrise des risques.
Reporting : rendre compte régulièrement de l'activité de prospection, du pipeline et des résultats d'acquisition à la direction.


LES MISSIONS C'EST IMPORTANT, L'ÉQUIPE ET L'ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL AUSSI !


Votre environnement de travail

Vous travaillez au sein d'une équipe internationale à taille humaine, composée d'experts avec différents horizons d'expertises
Vous échangez et partagez avec nos différents services internes afin d'optimiser vos connaissances pour ainsi répondre au mieux aux attentes de vos clients.


ÊTES-VOUS NOTRE FUTUR(E) BANQUIER PRIVE - DEVELOPPEUR (H/F) ?

Profil recherché : expérience confirmée d'au moins 8 ans en Private Banking ou gestion de fortune avec un historique de génération de nouveaux mandats, bonne connaissance des produits d'investissement et de crédit, compétences commerciales et relationnelles fortes, capacité à travailler de façon autonome tout en collaborant avec les équipes internes.


Expérience professionnelle et/ou diplôme:

Formation universitaire à orientation financière, économique, commerciale avec un intérêt personnel pour la relation client et la banque privée.


Compétences comportementales :

Capacité d'initiative / créativité & innovation
Sens commercial
Rigoureux et organisé
Esprit d'équipe


Connaissances linguistiques:

Description des tâches


Responsable Administratif et Financier
Rattachement hiérarchique
Direction Générale


Contexte de l'entreprise:

Dans le cadre de la réorganisation opérationnelle et du futur départ de notre actuelle Directrice Administrative d'ici fin 2026, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Responsable Administratif et Financier.

Dans notre environnement d'entreprise multiculturel (allemand, français, luxembourgeois) d'installation et maintenance HVAC, ce poste combine des fonctions de pilotage opérationnel, de contrôle de gestion rigoureux et de supervision transversale.


Missions et Responsabilités Clés:

Le/la RAF aura la responsabilité de superviser les quatre grands piliers de notre administration :

1. Management Général et Opérationnel

Assurer le pilotage de l'organisation administrative globale et le support au quotidien (informatique, événements, parc automobile, matériel).
Manager l'équipe de l'administration : piloter la répartition des tâches, assurer la montée en compétences et gérer les absences et suppléances.
Optimiser et digitaliser les processus internes, résoudre les problématiques inter-services et faire remonter (escalader) les points bloquants à la direction.
Fournir un support opérationnel à la direction générale par la préparation d'analyses, d'évaluations et de bases de décision.

2. Contrôle de Gestion, Finance & Audit

Piloter le contrôle de gestion des projets : analyser les écarts (coûts/recettes/marges), réviser les prévisions, valider les durées de projets et contrôler les coûts post-clôture.
Assurer l'interface entre la finance et le métier : aligner les données de la comptabilité avec la gestion de projet, et suivre les flux de trésorerie (garanties bancaires, retenues de garantie).
Coordonner de manière centrale l'audit financier avec notre auditeur externe (pré-audit de novembre et audit final en mars-avril), préparer les dossiers et justifier les données.

3. Supervision Comptable et RH (en binôme)

Encadrer la facturation régulière et en temps utile des clients.
Organiser les relances et suivre le bon recouvrement des factures clients.
Assurer les cycles de paiement (et la collecte systématique des escomptes fournisseurs).
Procéder au contrôle et à la validation finale des factures d'achat du département administratif.
Superviser l'administration RH : contrôler avec ses équipes les temps de travail avant l'envoi en paie, apporter un support à la rédaction de courriers/contrats RH, et faire l'interface avec le comité d'entreprise.
Fixer les grilles salariales annuelles, notamment pour la facturation des heures de projets.

4. Administration des Systèmes, Gérance Juridique, Services Généraux et Projets Transversaux

Gérer l'administration du système ERP (LABEL) : gérer les accès et les droits, effectuer les clôtures mensuelles et annuelles.
Assurer le suivi des engagements contractuels et la gestion globale des assurances (incluant le traitement des sinistres sur les chantiers et les bâtiments).
Assurer la supervision hiérarchique et le contrôle de la gestion du parc automobile (fleet management).
Piloter la qualité (norme ISO 9001) et mener des projets transversaux d'amélioration continue tels que la poursuite de la digitalisation de l'entreprise.


Profil et Qualités Requises:


Compétences Linguistiques:

En raison de la forte multiculturalité de notre entreprise et des interactions quotidiennes avec les différentes équipes, le profil recherché doit impérativement parler et comprendre l'allemand et le français.
La compréhension du luxembourgeois constitue un atout supplémentaire.


Expertise Technique (Hard Skills):

Solide formation et expérience avérée en gestion financière, contrôle de gestion (idéalement appliqué à la gestion de projets) et comptabilité.
Maîtrise des mécanismes de préparation et de justification lors d'audits financiers (ex. : relation avec des auditeurs).
Expérience dans l'administration des Ressources Humaines et le droit contractuel/gestion des assurances.
Forte aisance informatique avec les systèmes de type ERP (l'administration de logiciels type LABEL est un plus).


Savoir-être et Aptitudes (Soft Skills):

Excellente capacité managériale pour encadrer, coordonner et faire évoluer une équipe variée.
Esprit critique et excellente capacité d'analyse pour évaluer et challenger des données financières et économiques.
Sens aigu de l'organisation garantissant une stricte séparation des rôles entre l'exécution, le contrôle et la validation.
Excellentes compétences de communication inter-départements (capacité à lier les visions comptables, administratives et métier).

jobs.title: Junior National Funding Advisor – Innovation & Sustainability Grants (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Fixed-term contract (CDD – 24 months), full-time, ref.: JNF09
Service: National Funding
Hierarchical Superior: Head of National Funding

About Luxinnovation
Luxinnovation is Luxembourg's national innovation agency. As a semi-public institution set up as an Economic Interest Group (GIE), we empower companies to innovate today to be ready for tomorrow. We also contribute to the development of the economy as a whole by identifying innovation opportunities and fostering collaborative innovation projects that stimulate the development of a sustainable, competitive and digital economy.
Luxinnovation is supported by three ministries — the Ministry of the Economy, the Ministry for Research and Higher Education, and the Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs — as well as three semi-public institutions: the Luxembourg Chamber of Commerce, the Luxembourg Chamber of Skilled Crafts, and FEDIL – The Voice of Luxembourg's Industry.

Job mission
Department description
One of Luxinnovation's core activities is to support companies seeking national funding for their innovation activities and sustainability investments. The mission of the National Funding team is to guide and support companies throughout the process of applying for innovation and environmental state aid, ensuring they access the right instruments at the right time.
Job description
As a Junior National Funding Advisor, you will reinforce the National Funding team in the context of increased demand for innovation funding and decarbonisation grants. You will provide first-level guidance to companies, support eligibility assessments and contribute to the promotion of national funding opportunities — including the AI Factory initiative and environmental aid schemes.
You will progressively develop expertise across funding instruments, eligibility criteria and application processes under the mentorship of experienced advisors.

Main tasks and responsibilities
Your responsibilities are structured around Luxinnovation's four core pillars of activity:
Inspire:
• Contribute to the promotion of national funding opportunities by supporting the planning, coordination and delivery of awareness campaigns, workshops and events, particularly in relation to emerging environmental and AI aid schemes.
• Assist the National Funding team in knowledge-sharing activities and continuous improvement initiatives that contribute to the team's effectiveness and visibility.
Assess & Accelerate:
• Under the guidance of experienced advisors, participate in client meetings and support the preliminary assessment of companies seeking public funding for research, innovation and sustainability projects, including conducting eligibility checks and due diligence reviews.
• Support the review of funding applications by analysing project descriptions, financial statements, investment plans and supporting documentation, and contribute to the preparation of internal decision-support documents for Gate 1 and Gate 2 reviews.
Connect:
• Manage and qualify incoming client requests on a daily basis, with a particular focus on opportunities related to the AI Factory initiative and environmental/decarbonisation funding schemes, ensuring timely orientation towards relevant support services.
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date information within the customer relationship management (CRM) system and other internal tools, ensuring high-quality data management and effective follow-up of client interactions.
Fund:
• Provide first-level guidance to companies on available state aid instruments for innovation and sustainability, including the AI Factory initiative and environmental/decarbonisation funding schemes.
• Collaborate closely with senior members of the National Funding team to address more complex client enquiries and progressively develop expertise across funding instruments, eligibility criteria and application processes.
• Contribute to the preparation of client feedback and internal decision-support documents under the supervision of senior advisors.
This list is not exhaustive. Additional tasks may be assigned to the holder of the job.

You will act as a key bridge between national/European initiatives and the Luxembourg business ecosystem, driving innovation and sustainable growth.

Required competencies
Education level and professional experience required:
• Holder of a master's degree (bac+5 in the French university system) in economics, finance, business management, engineering or a dual scientific/management profile.
• Previous internship or professional experience of 1 to 2 years in an activity related to innovation funding, business consulting, financial analysis or state aid.
Specific competencies:
• Good skills in financial analysis and the ability to assess investment plans and business documentation.
• Strong writing skills and the ability to produce clear summary notes and decision-support documents.
• General knowledge of project management principles.
• Ability to manage several complex files efficiently and independently.
• Relational ease allowing effective interaction with partners at relevant ministries, financial institutions and business managers.
• Organised, flexible, autonomous with excellent listening and analytical skills.
• Interest in innovation ecosystems, decarbonisation and sustainability funding.
Languages:
• Fluent French and English (oral and written) are mandatory. Luxembourgish and/or German are considered a strong asset.
IT skills:
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel in particular).
• Familiarity with CRM tools and internal data management platforms.

Why choose this position?
Join a human-sized, multidisciplinary organisation where you will learn to carry out eligibility assessments using solid procedures, tools and databases. You will be part of a team with a strong team spirit and a culture of information sharing, with direct exposure to Luxembourg's innovation ecosystem. This role offers diversified and rewarding missions — from analysing state aid applications to participating in events on cutting-edge technology — giving you the opportunity to build a solid foundation in innovation funding and public support instruments.

Application
Interested candidates are invited to submit online their resume and a cover letter detailing their relevant experience and motivation for the role.
AI-generated applications might not be the best way to stand out. Show us the real you, and let's see where this journey takes us!
Please note that this position is based at our current offices in Esch-Belval. Luxinnovation GIE will relocate to the Luxembourg main station area in the first quarter of 2027.

  • Vozačka dozvola B kategorije.

  • Sposobnost brze identifikacije i rješavanja problema.
  • Iskustvo u razumijevanju tehničke dokumentacije.
  • Izvrsna sposobnost vođenja evidencije.
  • Komunikacijske vještine.
  • Fleksibilnost i timski rad.
  • Sposobnost postavljanja prioriteta.
  • Poželjno radno iskustvo od dvije godine u struci ili na sličnim poslovima.
Nudimo benefite i pogodnosti:
  • Briga o zdravlju: dopunsko i dodatno zdravstveno osiguranje (sistematski i specijalistički pregledi i slično), osiguranje zaposlenika od nezgode (24/7), besplatno korištenje teretane.

  • Balans privatnog i poslovnog: plaćeni i neplaćeni dopust za razne osobne potrebe, slobodan radni dan povodom rođendana zaposlenika, razna online savjetovanja za zaposlenike i programi pomoći te savjetovanja za razne životne teme.
  • Okruženje koje pokreće: podršku od strane kolega i voditelja, kontinuirani razvoj kroz stručno usavršavanje, obilježavanje događaja gdje slavimo uspjeh i izražavamo zahvalnost prema našim zaposlenicima.
Trajanje ugovora: Na određeno vrijeme s mogućnošću zasnivanja radnog odnosa na neodređeno vrijeme. jobs.title: TERENSKI SERVISER/KA
jobs.description:
Terenski serviser (m/ž)

Ključni zadaci i odgovornosti:

  • izvođenje servisnih radova u tvrtki i na terenu, na uređajima tvrtke RASCO i na ostalim uređajima koje tvrtka RASCO zastupa i distribuira
  • remont strojeva preuzetih od kupaca
  • izvođenje osnovne obuke za upravljanje Rasco strojevima i uređajima, i onima koje tvrtka RASCO zastupa
  • prijava nesukladnosti prikupljenih sa terena
  • unos podataka i korekcija u baze podataka kojima raspolaže servis
  • vođenje točnih zapisa vezanih za servisne radne naloge
  • kontrola tehničke ispravnosti i održavanje osobnih, dostavnih i teretnih vozila tvrtke

Traženi profil kandidata:

  • SSS tehničkog usmjerenja (automehaničar, autoelektričar, elektromonter itd.)
  • Poželjno 1 - 3 godina radnog iskustvu u sličnim poslovima, ali razmotriti ćemo i kandidate bez radnog iskustva, a koji su spremni proći intenzivnu obuku namijenjenu serviserima početnicima
  • Engleski ili njemački jezik (osnovna razina)
  • Korištenje računalom i MS Office aplikacijama (osnovno)
  • Vozačka dozvola B kategorija
  • Sklonost terenskom radu
  • Odgovoran pristup radnim zadacima
  • Sklonost timskom radu i fleksibilnost u poslu

Što nudimo:

  • Početnu plaću sukladno prethodnom iskustvu uz jasno definiranu mogućnost povećanja primanja nakon savladavanja zahtjeva radnog mjesta
  • Naknade troškova prijevoza na posao i s posla, dodatak za topli obrok i radne rezultate kao i isplata pripadajućih dnevnica i terenskog dodatka i prekovremenog rada na terenu
  • Ugovor o radu na neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rad od 3 mjeseca
  • Mentora i sustavno praćenje napretka s ciljem osiguravanja podrške i uspješno uvođenje u posao
  • Dodatne edukacije vezane uz specifičnosti radnog mjesta i edukacije namijenjene osobnom razvoju
  • Radno okružje s visokom razinom odgovornosti te rad sa iskusnim stručnjacima u navedenom području

Mjesto rada: Kalinovac, Koprivničko-križevačka županija Molimo pošaljite nam svoju prijavu i životopis najkasnije do 31.10.2026. godine.

jobs.title: STROJAR U SLUŽBI PROČIŠĆAVANJA OTPADNIH VODA
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 28. stavka 1. Zakona o vodnim uslugama (NN 66/19) i članka 35. Društvenog ugovora Vodovoda d.o.o. Zadar, te sukladno Smjernicama za provedbu Odluke o donošenju općih akata o postupku zapošljavanja u trgovačkim društvima u vlasništvu Grada Zadra i ustanovama kojima je osnivač, direktor Društva Tomislav Matek, dipl. ing. građ., objavljuje

JAVNI NATJEČAJ

za zasnivanje radnog odnosa za radno mjesto:

Strojar u Službi pročišćavanja otpadnih voda

(broj izvršitelja 1)

Radni odnos zasniva se na neodređeno vrijeme, uz probni rad u trajanju od 6 (šest) mjeseci.

Uvjeti:

Minimalna razina obrazovanja: SSS strojarskog smjera

Mjesto rada: Zadar

Radno vrijeme:puno radno vrijeme

Raspored radnog vremena: 1 smjena - prijepodne

Naknada za prijevoz: u cijelosti

Smještaj: nema

Radno iskustvo: 3 godine radnog iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima

Vozačka dozvola: B kategorija

Plaća: 1.335,14 € do 1.535,40 € bruto

Opis posla:

  • kontroliranje, popravljanje, ugradnja i održavanje strojarske opreme, uređaja i crpki u
  • procesu pročišćavanja otpadnih voda i crpnim stanicama,
  • rukovanje zasunima i zapornicama ručno ili daljinskim upravljanjem, pokretanje i
  • zaustavljanje rada crpki i opreme koja se koristi u tehnološkom postupka pročišćavanja
  • otpadnih voda,
  • obavljanje rutinskih poslova na održavanju opreme, remont opreme, servisi opreme,
  • zamjena ulja, podmazivanje zapornica i opreme koja se koristi u pročišćavanju otpadnih
  • voda ,
  • održavanje strojarske opreme i crpki (kontrola nastanka korozije, zaštita adekvatnim
  • premazima),
  • rukovanje i upravljanje strojo opremom, podmazivanje i kontrola nivoa ulja,
  • praćenje intervala za redovite servise opreme,
  • briga oko pravovremene nabavke rezervnih dijelova,
  • održavanje opreme u službi pročišćavanja otpadnih voda (pranje, čišćenje),
  • rukovanje s opasnim kemikalijama,
  • nadopuna kemikalija u odgovarajuće spremnike prema radnim postupcima,,

U prijavi je potrebno navesti osobne podatke: ime i prezime, adresu stanovanja, broj telefona/mobitela i e-mail adresu te priložiti slijedeću dokumentaciju:

  1. Životopis;

jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 28. stavka 1. Zakona o vodnim uslugama (NN 66/19) i članka 35. Društvenog ugovora Vodovoda d.o.o. Zadar, te sukladno Smjernicama za provedbu Odluke o donošenju općih akata o postupku zapošljavanja u trgovačkim društvima u vlasništvu Grada Zadra i ustanovama kojima je osnivač, direktor Društva Tomislav Matek, dipl. ing. građ., objavljuje

JAVNI NATJEČAJ

za zasnivanje radnog odnosa za radno mjesto:

Operater u Službi pročišćavanja otpadnih voda

(broj izvršitelja 4)

Radni odnos zasniva se na neodređeno vrijeme, uz probni rad u trajanju od 6 (šest) mjeseci.

Uvjeti:

Minimalna razina obrazovanja: SSS

Mjesto rada: Zadar

Opis posla:

  • održavanje opreme, uređaja, građevina i okoliša u procesu pročišćavanja otpadnih voda
  • rukovanje s repromaterijalima i kemikalijama koje se koriste u procesu pročišćavanja

otpadnih voda,

  • dehidriranje otpadnog mulja,
  • nadopuna spremnika za kemikalije prema radnim postupcima,
  • skidanje korozije po opremi i zaštita odgovarajućim sredstvima,
  • pomaganje kod redovitih remonta i popravaka opreme i crpki,
  • održavanje alata,
  • održavanje travnjaka,
  • rukovanje zasunima i zapornicama ručno ili daljinskim upravljanjem, pokretanje i

zaustavljanje rada crpki i opreme koja se koristi u tehnološkom postupka pročišćavanja

otpadnih voda,

  • obavljanje rutinskih poslova na održavanju opreme (pranje grubih i finih rešetki, zgrtača,

mjerne opreme, bazena, izlaznih brana, skidanje korozije, zaštita opreme odgovarajućim

zaštitnim sredstvima..),

  • kontrola ispunjenosti kontejnera za otpad i po potrebi zamjena beskonačnih vreća za

otpad,

  • pomoć oko čišćenja kod pražnjenja mastolova, zamjena hvatača masti i ulja…,
  • čišćenje građevina postrojenja i prihvata septika,
  • obrada i dehidracija mulja, održavanje kontejnera za mulj čistim,
  • mjerenje koncentracije plinova prema radnim uputama,

jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Töö induktsioonpliidiga (proovida mitte kõike põhja kõrvetada, mida vahepeal ka mul juhtub);
Tooraine ettevalmistus (korrektselt ja juhiste alusel valmistatud); Puhtuse ja korra hoidmine köögis (elementaarne oskus, mida peaks igaüks köögis omama); Toiduohutuse ja hügieeninõuete järgimine (väga tähtis punkt); Tooraine jälgimine ja laoseisu korrashoid (kasutame ainult kõige värskemat toorainet ja hoiame kuivaine laol silma peal); Tööaja detailne planeerimine (igapäevased to-do listid).

Omalt poolt pakume: Sõbralikku ja toetavat meeskonda (oleks hea, kui oskaksid vene keelelt, aga saab hakkama ka ilma);
Selgeid tööülesandeid ja väljaõpet kohapeal; Võimalust õppida ja areneda (peakokk on töötanud 1 ja 2 Michelini tärni restoranides Kopenhaagenis, Taanis); Paindlikku töögraafikut; Konkurentsivõimelist töötasu. Pakume ka ööbimise võimalust ja kütuse kompensatsiooni, kui elad Mustveest eemal.

Muud nõuded: Vähemalt 2 aastat varasemat töökogemust köögis (loodan, et oskad emotsiooni luua);
Kohusetundlikkus, täpsus ja vastutustunne (kvaliteet loeb); Põhiteadmised hügieeni- ja toiduohutusnõuetest (järjekordselt väga tähtis punkt); Soov panustada ettevõtte arengusse ja toidukvaliteedi hoidmisse (menüü täiustamine ja enda ideede väljakäimine); Huvi toidumaailma vastu (loodan, et toidu tegemine Sind päriselt ka huvitab).

Sinu peamiseks ülesandeks on meie restorani- ja konverentsikülaliste sõbralik ja tähelepanelik teenindamine. Töö hõlmab külaliste vastuvõtmist, tellimuste võtmist ja edastamist köögile, toitude ja jookide serveerimist, lauakatete korrashoidu ning arveldamist vastavalt restorani standarditele.

Omalt poolt pakume: * Stabiilset töökohta ja töötasu;
* Erialaseid koolitusi ning ettevõtte siseseid soodustusi; * Soodustusi Accor hotelliketti kuuluvates hotellides; * Stebby tervisehüvesid tööandja poolt; * Tasuta toitlustust.

Muud nõuded: Kandidaadilt ootame head organiseerimisvõimet, täpsust, vastutustunnet ning suurepärast suhtlemisoskust, vanust alates 18 eluaastat ja vajalik on eesti ja inglise keele oskus.
Kasuks tuleb varasem kogemus toitlustus- või hotellinduses. Töö toimub graafiku alusel.

jobs.title: Toitlustuse vahetusvanem
jobs.description:
Mövenpick Hotel Tallinn

Tööülesanded: Selles rollis oled sa see, kes hoiab teeninduse sujuvana ja meeskonna ühtsena. Sa juhid vahetust, lood selguse läbi igapäevaste infokoosolekute ning toetad meeskonda nii igapäevastes olukordades kui ka nende arengus. Samal ajal oled sina see, kes märkab detaile olgu selleks külalise kogemus, varude seis või meeskonna vajadused.
Koos restoranijuhiga hoolitsed selle eest, et töö oleks hästi korraldatud alates graafikutest ja sündmuste ettevalmistusest kuni igapäevase teeninduse kvaliteedini. Vajadusel võtad ka vastutuse ja juhid tervikut iseseisvalt.

Omalt poolt pakume: • Stabiilset tööd ja konkurentsivõimelist töötasu;
• Erialaseid koolitusi ning ettevõtte siseseid soodustusi; • Soodustusi Accor hotelliketti kuuluvates hotellides; • Rahvusvahelist hotellitöö kogemust; • Võimalust osaleda meie juhtidele suunatud arenguprogrammides; • Tasuta toitlustust ja Stebby tervisehüvesid; • Toetavat meeskonda ja ühiseid meeskonna üritusi.

Muud nõuded: Ootame sind, kui oled loomult hea suhtleja ja meeskonnamängija, kellele meeldib vastutus ning kes suudab hoida nii suurt pilti kui ka detaile fookuses. Sul on varasem kogemus toitlustuses ning tunned end kindlalt nii külaliste kui ka meeskonna ees.

jobs.title: Prentari / Printer
jobs.description:
Prentmet Oddi leitar að ábyrgðarmiklum, nákvæmum og metnaðarfullum starfsmanni til að sinna starfi prentara.
Um er að ræða fjölbreytt og krefjandi starf í öflugu framleiðsluumhverfi þar sem gæði, þjónusta og fagmennska eru í fyrirrúmi.

Helstu verkefni:
Stýra og hafa umsjón með offsetprentvél.
Úttekt og samanburður prófarka og prentarka til að tryggja gæði framleiðslu.
Umsjón með viðhaldi véla og útfylling viðhaldsbókar.
Veita svör og ráðgjöf varðandi prentun og tæknileg atriði.
Umhirða og frágangur vinnuaðstöðu.
Önnur tilfallandi verkefni tengd starfssviðinu.

Hæfniskröfur:
Reynsla af offsetprentun eða sambærilegri framleiðslu er kostur.
Góð tæknileg þekking og hæfni til að vinna sjálfstætt.
Nákvæmni, skipulagshæfni og öguð vinnubrögð.
Jákvætt viðhorf og góð samstarfshæfni.
Áhugi á gæðum og stöðugum umbótum.

Launakjör fara eftir reynslu, þekkingu og hæfni umsækjanda.
Starfið fellur undir kjarasamning Grafíu.
Vinnutími er frá 08:00 til 16:00 virka daga, en til 15:30 á föstudögum.

Um Prentmet Odda:

Prentmet Oddi er stærsti framleiðandi landsins á kartonumbúðum, almennu prentverki og bókum. Félagið vinnur jafnframt með mörgum af öflugustu umbúðaframleiðendum Evrópu til að veita fyrirtækjum heildarlausnir á sviði umbúða. Prentmet Oddi þjónustar meginþorra af kröfuhörðustu fyrirtækjum landsins og hefur gert það í áratugi með hraða, gæði og persónulega þjónustu að leiðarljósi.

eða

Nánari upplýsingar má einnig fá með því að senda fyrirspurn á isi@prentmetoddi.is.

Við leitum að einstaklingi sem hefur metnað fyrir gæðum, tæknilega færni og áhuga á að taka þátt í framleiðslu á fyrsta flokks prentverkefnum.
Umsóknarfrestur er til og með 12 september 2026

This is a varied and challenging position within a dynamic manufacturing environment where quality, service, and professionalism are key priorities.

Inspect and compare proof sheets and printed sheets to ensure production quality.

jobs.title: Chef to join our international kitchen team
jobs.description:
CHEF WANTED FOR STAFF RESTAURANT IN COPENHAGEN, DENMARK

Looking for a chef position in Copenhagen with great working hours, professional cooking and weekends mostly free?

We are looking for a skilled and motivated chef to join our international kitchen team in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Your main workplace will be The Staff Restaurant at Abacus Medicine, located at Kalvebod Brygge in central Copenhagen.

This is a full-time position with working hours primarily Monday to Friday from 06:30 to 14:30 – giving you the opportunity to work in an ambitious professional kitchen while still having your afternoons, evenings and most weekends free.

Occasional evening and weekend events may occur.

THE JOB

You will become part of a professional kitchen team responsible for the daily production and service at our staff restaurant.

We cook from scratch and care about good ingredients, seasonality, flavour and proper craftsmanship.

You will work primarily with hot kitchen production and take responsibility for your own preparation and tasks while working closely with the rest of the team.

Our kitchen is busy, so we are looking for someone who works efficiently and in an organised manner without compromising quality.

Just as importantly, we are looking for a good colleague.

We believe a professional kitchen should be a place where people communicate respectfully, help each other and enjoy coming to work.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

You may already be living in Denmark, or you may be considering moving to Copenhagen from another EU/EEA country.

We would like to hear from you if you:

  • are a trained chef or have equivalent professional kitchen experience

  • have experience from à la carte restaurants, quality staff restaurants, hotels or similar professional kitchens

  • have solid experience in the hot kitchen

  • have a genuine interest in food, ingredients and good craftsmanship

  • can organise your own work and maintain a good pace throughout the day

  • are reliable and comfortable starting work early

  • enjoy working as part of a team

  • communicate in a positive and respectful way

  • can maintain an overview when the kitchen gets busy.

A background in classic French or Mediterranean cuisine would be particularly relevant to our kitchen.

However, we are also interested in chefs who bring their own culinary background and experience. Whether your inspiration comes from France, Spain, Italy, Portugal, Greece, North or South America, Asia or somewhere else, we would like to see what you can bring to the team.

We want to taste what you are passionate about.

WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a full-time chef position in central Copenhagen with a working schedule that is unusual in the restaurant industry:

Monday–Friday
Primarily 06:30–14:30
Most evenings and weekends free

You will join a friendly and international workplace with experienced colleagues, high professional standards and room to contribute your own knowledge and ideas.

We value professional pride, teamwork, reliability and a positive working environment.

Our goal is simple: good food, good ingredients, good craftsmanship and a kitchen team that works well together.

MORE THAN A STAFF RESTAURANT

Your daily workplace will be:

The Staff Restaurant at Abacus Medicine
Kalvebod Brygge 35
1560 Copenhagen V
Denmark

Our kitchen also produces food for our small Copenhagen wine bar, Sankt Annæ 8, located in Christianshavn.

Within the same ownership group, we operate several Copenhagen restaurants, including Le Métier, La Propina and Ma Cuisine.

You will therefore become part of a wider restaurant family with different concepts and opportunities for future professional development.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION

Position: Chef
Employment: Full-time
Working hours: Primarily Monday–Friday, 06:30–14:30
Workplace: Copenhagen, Denmark
Starting date: As soon as possible / by agreement
Salary: Based on qualifications and experience and agreed individually
Evening/weekend work: Occasional events only

INTERESTED?

Send us your CV and a short application in English to:

job@willworkforfood.dk

Please write “CHEF FOR ABACUS” in the subject line.

Tell us a little about yourself, your kitchen experience, what kind of food you enjoy cooking and when you would be available to start.

Applications are reviewed continuously, and suitable candidates will be invited for an interview.

If you are currently living outside Denmark, please mention your current location and when you would potentially be available to relocate to Copenhagen.

We look forward to meeting you for a coffee and a conversation about food, ambitions and your future in Copenhagen.

The Staff Restaurant at Abacus Medicine
Copenhagen, Denmark
